scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Now I can see you.
I've been waiting for a good while.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
现在我能看清你了。
我已经等了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
There is something important.
Actually, there is much to be said by the esteemed daughter of Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
有件重要的事情。
实际上，内里乌斯尊贵的千金小姐有很多话要说。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes, right. Spica is now investigating several things.
That's why I look like this again.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
是的，没错。斯皮卡正在调查几件事。
所以我才又变成这副样子。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Actually, there is another task that Spica gave Crux during the banquet.
And Crux seems to have done it very well.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
实际上，斯皮卡在宴会上还给了克鲁克斯另一项任务。
而且克鲁克斯似乎完成得很好。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I heard about recently.
Spica told Crux to investigate the maid who gave me a glass with a drug during the banquet the other day.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我最近听说了这件事。
斯皮卡让克鲁克斯调查那个在宴会上给我下药的女仆。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Spica is so sharp in those things.
After all, she put me in this position as her substitute and is doing what she has to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
斯皮卡在这方面非常敏锐。
毕竟，她让我作为她的替身站在这个位置上，而她正在做她该做的事。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
She told us to wait for her. She said she would bring us some good news.
Since there are eyes everywhere, she told me to go to the Hero's Room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
她让我们等她。她说她会带来一些好消息。
因为到处都是眼线，她让我去英雄的房间。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
That's why we had to come here unwillingly without talking to you in advance.
Sorry for your inconvenience. Please wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
所以我们不得不没来得及先跟你打招呼就来到这里。
抱歉给你添麻烦了。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Maybe we should listen to her first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
也许我们应该先听听她的意见。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
As I told you before, you are the freest person among us.
So I am requesting you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
正如我之前所说，你是我们当中最自由的人。
所以我请求你。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
^4d4dffBruno^000000.. His destination must be ^4d4dffLighthalzen^000000.
Although it's my guess, I'm quite sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
^4d4dff布鲁诺^000000...他的目的地一定是^4d4dff里希塔乐镇^000000。
虽然这只是我的猜测，但我相当确定。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
He doesn't go to the Schwaltzvalt area even though he has an airship.
... He knows that he can be tracked.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
他虽然有飞空艇，却不去施瓦茨瓦尔特地区。
...他知道那样会被追踪到。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
So you have to ^4d4dffmeet Crux^000000 at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000. Then you have to narrow the range based upon the points that Crux has already investigated.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
所以你需要在^4d4dff里希塔乐镇机场^000000^4d4dff与克鲁克斯会面^000000。然后根据克鲁克斯已经调查过的线索缩小范围。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Not many of us can move freely. So we are asking you to take this task.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们当中能自由活动的人不多。所以我们请求你接受这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia is coming with you. She will be very helpful.
The Nerius family has great skill with swords.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯基亚会和你一起去。她会很有帮助的。
内里乌斯家族在剑术方面造诣很深。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I am counting on you.
You go separately and ^4d4dffmeet Crux and Skia at Lighthalzen Airport^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我指望你了。
你单独行动，在^4d4dff里希塔乐镇机场与克鲁克斯和斯基亚会面^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I look forward to hearing good news from you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我期待听到你的好消息。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
See you at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
在^4d4dff里希塔乐镇机场^000000见，英雄！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Now, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
现在，请原谅我失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Welcome. We have been talking about it already.
We are sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
欢迎。我们已经谈过了。
对此我们深表歉意。

scripts.text: We don't need so much formality between us ...
scripts.translation: 我们之间不必这么客气...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Can we talk freely?
Thanks.
It's my pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们可以随意聊聊吗？
谢谢。
这是我的荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
This is what I like about you.
Being able share confidences without sticking to formality is important.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
这就是我喜欢你的地方。
能够不拘礼节地分享心声，这一点很重要。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
By the way, let's talk about Bruno. How long do we have to proceed confidentially?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
顺便说一下，我们来谈谈布鲁诺吧。我们需要保密多久？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I'm sure the daughter of the Nerius family knows more about it than I do.
We must make a definite plan to resolve the situation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我相信内里乌斯家族的女儿对此比我更了解。
我们必须制定一个明确的计划来解决这个问题。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Everyone here knows that an Enterprise is behind him.
But he is outwardly innocent.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这里的人都清楚，他背后有企业的支持。
但他表面上看起来是无辜的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
That's why we are being swayed by him.
In my opinion, we'd better make a plan to track the whereabouts of the stolen ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 and reclaim it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这就是为什么我们会被他左右。
在我看来，我们最好制定一个计划，追踪被盗的^4d4dff泰拉格洛丽亚^000000的下落并将其夺回。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
For that reason, it will be interesting.
This Bruno guy will give you a fresh insight.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
正因如此，这会很有趣。
布鲁诺这家伙会给你全新的视角。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
How can you be so sure?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
你怎么能这么确定？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Because I trust Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
因为我信任克鲁克斯。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Sorry I'm late.
I found out a lot about Bruno.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
抱歉来晚了。
我查到了很多关于布鲁诺的事情。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
During the extradition procedure, I had to receive a little help from the Schwaltzvalt government.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
在引渡程序期间，我不得不接受施瓦茨瓦尔特政府的一点帮助。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
It was due to my position, and I am not a free adventurer ... Lady Skia handled it quite well for me ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
这是由于我的职位所致，我并不是一个自由的冒险者... 斯基亚女士替我处理得很好...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
There was an unexpected bonus.
I managed to get detailed data about the man and got a confession without making much fuss.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
还有一个意外的收获。
我设法获取了关于那个男人的详细数据，并让他招供了，而且没有引起太大的骚动。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I think it was possible because we convinced both sides that we would guarantee their security.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我认为之所以能成功，是因为我们让双方都相信我们会保证他们的安全。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I passed some of the unimportant details of the man's confession to the Schwartz government. Also, I handed Bruno to Schwartz.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我把那个男人招供中一些不重要的细节透露给了施瓦茨政府。另外，我也把布鲁诺交给了施瓦茨。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That's good.
After all, he would have been a burden to us even if we kept him.
So, the important information is ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那很好。
毕竟，即使我们留着他，他也是个负担。
那么，重要的信息是...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... It must be about a certain facility.
I mean, from the details on your report.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
... 那一定是关于某个设施。
我是说，根据你报告中的细节。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Considering the political situation of Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
... 考虑到施瓦茨瓦尔特的政治局势...

scripts.text: President?
scripts.translation: 总统？

scripts.text: Can we escape the Enterprise's attention?
scripts.translation: 我们能避开企业的注意吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not an easy job to inspect a facility in another country as part of the royal family's affair.
We cannot ask other families and leaders for cooperation yet.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
以王室事务的名义检查他国的设施，绝非易事。
我们目前还不能请求其他家族或领导人的合作。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Lady Spica. I believe you have already prepared a strategy.
The fact that Skia isn't here today might have something to do with your plan ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯皮卡小姐。我相信你已经制定好策略了。
斯基亚今天不在场，或许与你的计划有关...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess public approval is not something we can count on.
You are right. I sent Skia on another task.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
看来公众的支持是我们无法依赖的。
你说得对，我派斯基亚去执行另一项任务了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince Nihil. As you predicted, now we have to secure help from the Schwartz government.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
尼希尔王子。正如你所料，我们现在必须争取施瓦茨政府的支持。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And the Schwartz government knows of this as a private but important matter of the royal family of Nerius. That's because Skia made up a good story when delivering Bruno to Schwartz.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
施瓦茨政府知道这是内里乌斯王室的私人但重要的事务。这是因为斯基亚在把布鲁诺交给施瓦茨时编了一个很好的故事。

scripts.text: What was it?
scripts.translation: 是什么？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Since you are playing an important role, you need to know it as well.
Something extremely important to our family has been stolen.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
既然你扮演着重要角色，你也需要知道这一点。
对我们家族极其重要的东西被盗了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Currently, that important thing is said to be located in a suspicious facility. Now we have to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
目前，据说那个重要物品位于一个可疑的设施中。我们现在必须调查它。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
To investigate the facility, we need permission from the Schwartz government.
Outwardly, the Nerius family is the concerned party. That's why Skia is there now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
要调查该设施，我们需要施瓦茨政府的许可。
表面上，内里乌斯家族是相关方。所以斯基亚现在在那里。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We need more help.
Crux must report quickly. He will be busy again.
......
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们需要更多帮助。
克鲁克斯必须尽快汇报。他又会很忙了。
......

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I see.
Crux must go to Skia immediately.
And I must go to Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我明白了。
克鲁克斯必须立刻去找斯基亚。
而我必须去找尤诺。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Then you will borrow the name of the Nerius family.
In any case, I will try to do the best in my position.
And for the hands we lack ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
那么你将借用内里乌斯家族的名义。
无论如何，我会尽我所能做好我的位置。
至于我们缺少的人手...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
I feel so lucky that you are with us.
Please escort Miss Spica.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}。
有你在身边，我感到很幸运。
请护送斯皮卡小姐。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Escorting is not so difficult.
Your job is to wait until Miss Spica completes her task and bring her back safely.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
护送并不困难。
你的任务是等待斯皮卡小姐完成任务，并安全地带她回来。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
... I'm counting on you for Miss Spica.
Then I will go to Yuno now.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
...斯皮卡小姐就拜托你了。
那么我现在就去尤诺那里。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Now we have the big picture.
It depends on how the Schwartz government reacts to us.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
现在大局已定。
这取决于施瓦茨政府对我们的反应。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
For that issue, please trust the next leader of the Nerius family.
Then {0}, you come to ^4d4dffYuno Airport^000000.
We will continue our conversation there.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
关于这个问题，请相信内里乌斯家族的下一任领袖。
那么{0}，你来到^4d4dff尤诺机场^000000。
我们在那里继续谈话。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Let me speak plainly.
This is becoming more serious that we expected.
Crux did a wonderful job, so I thought we almost got them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
让我直说吧。
情况比我们预想的更严重。
克鲁克斯做得很好，我以为我们几乎得手了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But they are not so stupid.
Crux struggled to find the suspicious chamberlain who you saw at first.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
但他们并不愚蠢。
克鲁克斯费了好大劲才找到你最初看到的那个可疑侍从长。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But the maid who passed the glass was easily found.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
但那个递酒杯的女仆很容易就被找到了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
She had been ordered to recommend a drink to the son of the Heine family. Someone told her that it was his favorite drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
她收到命令，要推荐一种饮料给海尔内家的儿子。有人告诉她，那是他最喜欢的饮料。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
And you haven't found any special clues?
You have no more to investigate. Why did you come alone without Crux?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
那你没找到什么特别的线索吗？
没有更多可调查的了。为什么你独自前来，没带克鲁克斯？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, not really.
I got a clue about the chamberlain who gave the drink to the maid. His hometown is Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯，也不算完全没有。
我得到了一条关于那个给女仆倒酒的侍从长的线索。他的家乡是施瓦茨瓦尔特。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Crux has left to find that man.
He keeps me updated on his current location. He has now passed Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
克鲁克斯已经出发去找那个人了。
他一直向我汇报他的当前位置。他现在已经经过尤诺了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
If that man is from Schwaltzvalt, this is not going to be easy.
In particular, the royal family should not take an official action.
We cannot officially announce this situation either.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
如果那个人来自施瓦茨瓦尔特，事情就不会那么简单了。
特别是，王室不应该采取官方行动。
我们也不能正式公布这一情况。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The leaders of other families already know about the chamberlain. And, they called a conference to discuss how to handle that issue.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
其他家族的领袖已经知道了那个侍从长的情况。而且，他们召开了一次会议，讨论如何处理这个问题。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have been in the conference so far. Seems like every family has a different idea.
So I decided to do as I wish.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
到目前为止我一直在参加会议。看来每个家族都有不同的想法。
所以我决定按我的意愿行事。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
The problem is where that chamberlain is headed. Regardless of his final destination, it will be quite tough for Crux alone.
{0}, could you please go for backup?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
问题在于那个侍从长要去哪里。无论他的最终目的地是哪里，仅靠克鲁克斯一人都会相当艰难。
{0}，你能去支援一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then let me go too.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
那我也去吧。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
As you wish.
This is the report from Crux.
I don't like outside missions. So I will just stick to my room. Hahaha ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
随你便。
这是克鲁克斯的报告。
我不喜欢外出任务。所以我就会待在房间里。哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... You are helping us so much.
Thanks a lot.
But why are you so eager to help us?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...你帮了我们很多。
非常感谢。
但为什么你这么热心地帮助我们？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hmm, I find it interesting.
And I think a change is needed.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯，我觉得这很有趣。
而且我觉得需要改变一下。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Soon, our day will come.
And I find it stuffy.
The unusual obsession of the Heine family ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
很快，我们的日子就会到来。
而且我觉得很沉闷。
海尔内家族那种异常的执着...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, let me stop here.
If I continue, it will be too rude of me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好了，我就说到这里。
如果继续说下去，就太失礼了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... But you look quite happy.
Whatever. We will talk about more details of the story later.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...但你看起来挺开心的。
算了。我们之后再详细谈谈这件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I handed part of Crux's report to Prince Nihil.
For your schedule from now on, you'll have to talk to Prince Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我把克鲁克斯报告的一部分交给了尼希尔王子。
关于你接下来的日程，你需要和尼希尔王子谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I look forward to hearing good news from you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我期待听到你的好消息。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
See you at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
在^4d4dff里希塔乐镇机场^000000见，英雄！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Now, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
现在，请原谅我失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Welcome!
Sorry for having entered the room while the owner was not present.
But I had nothing to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
欢迎！
抱歉，主人不在的时候我闯入了房间。
但我实在没事做。

scripts.text: What about others?
scripts.translation: 其他人呢？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I reclaimed the Blessing Star.
There was a conference.
Nihil and Spica participated.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我收回了祝福之星。
开了一次会议。
尼希尔和斯皮卡参加了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Now I feel like everything is back to normal.
The recent tasks have been so wonderful and interesting.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
现在我觉得一切都恢复了正常。
最近的任务真是既精彩又有趣。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... I had always been operating in the shadows behind Spica's back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
...我一直都在斯皮卡身后，在阴影中行动。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
If my mother finds out about this, she will be quite upset.
My father will be concerned. But he will tell me it's okay, as usual.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
如果母亲知道这件事，她会很生气的。
父亲会担心的。但他还是会像往常一样告诉我没关系。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
....
By the way, hero.
I think I am unwell lately.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
....
对了，英雄。
我觉得我最近身体不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I occasionally have a shooting pain near my heart. And my heart beats faster than usual. Sometimes I become hot even though I don't have a fever.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我偶尔会感到心脏附近一阵刺痛。心跳也比平时快。有时候即使没有发烧，也会觉得发烫。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Is this because I didn't have enough training due to the banquets? There might be a problem with my health.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
这是因为宴会太多，训练不足吗？我的健康可能出了问题。

scripts.text: Do you feel it all the time?
scripts.translation: 你一直都有这种感觉吗？

scripts.text: When is it most serious?
scripts.translation: 什么时候最严重？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Not always ...
Recently ... Oh! It was when I was waiting for the adventurer at the Einbroch hotel ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
不是一直...
最近...啊！是在艾音布罗克旅馆等冒险者的时候...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
When I asked him whether I could use the Scroll of Movement ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
当我问他能不能使用移动卷轴的时候...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
When he told me to wait for a while in this room ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
当他让我在这个房间稍等的时候...

scripts.text: Who told you to wait?
scripts.translation: 谁让你等的？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
It was Nihil. He said he would come after finishing everything.
...
Ah! My heart is beating fast again!
What's wrong with me ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
是尼希尔。他说处理完事情后会过来。
...
啊！我的心跳又加速了！
我到底怎么了...

scripts.text: ... A heart disease.
scripts.translation: ...心脏病。

scripts.text: Perhaps it's love?
scripts.translation: 也许是恋爱了？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... What? A heart disease?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...什么？心脏病？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... Love??
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...恋爱？？

scripts.text: Skia told Spica about her symptoms.
scripts.translation: 斯基亚向斯皮卡讲述了自己的症状。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh my god! Skia!
What do you like about Prince Nihil?
Is it his handsome face?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
天哪！斯基亚！
你喜欢尼希尔王子的什么？
是他英俊的脸吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, what?
Why do you keep mentioning Nihil?
The hero asked me the same thing ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
啊？什么？
你为什么一直提尼希尔？
英雄也问过我同样的问题...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Come on, my sister.
What you mentioned so far were the moments when you were with Prince Nihil.
................
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
拜托了，姐姐。
你刚才提到的，都是和尼希尔王子在一起的时候。
............

scripts.text:
[Spica]
As I expected ............
Let's talk about this later.
Oh ... You will be in trouble once my mother knows this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
果然如此............
这件事我们改天再谈。
啊...要是让母亲知道了，你可就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Bel]
Prince Grantz has arrived.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
格兰茨王子到了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Hmm. The esteemed daughters of the Nerius family are here too.
First of all, {0} I have come to show my gratitude to you.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
嗯。内里乌斯家的千金们也在啊。
首先，{0}，我来向你表达谢意。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Thanks to your support, we kept the tradition of our royal family. And we avoided the dirty tricks of malicious people.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
多亏了你们的支持，我们保住了皇室的传统，也避免了那些心怀恶意之人的阴谋。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is true that Nihil overstepped his place during the process. But we removed the dishonor on our family.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
确实，尼希尔在过程中有些越界。但我们消除了家族蒙受的耻辱。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince, didn't we finish the discussion in the conference?
Thanks to the Prince, you have gained an advantage in the trade with the Schwaltzvalt government.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
王子殿下，我们在会议上不是已经谈完了吗？
多亏了王子殿下，您在与施瓦茨瓦尔特政府的贸易中占据了优势。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
... Right.
Although Fritz and I were involved, Nihil did quite a good job in terms of domestic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
...是的。
虽然弗里茨和我也有参与，但尼希尔在处理内政方面做得相当不错。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince. You still don't want to accept him. Do you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
王子殿下。您还是不想接纳他，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is not true.
I also learned a lot during this event.
It was an unexpected result.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
并非如此。
在这次事件中，我也学到了很多。
这是一个意想不到的结果。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
On second thought, I didn't give any opportunity to Nihil. And he may have been sad about it.
... Anyhow ... He must have.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
仔细想想，我并没有给尼希尔任何机会。他可能因此感到难过。
...总之...他一定很难过吧。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Thanks to this event, the Heine family learned a lot.
All we hope now is for Peter, who is in the hospital, to wake up.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
多亏了这次事件，海尔内家族学到了很多。
现在，我们只希望住院的彼得能醒过来。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Hmm, let me stop talking about private stuff.
I have {0} come to compensate
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
嗯，我不该说这些私事。
我带来了{0}作为补偿。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
This might be a small reward considering what you have done for us.
... But please take it.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
考虑到你们为我们所做的一切，这点报酬可能微不足道。
...但请收下。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
You can continue to enjoy everything you did as a guest. We have agreed on it.
As you always have shown us honest faith.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
你们可以继续享受作为客人的一切待遇，我们已经达成了协议。
因为你们一直对我们表现出真诚的信任。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Then I will let you young people enjoy the conversation.
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那么，我就让年轻人好好聊聊天吧。
回见。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
See you later. I will contact you.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
回见。我会联系你的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia?
Why don't you have a quiet conversation with me?
{0} seems like most things are arranged. Now I will leave with my poor sister.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亚？
你为什么不和我安静地聊聊天呢？
{0}，看来大部分事情都安排好了。现在我要带着我可怜的姐姐离开了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Ah ... Hero.
Next time, please visit the Nerius family again!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
啊...英雄。
下次，请再来内里乌斯家做客吧！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
By the way, I received a letter from ^4d4dffPhilopontess^000000.
He told you to visit him at ^4d4dffWerner Laboratory Entrance^000000. Don't forget to visit him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
对了，我收到了^4d4dff菲洛庞特斯^000000的信。
他让你去^4d4dff维尔纳实验室入口^000000找他。别忘了去拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I don't know why he used me as a contact point. What a brave young man.
I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不知道他为什么利用我作为联络点。真是个勇敢的年轻男子。
回见。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh, hello.
Nice to meet you here.
Me? I am just doing the task the Lady gave me.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
哦，你好。
很高兴在这里见到你。
我？我只是在执行女士交给我的任务。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Ah, have you arrived?
Have you come alone?
I heard Skia was coming too ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
啊，你到了？
你是独自来的吗？
我听说斯基亚也会来...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh! You've arrived.
The Prince of the Heine family ordered me, so I came to Lighthalzen. Do you think that man will show up?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
哦！你到了。
海尔内家的王子命令我，所以我来到了里希塔乐镇。你觉得那个人会露面吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I think he will.
That man who used to be a chamberlain ... Didn't you write on the report that he was trying to contact someone?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我想他会来的。
那个曾经是侍从长的人...你在报告里不是写了他正在试图联络某人吗？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Yes. I did.
I thought he was seeking the person behind the chamberlain.
He was also asking for more payment.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
是的，我写了。
我以为他在寻找侍从长背后的人。
他还要求增加报酬。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
According to Nihil, the person behind the chamberlain is likely to be in Lighthalzen.
Here or Einbroch. But Nihil said those guys would probably hate a city full of smoke.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
根据尼希尔的说法，侍从长背后的人很可能在里希塔乐镇。
这里或者艾音布罗克。但尼希尔说那些人可能讨厌充满烟雾的城市。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Hmm. Really?
Then the person behind him may be in a high position or have authority. Or he/she might be rich.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
嗯。真的吗？
那么他背后的人可能地位很高，或者拥有权力。又或者他/她很有钱。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Umm. Anyway, what we have to do is find that guy here in Lighthalzen.
And what do we know about his features and clothes?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯。总之，我们要做的是在里希塔乐镇找到那个人。
我们对他/她的特征和衣着了解多少？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
A man with a neat appearance, with light brown hair down to his shoulders.
His name is Bruno ... Since it's such a common name, it may be an alias.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
一个外表整洁的男子，留着及肩的浅棕色头发。
他的名字是布鲁诺...因为这个名字很常见，所以可能是一个别名。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I will investigate southern Lighthalzen, and the lady will investigate nearby the department store and hotel.
Adventurer, please search ^4d4dffthe north and northeast area^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我会调查里希塔乐镇的南部，女士会调查百货公司和酒店附近。
冒险者，请搜索^4d4dff北部和东北部区域^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Once you find anything, ^4d4dffplease meet in front of the central department store and we'll share information^000000.
Now let us move quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
一旦你发现任何线索，^4d4dff请到中央百货公司前集合，我们会共享信息^000000。
现在让我们快速行动吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, yes.
Crux ... You are a great actor.
See you later.
You too, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
哦，是的。
克鲁克斯...你真是个出色的演员。
回见。
你也是，英雄！

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I will investigate southern Lighthalzen, including the airport.
Adventurer, please take care of the north and northeast areas.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我会调查里希塔乐镇的南部，包括机场。
冒险者，请负责北部和东北部区域。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Once you find anything, ^4d4dffplease meet in front of the central department store and we'll share information^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
一旦你发现任何线索，^4d4dff请到中央百货公司前集合，我们会共享信息^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Really? He headed to the slum?
We are in trouble.
I will follow you with the lady by any means.
Adventurer, please go there first.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
真的吗？他去了贫民窟？
我们要麻烦了。
无论如何，我会和女士一起跟上你。
冒险者，请先去那里。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You mean ... Bruno?
It will be difficult to use the airship. So we are moving separately.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
你是说...布鲁诺？
使用飞空艇会很困难。所以我们分开行动。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't worry about me, I will see you again in the palace.
Please give my regards to Lady Spica.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
别担心我，我会在宫殿再见你的。
请代我向斯皮卡女士问好。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't you have to go to Yuno?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
你不应该去尤诺吗？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I have an appointment in the hotel in Lighthalzen.
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我在里希塔乐镇的酒店有个约会。
我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I don't like leaving you like this for a long time ...
... I have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我不喜欢让你这样独自等待太久...
...但我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This is what you want.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
这就是你想要的结果。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
So far, I haven't seen anyone suspicious!
But I will find him soon.
I don't know why, but I have a strong belief about it.
The belief that he must be here!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
目前为止，我还没看到任何可疑的人！
但我很快就会找到他的。
不知道为什么，我对此有着强烈的信念。
我相信他一定在这里！

scripts.text:
He must have gone to the slum!
We have to find a way to get there.
scripts.translation:
他一定去了贫民窟！
我们必须想办法去那里。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will tell Crux. You go after that guy first, please.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我会告诉克鲁克斯的。请你先去追那个人。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Let's go back to the palace now.
Crux took that Bruno guy.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我们现在回宫殿吧。
克鲁克斯带走了布鲁诺。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I always wanted to visit this place as a tourist. I never imagined to come here this way.
Wonderful city.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我一直想以游客的身份来参观这个地方。没想到会以这种方式来到这里。
真是一座美丽的城市。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Let's go back to the palace.
Crux will take care of Bruno.
Then we will get ready for the investigation, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我们回宫殿吧。
克鲁克斯会处理布鲁诺的事。
然后我们准备开始调查，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I have to tell Nihil about this.
Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我必须把这件事告诉尼希尔。
我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I have been waiting.
Since there has been a change in the schedule, we might miss each other.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我一直在等。
因为日程有变，我们可能会错过彼此。

scripts.text: You are escorting Spica, right?
scripts.translation: 你在护送斯皮卡，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
That's what I would like to talk about.
Do you know Lady Skia and I requested a meeting in Yuno earlier?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
这正是我想谈的。
你知道斯基亚女士和我之前要求在尤诺会面吗？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Since there are too many eyes in Yuno as well as the presidential residence, they wanted to meet us in a different location.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
因为尤诺和总统官邸都有太多双眼睛盯着，他们希望我们在其他地方见面。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I thought Lady Spica would draw their attention if she stayed too long in Yuno. So she moved to the appointed place immediately.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我担心斯皮卡女士如果在尤诺停留太久会吸引他们的注意。所以她立刻去了约定的地点。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
She disguised herself as a tourist ... and is now in ^4d4dffthe hotel in Lighthalzen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
她伪装成游客...现在在^4d4dff里希塔乐镇的酒店^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I wanted to send her a note to update the changed schedule. But I thought I would meet her here ... So I've been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我想给她留个条子通知日程变更。但我以为会在这里遇到她...所以我一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
... ...
Since we do these things secretly, this happens quite often.
I know it's funny, but I am sorry that your trip was in vain.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
...
因为我们做这些事都很秘密，这种情况经常发生。
我知道这有点好笑，但很抱歉让你白跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
But the Schwartz government is positive about it.
However, I don't know what kind of card the ladies showed them ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
但施瓦茨政府对此持积极态度。
不过，我不知道女士们给他们看了什么牌...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Well, I have to take care of my task.
Then let us go to ^4d4dffLighthalzen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
好了，我得去处理我的任务了。
那我们去^4d4dff里希塔乐镇^000000吧。

scripts.text: I will count on you.
scripts.translation: 拜托你了。

scripts.text: Wait a minute.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please tell me when you are ready.
Then we will get going.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
请告诉我您准备好了。
然后我们就出发。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This way ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
这边请...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Let's go to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我们去里希塔乐镇。

scripts.text: I will count on you.
scripts.translation: 拜托你了。

scripts.text: Wait a minute.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please tell me when you are ready.
Then we will get going.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
请告诉我您准备好了。
然后我们就出发。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This way ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
这边请...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
The appointed place is ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
An agent named ^4d4dffLazy^000000 is waiting for us.
We have to hurry.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
约定的地点是^4d4dff艾音布罗克火车站^000000。
一位名叫^4d4dff懒散^000000的特工在那里等我们。
我们得快点。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I never imagined that I would be traveling overseas ... I hope everything goes well.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我从没想过自己会出国旅行...希望一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You've arrived on time!
Sorry for what happened in Yuno.
They say we'd better move to another place.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你准时到了！
抱歉尤诺发生的事。
听说我们最好换个地方。

scripts.text: Who said that?
scripts.translation: 谁说的？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Let me introduce you this person.
He has been sent by the president of Schwaltzvalt.
From now on, you will talk with him before deciding what to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
让我给你介绍一个人。
他是施瓦茨瓦尔特总统派来的。
从现在起，你要先和他商量再决定怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Tess will explain.
Let's listen to him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
泰丝会解释的。
我们听听他怎么说。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please talk to the representative of the Schwaltzvalt government along with the lady.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
请和那位女士一起与施瓦茨瓦尔特政府的代表谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
The appointed place is ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
An agent named Lazy is waiting for you.
We have to hurry.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
约定的地点是^4d4dff艾音布罗克火车站^000000。
一位名叫懒散的特工在那里等你。
我们得快点。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
My name is Philopontess. You can call me Tess.
Naturally, you have to talk to the president about this ... I am sorry we have to meet you this way.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我的名字是菲洛庞泰丝。你可以叫我泰丝。
当然，这件事你得和总统谈...很抱歉我们要以这种方式见面。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The big picture has already been drawn ...
Do you need a detailed explanation?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
大局已经定下了...
你需要详细的解释吗？

scripts.text: Let us hear it.
scripts.translation: 让我们听听。

scripts.text: Please tell us what to do from now on.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我们接下来该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you ... for your concern.
Saying the same thing again is quite hard.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
谢谢...你的关心。
同样的话再说一遍很难。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Haha, it must be a tough job.
Philopontess? Please go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈，这工作肯定很辛苦。
菲洛庞泰丝？请继续。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
{0} I'm not sure how much you know about this. The political condition in Schwaltzvalt is not good.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
{0} 我不确定你了解多少。施瓦茨瓦尔特的政治局势不太好。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you remember the collapse of the Secret Wing, maybe you will know a lot about it.
But the Secret Wing was not destroyed entirely.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
如果你记得秘密机翼的崩溃，可能对此了解很多。
但秘密机翼并没有完全被摧毁。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Although it's only a small number, there are agents who are working on information warfare.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
虽然人数不多，但确实有一些特工正在从事信息战工作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I am one of them. Usually, I work as a secretary.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我就是其中之一。通常，我担任秘书一职。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The reason I am involved in this issue is that the case requested by the Nerius family is very special.
As you know, the government does not have a very good relationship with the enterprise. And we need cooperation for the facility of the enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我之所以卷入这件事，是因为内里乌斯家族委托的案件非常特殊。
如您所知，政府与企业之间的关系并不融洽。而我们需要利用企业的设施。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So we are taking this opportunity to execute what we have planned.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
所以，我们正借此机会执行早已计划好的行动。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That organization was destroyed once, so they must be lacking in armed forces. We will be supporting them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那个组织曾经被摧毁过一次，所以他们的武装力量肯定很薄弱。我们会支持他们的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And you are the key player in that mission.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
而你是那次任务中的关键人物。
我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So this will be a cooperative relationship.
We give you the information and discharge surveillance and legal restriction on the facility.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
所以这将是一种合作关系。
我们提供情报，并解除对该设施的监视和法律限制。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Then we want to disable the Enterprisebeyond repair.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
然后，我们要让企业彻底瘫痪，使其无法修复。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
To avoid surveillance by the enterprise, our president came here secretly and went back immediately.
His excellency entrusted me with the rest, so you can work with me from now on.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
为了避免被企业监视，我们的总裁秘密来到这里，随即又立刻离开了。
他将剩下的事情托付给了我，所以从现在开始，你可以与我合作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Now, I will let you know the future plans.
The princess is trying to reclaim the secret treasure of your family, right?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
现在，我要向你说明未来的计划。
公主正在试图夺回你们家族的秘宝，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We estimate that the one who took it is a trustee of the enterprise. And the facility we have to investigate is the ^4d4dffabandoned factory area near Einbroch^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们推测，拿走秘宝的人是企业的受托人。而我们需要调查的设施是^4d4dff艾音布罗克附近的废弃工厂区^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We know a lot about this facility.
It is one of the facilities we were planning to investigate.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们对这个设施了解很多。
它也是我们计划调查的设施之一。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We can send an official letter to the Enterpriserequesting their cooperation in the investigation. But as far as we are concerned, such an official request would only give them time to hide things.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们可以向企业发送正式信函，请求他们配合调查。但对我们来说，这种正式请求只会给他们时间掩盖真相。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since the royal family of Rune Midgarts is helping us, we decided to run a random inspection.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
既然鲁恩·米德加特的王室在支持我们，我们决定进行一次突击检查。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Sorry to interrupt you, but the only agents who can fight here are the adventurer and me ...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
抱歉打断一下，但在这里能战斗的特工只有冒险者和我们……

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I see. An experienced adventurer and a bodyguard ...
We do realize that we do not have enough armed forces. So we have prepared some other strategies.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我明白了。一位经验丰富的冒险者和一名保镖……
我们也意识到武装力量不足。所以，我们准备了其他策略。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
But here, if necessary, we need the help from the adventurer ... What's your name?
{0}, your cooperation is required.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
但在这里，如果有必要，我们需要冒险者的帮助……你叫什么名字？
{0}，我们需要你的合作。

scripts.text: I am all right.
scripts.translation: 我没事。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Actually, I have a military group in mind to work with us. I'm sure you know them.
It's ^4d4dffRebellion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
实际上，我打算让一个军事团体与我们合作。我相信你知道他们。
就是^4d4dff反叛者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After the Mercenary Rebellion, those who opposed the Enterprise allied and established the Rebellion.
They will accept our proposal.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
在佣兵叛乱之后，那些反对企业的人联合起来，建立了反叛者组织。
他们会接受我们的提议。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Rebellion? Those guys? Are you serious?
It was the government that ignored the mercenaries who were in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
反叛者？就是那群人？你是认真的吗？
明明是政府无视了那些陷入困境的佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That's why they organized a military group themselves and have grown so far ... Do you really think they will be on our side?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
所以他们才自己组建军事团体，并发展到了现在的地步……你真的认为他们会站在我们这边吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You know quite a lot about it.
Of course, I expect some buzz.
That's why we need {0}.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
看来你很了解情况。
当然，我预料到会有一些风波。
所以我们需要{0}。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since they hate us, there has been no progress in the negotiation. That's the problem.
This time, {0} and the royal family are with us. So the president thinks that we have a strong chance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
因为他们憎恨我们，谈判一直没有进展。这就是问题所在。
这次，{0}和皇室都站在我们这边。所以总裁认为我们有很大的机会。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If the adventurer talks to them, they will listen.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
如果是冒险者去跟他们谈，他们会听的。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The important thing is that we must get the cooperation of the Rebellion.
We must be able to use the military force of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
重要的是，我们必须获得反叛者的合作。
我们必须能够使用反叛者的军事力量。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And inspecting the facility must be through the Rebellion and the organization. Only then can we approve your investigation to reclaim the secret treasure.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
而且，检查设施必须通过反叛者和该组织进行。只有这样，我们才能批准你进行调查以夺回秘密宝物。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are saying that ... if we don't get help from the Rebellion, you cannot approve the investigation of the facility?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你的意思是……如果我们得不到反叛者的帮助，你就不能批准对设施的调查？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You already know that they will hate it if the government contacts them.
Then there is one thing we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你已经知道，如果政府直接联系他们，他们会很反感。
那么，有一件事我们必须做。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We have to rely on the heroic adventurer to borrow the military force of the Rebellion ...
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们必须依靠英勇的冒险者来借用反叛者的军事力量……
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
After all, what we need is an investigation of the ^4d4dfffacility^000000.
There is nothing more we want. Now let us finish the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
毕竟，我们需要的是对^4d4dfffacility^000000的调查。
我们没有其他要求。好了，让我们结束这段对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And then, {0} I would like to explain our schedule ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
然后，{0}，我想解释一下我们的日程……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We have no other choice.
They say it has to be you. No one else ...
{0}... Will you help us?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们别无选择。
他们说必须是你，不能是别人……
{0}……你会帮我们的吗？

scripts.text: Once we start, we have to finish it.
scripts.translation: 一旦开始，就必须完成。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Haha. {0} you never disappoint me.
But I can't vacate my seat for too long.
I am sorry that I cannot be with you until the end of this mission.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈。{0}，你从不让我失望。
但我不能离开座位太久。
很抱歉，我无法陪你直到任务结束。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So you are going back, princess.
{0}. Please meet ^4d4dffLazy^000000 in ^4d4dffEinbroch^000000 and work with him. He is a negotiator who we have prepared.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
所以你要回去了，公主殿下。
{0}。请在^4d4dff艾音布罗克^000000与^4d4dff懒散^000000会面并合作。他是我们准备的谈判代表。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
An agent named ^4d4dffLazy^000000 will be waiting for you at the ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
Please don't forget it.
If possible, please hurry.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
一名名为^4d4dff懒散^000000的特工将在^4d4dff艾音布罗克火车站^000000等你。
请别忘了。
如果可能的话，请快点。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
From now on, this is a race against time.
Thank you for your support in advance.
I will go to the president for a report.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
从现在开始，这是一场与时间的赛跑。
提前感谢你的支持。
我要去见总裁汇报情况了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... What a straightforward man.
Let's go back now.
Seems like we have finished our job.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
……真是个直率的人。
我们现在回去吧。
看来我们的工作已经完成了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have to entrust you to meet ^4d4dffLazy in Einbroch^000000... For additional issues, I will go back to the palace and handle them with the prince of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我必须委托你去^4d4dff艾音布罗克见懒散^000000……至于额外的问题，我会回宫殿与海尔内家族的王子处理。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Then, {0}.
I wish you fortune in war.
Crux, let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那么，{0}。
祝你在战争中好运。
克鲁克斯，我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Someone crazy about Yuno]
Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation:
[痴迷朱诺的人]
朱诺~ 去见朱诺~ 如果你生而为人，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你来到了施瓦茨瓦尔特，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你还在呼吸，就去朱诺那里~

scripts.text:
[???]
Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation:
[???]
朱诺~ 去见朱诺~ 如果你生而为人，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你来到了施瓦茨瓦尔特，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你还在呼吸，就去朱诺那里~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They told me to meet the agent of the Secret Wings. Could it be that person? Well, by no means...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们让我去见秘密之翼的特工。难道就是那个人吗？嗯，绝对不可能...

scripts.text:
[???]
Yo! Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[???]
嘿！很高兴见到你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it should never be him... Let's ignore him for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，绝对不可能是他... 先无视他吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
A heron swallows a fish alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
鹭独自吞下鱼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heron wants to drink water?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鹭想喝水吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
In that case, you should say 'A heron hides its secret in the wings'. Didn't you hear that before leaving?
scripts.translation:
[???]
那样的话，你应该说“鹭将秘密藏在翅膀里”。你出发前没听到吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be confusing me with someone else...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一定是认错人了...

scripts.text:
[???]
{0} Isn't it you...? It must be you! Why do you pretend as you are not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
{0} 难道不是你...？一定是你！你为什么装作不是？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am {1} that person. But...

[???]
Are you sure you don't know anything? My name is ^0000cdLazy^000000. Of course it's not my real name. For now, you can just remember that name.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你确定什么都不知道吗？我的名字是^0000cd懒散^000000。当然这不是我的真名。暂时，你只需要记住这个名字。

scripts.text:
[???]
I have been assigned to this mission with you. We have to ask the Rebellion for cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我被指派与你一起执行这项任务。我们必须请求反叛者合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you are Lazy, you must be the agent of the Secret Wings. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你是懒散，那你一定是秘密之翼的特工。对吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Pipe down~ You must not say that word in a public place like this! You must always be careful! Remember that we are in the middle of a mission!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
小声点~ 在这种公共场合绝对不能说那个词！你必须时刻小心！记住我们正处于任务之中！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Yes.

[Lazy]
Just by looking at you, I know they have brought someone very smart. And the callus in your hand indicates that you are a man of the world.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
光看你的样子，我就知道他们派来了一个非常聪明的人。而且你手上的老茧表明你是一个见过世面的人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are also taking someone off his/her guard by pretending to be a little naive. You deserve to be trusted by the royal families of Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你甚至通过假装有点天真来让人放下戒心。难怪你能被伦恩米德加特的王室信任。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
When I read about you in the report, I thought you would look a bit scary. But by seeing you directly, you seem to be different from what I heard. That's why we have to meet someone directly to know him/her well.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当我在报告中读到关于你的描述时，我以为你会看起来有点吓人。但亲眼见到你，你似乎和传闻中不太一样。这就是为什么我们必须亲自见面才能了解一个人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
By the way, how are you? Have you been to Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
顺便问一下，你最近怎么样？你去过阿鲁纳菲兹吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, yes. Kind of...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，算是去过吧...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow- Have you met the Pope? Her highness is great. I really like her.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇——你见过教皇吗？陛下非常伟大。我真的很喜欢她。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, Pope... !!

[Lazy]
I'd really love to meet the Pope. But I am not mentally ready to see the holy face of her highness. I guess I might black out once I see the Pope. If you have time later on, please take me to the Pope.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我真的很想见见教皇。但我还没做好心理准备去瞻仰陛下神圣的面容。我想我一见到教皇可能会晕过去。如果你之后有空，请带我去见见教皇吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
By the way, what are we doing here? Aren't we supposed to meet in ^0000cdEinbech^000000? I have been waiting for a long time and came here. And I found you here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
话说回来，我们在这里做什么？我们不是在^0000cd艾音贝赫^000000约定见面的吗？我等了很久才来到这里，结果发现你在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They told me to come here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们让我来这里。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey~ Who? Who said that? There must have been some misunderstanding during the communication. We must go to Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿~谁？谁让你来的？肯定是沟通时出了什么误会。我们必须去艾音贝赫。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, since I like a train, it doesn't matter how many times I take it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯，既然我喜欢坐火车，坐多少次都没关系。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's hurry up. We have a long way to go.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们快走吧。还有很长的路要走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where are we going now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们现在要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The most dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
最危险的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Calm down! I'm just kidding. You are too serious. We are just going to the secret base of the Rebellion in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冷静点！我只是开玩笑。你太严肃了。我们只是要去艾音贝赫的反叛者秘密基地。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm just saying that I feel like it is dangerous. I don't mean it will really be dangerous. Calm down.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我只是说我觉得那里很危险，并不是说真的会有危险。冷静点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If we are negotiating with the Rebellion, why are we going to Einbech instead of Einbroch?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我们要和反叛者谈判，为什么不去艾音布罗克，而是去艾音贝赫？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Have you heard of the mercenary revolt in Schwaltzvalt?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你听说过施瓦茨瓦尔德的佣兵叛乱吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
To tell you briefly, the mercenaries were used as a garrison of the republic. But as the republic developed a Guardian, they were about to be abandoned. Then the mercenaries rose in revolt and were nearly annihilated.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
简单地说，佣兵曾被用作共和国的驻军。但随着共和国开发了<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫，他们即将被抛弃。于是佣兵发动了叛乱，并几乎被歼灭。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Some of the remnants went to Figel, But the rest of them gathered in Einbech and Einbroch to organize the Rebellion. By the way, Einbroch is a large city where many people live ans pass by. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
一些残部逃到了菲格尔，但其余的人聚集在艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克，组织起了反叛者。顺便说一句，艾音布罗克是一座大城市，很多人居住和路过那里，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So the Rebellion put their guild in Einbroch. The rest of them were hiding somewhere else in Einbroch. That's why I suggested you to meet in Einbech..
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以反叛者把他们的公会设在艾音布罗克。其余的人则隐藏在艾音布罗克的其他地方。这就是我建议你我们在艾音贝赫见面的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, the government was overlooking the remnants for various reasons. I'm sure the government is still uncomfortable about it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，政府出于各种原因一直在忽视这些残部。我相信政府对此仍然感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why this negotiation is so important. We are going to asking for help to the guy who's angry at me. It won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以这次谈判才如此重要。我们要去向那个对我生气的人求助，这可不是一件容易的事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We should them a sense of apology and a promise of hope in the future. At the same time, ^0000cdwe have to relax their mind and promise with them to cooperate in future affairs^000000...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们应该向他们表达歉意，并许下未来的希望。同时，^0000cd我们要安抚他们的情绪，并承诺在未来的事务中与他们合作^000000...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just by listening to it, it sounds really difficult.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
光是听你说，就觉得非常困难。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The most difficult thing is how to enter the ^0000cdsecret base^000000 rather than talking to them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
最困难的不是和他们交谈，而是如何进入^0000cd秘密基地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, we will think about the method on our way there. You Just trust me and follow me. Nothing is impossible as long as you trust me. You can trust me in any situation.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，我们在路上再想办法。你只需相信我，跟着我就行。只要你相信我，就没有什么是不可能的。在任何情况下你都可以相信我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have much faith in you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我对你的信任度并不高。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's okay, because I trust myself. Out of all these people in this large world, I am the only one whom I trust. So you just follow me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没关系，因为我相信我自己。在这个广阔世界的众多人中，我是唯一让我自己信任的人。所以你就跟着我吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have great faith in yourself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你对自己很有信心。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Of course. If I don't feel confident about myself, I can't do this job.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然。如果我对自己的能力没有信心，我就做不了这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Sometimes I have to face some unpleasant situation, and do things that are not sometimes moral. But for my task and survival, I must not hesitate to make momentary decisions and execute my actions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
有时我不得不面对一些不愉快的情况，做一些有时并不合乎道德的事。但为了我的任务和生存，我必须毫不犹豫地做出瞬间的决定并执行我的行动。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And let's say you begin to doubt it. Once your mind starts to shake, the task will be in danger. Unwavering confidence is more important than anything else.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而且，假设你开始产生怀疑。一旦你的意志开始动摇，任务就会陷入危险。坚定不移的信心比什么都重要。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Of course, you need the capability to support your confidence. You can't trust anything without evidence.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然，你需要有能力来支撑你的信心。没有证据，你就不能相信任何东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
After listening to what you said, I don't fully trust you. But I feel like having to trust you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听完你说的话，我并没有完全信任你。但我感觉不得不信任你。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's quite natural. Very good. Good luck in our mission. My goal is to build a reputation of a fantastic duo with you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这很正常。非常好。祝我们的任务顺利。我的目标是与你建立一对绝佳搭档的名声。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's get going. This way.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们走吧。这边请。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The ticket gate is over there! We have to pay for the train. Are you saying we will walk there?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
检票口在那边！我们要买火车票。你是说我们要走过去吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yikes! Pipe down!! Of course we are taking a train. In a special place and in a special way.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
天哪！小声点！！我们当然是坐火车的。在一个特殊的地方，用一种特殊的方式。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A free ride? Why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
免费乘车？为什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you want to call it a free ride, go ahead. But do you really want to discount your action as a 'free ride'? You can used the elegant expression 'occupation after closed infiltration'.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你想称之为免费乘车，那就随你吧。但你真的想把你的行为贬低为“免费乘车”吗？你可以用更优雅的说法：“潜入后的占领”。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Usually, we can feel buy tickets, say hello to the station staff eat delicious snacks, and enjoy our trip.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
通常，我们可以买票，向车站职员问好，吃美味的零食，享受我们的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But we are in the middle of a mission. It's already begun. It's kind of an emergency. So we have to be tense.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
但我们正处于任务中。任务已经开始了，情况有点紧急。所以我们必须保持紧张。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really don't understand the relationship between being tense and free riding.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真的不明白保持紧张和免费乘车之间有什么关系。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you really thing I'm just trying to save 200 Zeny? I know what I'm doing. You just follow me without nagging. We are in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你真以为我只是想省那200 Zeny吗？我知道自己在做什么。你就别唠叨了，跟着我就行。我们赶时间。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why aren't you following me? We might miss the train!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你怎么没跟上？我们要赶不上火车了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了。明白了吗？回头见！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you okay to be here now?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你现在在这里没问题吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了。明白了吗？回头见！

scripts.text: It is a small hole where one person can barely pass through.
scripts.translation: 这是一个非常小的洞，一个人勉强能挤过去。

scripts.text: You passed through the hole where one person can barely enter.
scripts.translation: 你穿过了那个一个人勉强能挤过去的洞。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We are going to take a train here. Do you see ^0000cdvery small hole^000000 in the sewer down there?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们要在这里坐火车。你看到下面下水道里那个^0000cd非常小的洞^000000了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this... a ^0000cddoghole^000000? I heard the Secret Wings is an executive office of the President. Why are you so needy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...是个^0000cd狗洞^000000吗？我听说秘密翅膀是总裁的行政办公室。你为什么这么卑微？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Shh--- I told you not to mention that name. Be careful from now on. I don't want to be stabbed on my back for something I didn't do. If you really want to say it, call it Heron.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘘--- 我告诉过你，不要提那个名字。从现在开始小心点。我不想因为没做过的事而在背后挨刀。如果你非要说的话，就叫它“鹭”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean, why do you have to go through a place like this? Don't they pay you any activity cost? Maybe his excellency doesn't care for all your comfort.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说，你为什么非要走这种地方？他们不给你发活动经费吗？也许那位大人并不在乎你的舒适。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's not true. We receive a free pass to use all means of transportation in this continent. They includes airship, train and teleporting, etc.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不是这样的。我们拥有使用本大陆所有交通工具的免费通行证。包括飞空艇、火车和传送等。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why do you have to go through a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你们为什么非要走这种地方？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Because we don't want to leave the records. We must not be detected by others. Although we get captured, our moving route must be hidden. The moving routes can be a great clue.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
因为我们不想留下记录。我们必须不被他人发现。即使我们被抓住了，我们的移动路线也必须隐藏。移动路线可能会成为重要的线索。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No wonder we have the word 'secret' in our name. That's why I move so carefully during my mission.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
难怪我们的名字里有“秘密”这个词。这就是为什么我在执行任务时如此小心。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
To avoid being detected, duck yourself and follow me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为了不被发现，请低下头，跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Someone crazy about Yuno]
Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation:
[痴迷朱诺的人]
朱诺~ 去见朱诺~ 如果你生而为人，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你来到了施瓦茨瓦尔特，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你还在呼吸，就去朱诺那里~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He told me he'd come here. Maybe he's still in Einbroch train station? I have to go there again.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他告诉我他会来这里。也许他还在艾音布罗克火车站？我得再去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is Einbech. The last time I came here, I was being chased by 17 pursuers.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这里是艾音贝赫。上次我来这里的时候，被17个追捕者追着跑。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm sorry I can't tell more than that. It's confidential.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
抱歉，我不能透露更多。这是机密。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey! I just cracked a joke before starting on the mission. You can't even accept?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿！任务开始前我开了个玩笑，你连这个都接受不了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm a little nervous. A negotiation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有点紧张。毕竟是要去谈判...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You don't have to be nervous. I'm going to be in charge of talking to them. You just add several words beside me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不用紧张。谈判由我负责，你只需要在我旁边说几句话就行。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
In this mission, the trust is important. There is a reason why the government assigned you to this mission in addition to me, a professional negotiator.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在这个任务中，信任至关重要。除了我这名专业谈判专家外，政府还指派了你，这自有其原因。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are known as a hero in this Midgard continent and a symbol of trust. If you come with me, the Rebellion will be less stubborn to us. Once we get trusted by them, everything will work out.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在米德加尔特大陆上被誉为英雄，也是信任的象征。如果你和我一起去，反叛者对我们的抵触就会少一些。一旦他们信任我们，一切就会顺利解决。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Talking like that in that clothes, you don't look very persuasive.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
穿着这身衣服说这种话，看起来一点也不像有说服力啊。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is my critical costume I prepared for this mission. Who would ever find a tourist suspicious?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是我为了这次任务准备的伪装。谁会怀疑一个游客呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
As I mentioned before, our greatest challenge is to enter the Rebellion's secret base without any armed conflict. This costume is for that purpose.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
正如我之前所说，我们最大的挑战是在不发生武装冲突的情况下潜入反叛者的秘密基地。这身装扮就是为了这个目的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And Yuno is such a nice place. I have a dream to buy a building there after retirement and spend my golden years comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而且朱诺是个好地方。我梦想着退休后在那里买栋房子，安度晚年。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't they normally choose a resort like Comodo for golden years?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
通常人们不是会选择克魔岛这样的度假胜地来安度晚年吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, I don't like a beach. I saw the sea every single day when I was young. Now I'm sick of its salty smell. To leave the sea, I used to have a dream to become a captain of airship.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，我不喜欢海滩。小时候我每天都看海，现在我已经受够了那股咸味。为了离开大海，我曾经梦想成为一名飞空艇的船长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you wanted to become a pilot, why did you become a secret agent?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你想当飞行员，为什么后来成了特工？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I can't tell you. It's confidential.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我不能告诉你。这是机密。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, when you get back after the mission, you can purchase a train ticket and show it to the employee in the train station. But it's free for me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，任务结束后你回来时，可以买一张火车票，出示给火车站的员工看。不过对我来说是免费的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, where should we go now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，我们现在该去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We have go somewhere deep inside the village. From here on, just trust me and follow me. Since the path is a little complicated, I will leave ^0000cdtraces^000000. Make sure you catch them up.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们要去村庄深处。从这里开始，请相信我并跟着我。因为路线有点复杂，我会留下^0000cd痕迹^000000。请务必跟上。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在干什么？我让你跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We are not supposed to be here now.
We must go to the rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们现在不该在这里。
我们必须去反叛者那里。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了。明白了吗？回头见！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wait. Stop right there. Somebody is lying down here. Don't step on it. Hey, watch out!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
等等。停在那里。有人躺在这里。别踩到他。嘿，小心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this a human?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是人类吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If I get rid of this and that...!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果把这些都处理掉...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow... I think today is a lucky day. This mission is going to be easier than we thought.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇...看来今天是幸运之日。这个任务比我们想象的还要轻松。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What's written on the bottom? Dying message? Are they words? How come he never practiced writing even if he was a Gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
下面写的是什么？遗言？这是字吗？明明是个神枪手，怎么连字都没练过？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, try to heal this man. Although he has an injury, it's not so serious. Since he's collapsed due to an exhaustion, he'll probably recover himself by a simple treatment. Once he wakes up, I will take all the information from him.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，试着治愈这个人。虽然受了伤，但并不严重。他是因为过度疲劳而倒下的，只要简单处理一下，应该就能自己恢复。等他醒来后，我会从他那里获取所有情报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know how to heal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不会治愈术。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Aren't you an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不是冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Adventurer is not almighty.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冒险者也不是万能的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, I have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好吧，我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Odin, Freyja, Thor and a god of exhausted traveler. Please show us a mercy!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
奥丁、弗蕾雅、托尔，还有疲惫旅行者的守护神啊，请赐予我们怜悯吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wow... You're a secret agent and you also know how to heal?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...你是特工，居然还会治愈术？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, after experiencing so many things, you should do it all.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，经历了这么多事，你应该什么都会才对。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'am so good at various arts and craft. I am such a great person.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我精通各种技艺。我真是个大人物。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He won't wake up immediately, but he'll save his life anyway. If we were too late, he would have died.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他不会马上醒来，但命保住了。如果我们再晚一点，他就死了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? Carry him.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在干什么？把他抬起来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are we carrying him? I thought we were on a secret mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们要抬着他走？我以为我们在执行秘密任务。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We ^0000cdmust bring^000000 him. No matter what happens, we must bring this man. He will be our ticket to the base.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们^0000cd必须带^000000他走。无论发生什么，都必须带上这个人。他是我们进入基地的通行证。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who's this man?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good question. But since we don't have enough time, let me explain later. We must deliver him before he dies.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
问得好。但既然时间紧迫，我稍后再解释。我们必须在他死前把他送出去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在干什么？我让你跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you here now?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你现在在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Put down what you have carried.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
放下你背上的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪？这里一个人也没有。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You can see as much as you know. That's why I'm always tired. People all want me to look at them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你能看到的，就是你所知道的。所以我总是很累。大家都想让我看他们。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, let's get in here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, where am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，我在哪？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You talk too much! I told you we don't have much time. You can listen to my explanation later. Someone who was standing in front of this detected me already and went inside. We don't know what they will prepare.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你话太多了！我说过时间不多了。你可以稍后再听我的解释。刚才有人站在这里，发现了我，然后进去了。我们不知道他们会准备什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, are we going to leave him here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我们要把他留在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah. Is there any problem? Is it a problem? Could it be a problem?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是啊。有问题吗？这有问题吗？这会有问题吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said that we should bring the injured man. Then you told me to carry him all the way here. Now you are abandoning him here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你刚才说我们应该带上那个受伤的男人。然后你让我把他背到这里。现在你要把他丢在这里？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Don't worry about him. He's not going to die. Humans do not die so easily. The fact I'm still alive is the evidence.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
别担心他。他不会死的。人类没那么容易死。我还活着就是证据。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not the issue here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这不是重点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on, let's get in. We don't have much time. Let's talk inside. Aren't you curious to know what's in there?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
快进来。时间不多了。我们在里面谈。你不想知道里面有什么吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We have to see something to get in there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们必须看到什么东西才能进去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look at this. There's an entrance here. This is ^0000cdan entrance hidden in the wall of the beach^000000. It is so fishy. Let's get inside and check what's there.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看这里。这里有个入口。这是^0000cd隐藏在沙滩墙壁里的入口^000000。真够可疑的。我们进去看看里面有什么。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? Come in!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你在干什么？快进来！

scripts.text:
[Eri]
Oh, welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
哦，欢迎光临。这里是武器店，夜巡者转职考试地点。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
In this store, even a small sound creates a huge resonant due to its structure. Please be quite when entering here.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
在这家店里，由于结构原因，即使是很小的声音也会产生巨大的共鸣。请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
A real customer!! We have a customer in this period...
scripts.translation:
[内米]
真正的顾客！！在这个时期居然有顾客...

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Be quite when entering.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
进来时请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Who are you? This is not a place where anyone can come in. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
你是谁？这里不是谁都能进来的地方。请离开。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ouch! The store looks smaller that it looks from outside. Is there a space behind the pillar?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎哟！这家店看起来比外面看要小啊。柱子后面还有空间吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this a firearm store?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是一家枪械店吗？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
A real customer?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
真正的顾客？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Welcome. This is ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000 and we handle various firearms.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
欢迎光临。这里是^0000cd夜巡者转职考试地点^000000，我们经营各种枪械。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Take a look around and tell me if there is anything you are looking for.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
请随意看看，如果您有什么需要的，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah.. I hope we have what you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯...希望我们有您需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
By the way... How did you find us? This is a small store that only limited people visit.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
顺便问一下...您是怎么找到这里的？这是一家只有少数人光顾的小店。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I wanted to buy a self-defense gun. And someone recommended me this store.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我想买一把自卫用的枪。有人向我推荐了这家店。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Who.. was it?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
谁...推荐的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What would you do if I tell you who that person is?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果我告诉您那个人是谁，您会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow, this looks cool. Is this the way you hold it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇，这个看起来挺酷。是这样握持的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Sir. That stuff is quite sensitive and you shouldn't tough it inconsiderately.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
先生。这东西很敏感，请不要随意触碰。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Didn't you tell me to look all I want? This is so small! Can it ever fire a bullet? Look at the dust here. I guess you're out of business here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
您不是让我随便看吗？这也太小了吧！它能发射子弹吗？看看这里的灰尘。看来你们生意不好啊。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Oh.. That's one of the most popular products in our store.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哦...那是我们店里最受欢迎的产品之一。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Is this a popular product? I can imagine the quality of this store.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是最受欢迎的产品？我都能想象出这家店的质量了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
What did you say? Are you insulting my gun now?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你说什么？你是在侮辱我的枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, I don't mean it. But if you heard it that way, then it's an insult.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不，我不是那个意思。但如果您听成了那样，那就是侮辱了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Calm down, Nemi. He's a customer.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
冷静点，内米。他是顾客。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hmm... This looks quite good. How much is it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯...这个看起来不错。多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
3.4 million Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
340万Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's the price of a snack. Give me one.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这价格连零食都不如。给我来一个。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Since it is a display product, we have to place an order. There are too many orders and you have to wait for eight months. Can you wait?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
既然是展示品，我们就得去订货。订单太多了，你得等八个月。你能等吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm not the one who's short-tempered. I guess it's you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我可不是脾气差的人。我看是你吧。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Calm down, Nemi.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
冷静点，内米。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Rather than these, show me what you actually sell here. For example, ^0000cdFast Grinder Cutting through the Wind^000000?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
别拿这些糊弄我，给我看看你们真正卖的东西。比如^0000cd疾风切割研磨工^000000？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Hey, who the hell are you?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
嘿，你他妈是谁啊？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Can't you see? I am a tourist and this is my secretary.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看不出来吗？我是游客，这是我的秘书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sec, secretary...?

[Shopkeeper]
Which tourist comes all the way to the weapon store in a mining village where there is nothing to see? Where do you come from?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哪个游客会大老远跑到一个没什么可看的采矿村里的武器店来？你从哪来的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I just arrived from Yuno. I went there and it was so~ wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我刚从尤诺来。那里真是~太棒了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Go back. We don't have what you want.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
回去吧。我们没有你要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So you're kicking us out? Mr. Nemieri. You can't do this.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以你要赶我们走？内米里先生。你不能这样。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Why can't I kick you out? Go away before call someone.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
我为什么不能赶你走？在我叫人之前赶紧滚。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You'd better take a look who's out there. His name was... ^0000cdGonie^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你最好看看外面是谁。他叫... ^0000cd戈尼^000000。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Just go outside and check it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你自己出去看看不就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
I won't tolerate you if you're playing shallow tricks.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
如果你是在耍小把戏，我绝不会容忍。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Can he carry him alone?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他能一个人把他扛走吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is the collapsed guy from here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个倒在地上的人是从这里出来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Didn't you know? That's why we struggled to bring him all the way here. Now look. He will use a magic after a short while.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不知道吗？所以我们才费了这么大劲把他弄到这里。你看，过一会儿他就要施放了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Arrgh...

[Shopkeeper]
Oh, my goodness. Gonie! What happened!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
天哪。戈尼！发生什么事了！

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Eri. Go and bring ^0000cdLucky^000000.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
绘理。去把^0000cd拉基^000000叫来。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Lucky?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
拉基？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Hey, what did you to this guy?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
喂，你们对他做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, we did something. He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive. That was a great job.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯，我们做了一些事。他当时快死了，我们一路把他救活带到这里。这可是大功一件。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Didn't you hurt him to take him as a hostage?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你们是不是伤了他，把他当人质？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why would I hand over the person I took hostage to you? If you really don't know what happened, wake him up and ask him. What would you do if we didn't hurt him?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我为什么要把我抓的人质交给你？如果你真的不知道发生了什么，就让他醒过来问问他。如果我们没伤他，你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You'll be so embarrassed, sorry and ashamed. Would you even lift your head up?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你会很尴尬、很抱歉、很羞愧。你还能抬起头吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why are you doubting us so much? Enough is enough. Not many villains try to swindle with an injured person.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你为什么这么怀疑我们？够了。很少有恶棍会用受伤的人来行骗。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is unfair. I've been victimized! Father! Mother!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这不公平。我才是受害者！神父！母亲！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Nemi, what happened? Is Gonie dead?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
内米，发生什么事了？戈尼死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
No, he's not.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
不，他没死。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive~ It was so tough~~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他当时快死了，我们一路把他救活带到这里~ 真不容易~~

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
He's not doing very well. We have to take him there and lay him down. Wake up, Gonie. Can you walk?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他情况不太好。我们得把他带到那边躺下。醒醒，戈尼。你能走吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It will be difficult now. You will have to carry him. If it is hard for you, you can order my strong secretary to lift him~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在很难。你得背着他。如果你背不动，可以命令我强壮的秘书把他抬起来~

scripts.text:
[??]
Arrgh, yeah!!
Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Gonie]
....!

[Lazy]
Oh, dear! You dropped him. Maybe you have been overworking.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀！你把他摔了。看来你最近太累了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He opened his eyes! Looks like he is conscious!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他睁开眼睛了！看起来他恢复意识了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, he opened his eyes instinctively due to the impact. He's still unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不，他只是因为撞击而本能地睁开了眼睛。他仍然处于昏迷状态。

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! Are you all right? Stand up.
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你没事吧？站起来。

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Gonie]
....!

[Lazy]
My god! You dropped him again. Don't work too hard.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
天哪！你又把他摔了。别太勉强自己了。

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! What happened to you? Stand up again.
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你怎么了？再站起来一次。

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Gosh, why is your arm you so weak? Seems like this place is in trouble. You have no manpower so you hired such a weak person? My god.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
天哪，你的手臂怎么这么弱？看来这个地方麻烦不少。人手不足，所以雇了这么弱的人吗？真是的。

scripts.text:
[??]
I don't know who you are. But I hear what you're saying!
scripts.translation:
[??]
我不知道你是谁。但我听到了你在说什么！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hear what? I was just speaking inside!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到什么？我只是在心里自言自语！

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! Why are you so bloody? Did they attack you?
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你身上怎么这么多血？他们攻击你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
you! It's because of you! You just can't lift him! Come on. Let's carry him together. You are so weak that you cannot lift anything heavier than a spoon.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你！都怪你！你就是抬不动他！快。我们一起抬他。你弱得连比勺子重一点的东西都抬不起来。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Don't give Lucky too much pressure.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
别给拉基太大压力。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I barely saved his life and now you're trying to kill him. It's a fortune that he is unconscious and cannot feel the pain.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我好不容易救了他的命，现在你又要害死他。幸好他昏迷着，感觉不到疼痛。

scripts.text:
[??]
Thanks, Nemi. Arrgh. Let's bring him and lay him down.
scripts.translation:
[??]
谢谢，内米。啊。我们把他带过去躺下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey. Don't you have anything to tell us?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
喂。你们就没有什么要告诉我们的吗？

scripts.text:
[??]
Oh, I heard about you briefly. Thank you very much for saving my friend and taking him all the way here. The shop owner will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[??]
哦，我大概听说过你们。非常感谢你们救了我的朋友，并把他一路带到这里。店主会补偿你们的。

scripts.text:
[??]
See you later.

[Lazy]
Wait! They're sending us away like this? Seems like they are. Did I get it wrong?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
等等！就这样把我们打发走了吗？看起来是这样。我理解错了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oops? They went inside! Come on!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀？他们进去了！快跟上！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are sending us back after giving some money? You can't do this! At least, you should give me a cup of tea!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
给了钱就把我们打发走？你们不能这样！至少，应该请我喝杯茶吧！

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Please, customer. You shouldn't do this.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
拜托了，顾客。您不该这样做的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Then tell them to come out! Come out now! Come out! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
那就让他们出来！现在出来！出来！快出来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, Lazy. This is a little embarrassing. Let's go back now. We have a mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，懒散。这有点尴尬。我们回去吧。我们有任务在身。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Never! I am impervious to shame so I will keep shouting until they come out! Hey! Rookie! Come out! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
绝不！我脸皮厚得很，我会一直喊到他们出来为止！嘿！新人！出来！快出来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm feeling ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得很丢脸...

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Be quiet. If you keep making a fuss, I will call someone to get you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
安静点。如果你继续闹事，我会叫人把你赶出去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Who kicks me out! That's impossible! I will lie down here! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
谁敢赶我出去！绝对不行！我就躺在这里！出来！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Phew...

[Lazy]
He's here!!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他来了！！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Your voice is so loud that it hurts my ears. Normally, stupid people have huge voices.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
你的声音太大了，吵得我耳朵疼。通常，愚蠢的人声音都很大。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I can do something worse.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我能做出更糟糕的事。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I see. Come in. We can give you a cup of tea as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我明白了。进来吧。我们可以按你的要求给你倒杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Are you sure it's okay?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你确定这样没问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Look at him. He can't even hurt us.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
看看他。他连伤害我们的能力都没有。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I feel weird, but I will skip it. Oh! I'm so thirsty~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我觉得有点奇怪，但我就免了吧。哦！我渴死了~

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Follow me. It's this way.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
跟我来。这边请。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
These guys are quite loud.
I would never be bored.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
这些人真吵。
我绝对不会感到无聊。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Someone has come, and I think he is looking for you.
I let him come in, even though I had a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
有人来了，我想他是来找你的。
虽然我有种不好的预感，但我还是让他进来了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
These people are really rude.
... How can they ever put a visitor outside like this?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
这些人真没礼貌。
...怎么能把客人晾在外面呢？

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Hey, dude. You talk very politely, don't you?
Without this case, we would never cooperate with the government guys!
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
嘿，伙计。你说话真客气啊。
要不是因为这件事，我们才不会跟政府的人合作呢！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
There is a visitor from Rune Midgarts. I escorted the visitor to ^4d4dffthe Einbroch hotel^000000.
I don't know how things are going on here.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
有一位来自鲁恩·米德加特的访客。我把他带到了^4d4dff艾音布罗克旅馆^000000。
我不清楚这里的情况如何。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since I was able to come in here, I guess the negotiation was successful.
... Where is the field of operations?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
既然我能进来，看来谈判是成功了。
...行动地点在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
That's what I was about to tell you!
Without you, I've already told him all about it!
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
这正是我正要告诉你的！
没有你，我已经把一切都告诉他了！

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Well, I don't know if you are a visitor or not. But you're going to Einbroch? It's good.
We are going to Einbroch, too.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
嗯，我不知道你是不是访客。但你要去艾音布罗克？很好。
我们也是要去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Einbroch hotel? Nice.
If you take a train here, you will arrive at Einbroch in a moment.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
艾音布罗克旅馆？不错。
如果你坐火车来这里，很快就会到达艾音布罗克。

scripts.text: The heron ...
scripts.translation: 苍鹭...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The heron? Oh, Lazy?
I'm sure he will take care of getting himself there.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
苍鹭？哦，是懒散？
我相信他会自己安排好的。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
See you at ^4d4dffEinbroch hotel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们在^4d4dff艾音布罗克旅馆^000000见。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Well, let me escort you to the train station.
Shall we depart now?
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
嗯，让我送你去火车站吧。
我们现在出发吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: We will go on our own.
scripts.translation: 我们自己去。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
From Einbech station to Einbroch, you go on your own.
Now you know the direction.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
从艾音贝赫站到艾音布罗克，你自己去吧。
现在你知道方向了。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
You said it is ^4d4dffEinbroch hotel^000000.
We will send someone you might know well.
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
你说的是^4d4dff艾音布罗克旅馆^000000。
我们会派一个你可能很熟的人去。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Maybe it's our chance to give a huge gift to the enterprise~
scripts.translation:
[斯夸德]
也许这是我们给企业送上一份大礼的好机会~

scripts.text: Since you do not have the ^00ffff{0}^000000, you cannot proceed any further.
scripts.translation: 由于您没有^00ffff{0}^000000，无法继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What is going on here?
There's something in the air.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
这里发生了什么？
空气中弥漫着某种气息。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Well, I have to hand it to you.
I've never stepped back before.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
好吧，我得承认你很强。
我以前从未退缩过。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not a big deal, is it?
We are doing this for our mutual benefit.
It's not so definite yet
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
没什么大不了的，不是吗？
我们这样做是为了双方的利益。
目前还没有最终定论。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The president will make the final decision anyway.
... But I believe his excellency will accept it without any opposition.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
反正最终决定权在会长那里。
...但我相信阁下会毫无异议地接受这个提议。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
But I am still upset.
... It's just a personal feeling.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
不过我依然感到不安。
...这只是我个人的感受。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Would you please let me know what you have been talking about?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
能告诉我你们刚才在讨论什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not so serious.
We have been discussing diplomatic issues that could arise during our operation. Also, we talked about the relationship with the Enterpriseand other plans.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
没什么严重的。
