我们在讨论行动期间可能出现的 diplomatic 问题。此外，我们还谈到了与企业（Enterprise）的关系以及其他计划。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We also talked about the possible gains and losses for our two sides during this cooperation ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们也讨论了这次合作中双方可能获得的利益和损失...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... Although it was committed by the enterprise, we cannot deny that it happened in our country. So we have to take some responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...虽然这是企业所为，但我们不能否认它发生在我们的国家。因此我们必须承担一定的责任。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Yes. That's it.
But I'm not sure whether they could feel more comfortable with this kind compensation or contract ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
是的，就是这样。
但我不确定他们是否更倾向于这种补偿或契约...

scripts.text: They?
scripts.translation: 他们？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Once we sent delegates to Schwaltzvalt.
... And they never came back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们曾派遣代表前往施瓦茨瓦尔特（Schwaltzvalt）。
...但他们再也没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Come to think of it, you must have cleared your mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
仔细想想，你应该已经完成了任务。

scripts.text: Give him the Blessing Star.
scripts.translation: 给他祝福之星

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Terra Gloria, the surface is gone.
Only the star is remaining.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...泰拉·格洛丽亚（Terra Gloria），表面已经消失了。
只剩下星星了。

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
No, the surface is just a means to cover the star.
What matters is the star.
You have brought the right stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
不，表面只是用来包裹星星的手段。
重要的是星星本身。
你带来了正确的东西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Hmm? It's just a gem, isn't it?
Why on earth did they steal this?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
嗯？这只是一颗宝石，不是吗？
他们为什么要偷这个？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Because it is like a fine magic stone.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
因为它就像一块精美的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.. Now they steal the materials for experiments?
There are several more facilities that are presumed to have secret laboratories like this.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...现在他们连实验材料都偷？
据推测，还有几个设施拥有像这样的秘密实验室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Are you freaking out about the future?
We have already finished talking about it.
I told you that I would support you if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
你在担心未来吗？
我们已经讨论过了。
我告诉过你，如果你需要，我会支持你。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... That was in reference to the mutual agreement. So please don't take the credit for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...那是指双方的协议。请不要把功劳揽在自己身上。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Credit? I was just telling the truth.
Now, I don't have to be here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
功劳？我只是说了实话而已。
好了，我也不用留在这里了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You are so cold.
Are you leaving right after obtaining what you want?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你真是冷漠。
拿到想要的东西就要立刻离开吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We will meet again, if necessary.
Tess, if you visit Prontera, you will be more than welcome.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
如果有必要，我们还会再见的。
泰丝，如果你来普隆德拉，我会非常欢迎你的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Besides, I don't have much time.
I have many things to handle when I get back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
而且，我也没多少时间了。
回去后还有很多事情要处理。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
Go back to the palace and wait in your room.
I will make sure that you get enough compensation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}。
回到宫殿后，就在房间里等着吧。
我会确保你得到足够的补偿。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Are we going back now?
I have a Scroll of Movement made by Nilem, the palace magician. Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我们现在要回去了吗？
我有尼勒姆——宫廷魔法师制作的移动卷轴。要使用吗？

scripts.text: Let me join you!!
scripts.translation: 让我加入你们！！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
No, {0}, please talk to me for a while.
I would like to get some more!
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
不，{0}，请再和我聊一会儿。
我还想多聊点！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia, activate it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯基亚，发动它。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes~
Mr. Philopontess, so long!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
好~
菲洛庞特斯先生，再见！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Good to see you again.
I am glad you are safe.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
很高兴再次见到你。
看到你还平安无事，我很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
This happened because of me. So I came to resolve the crisis myself.
... It would be shameful of me to keep relying on others.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这件事是因为我而发生的。所以我亲自前来解决危机。
...一直依赖别人，对我来说是羞耻的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Although I cannot help you physically,
I can take care of the information analysis and diplomatic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...虽然我不能在体力上帮你，
但我可以负责情报分析和外交事务。

scripts.text: Have you been released from confinement?
scripts.translation: 你被解除禁闭了吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm~ Unfortunately, no.
I reported to the elders of our royal family about this affair. I was scolded and barely got permission to come here.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯~ 很遗憾，没有。
我向皇室的长老们汇报了这件事。我被责骂了，勉强才获得许可来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
In the process, I took advantage of your name.
Officially, you are the key person resolving this crisis and I am the one who takes the responsibility. And Lady Skia is observing me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
在这个过程中，我借用了你的名字。
官方说法是，你是解决这次危机的关键人物，而我负责承担责任。至于斯基亚女士，则是在监督我。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Since they all know about you, everyone is expecting you resolve this by any means.
I apologize for having taken advantage of your name without informing you earlier.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
既然大家都知道了你的存在，所有人都在期待你无论如何都要解决这个问题。
抱歉，之前没有告知你就借用了你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Without it, they would never have approved you.
They would have claimed that you had made things worse.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
如果没有这样做，他们绝不会批准你的。
他们会声称是你把事情搞得更糟了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Let's talk about the operation ... Is your name Philopontess?
We are cooperating now, so may I tell you my opinion?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们来谈谈行动吧... 你的名字是菲洛庞特斯吗？
既然我们现在是合作关系，我可以告诉你我的意见吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course.
And please call me Tess.
The Rebellion will be in charge of the military operation. But ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
当然可以。
请叫我泰丝。
反叛者将负责军事行动。但是...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
In terms of strategy, we are superior.
And we only have a single chance. So you are welcome to give us a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
在战略方面，我们更胜一筹。
而且我们只有一次机会。所以，如果你有什么好主意，尽管提出来吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, he sure has a big mouth~
If my sister Elena heard it, she might have shot him in the head!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，他嘴巴真大~
如果我姐姐埃琳娜听到这话，说不定会一枪崩了他的头！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We've picked out the combatants. Since this operation is confidential, we selected those who we can fully trust.
And the investigation of the buildings and geographical features?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们已经挑选好了战斗人员。由于这次行动是机密的，我们只选了完全值得信赖的人。
至于对建筑物和地形的调查呢？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course, we have provided it.
We have been investigating this place for quite a long time.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
当然，我们已经提供了。
我们对这个地方已经调查了相当长的时间。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I read the document.
The funny thing is here ... I don't know why. But there is
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我读了那份文件。
奇怪的事情在这里... 我不知道为什么。但是那里

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
no retreat path in the area where the facility is located.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
该设施所在区域没有撤退路线。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm. Then all we have to do is get in there and block the only entrance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯。那我们只需要进去，堵住唯一的入口就行了？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
They might have installed a gate for teleport. We must disable it first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
他们可能安装了传送门。我们必须先将其瘫痪。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We must do it quickly, so that the enemy cannot take any countermeasures even if they recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们必须迅速行动，这样即使敌人察觉到了，也无法采取任何反制措施。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Leave it to us!
The Rebellion hasn't just been napping.
Then the rest here are all surplus manpower?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
交给我们吧！
反叛者可不是在睡觉。
那么，剩下的这些人都是多余的人力吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Did you say 'surplus'!?
Have you already forgotten who provided this information?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你说什么“多余”！？
你已经忘了是谁提供的情报吗？

scripts.text: ... The meeting is getting too long.
scripts.translation: ... 会议开得有点太长了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm ... It's boring, isn't it?
Things have been decided to some degree.
I won't be able to help you directly.
I'm here to watch Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯... 很无聊，不是吗？
事情已经大致决定了。
我无法直接帮你们。
我在这里是为了监视尼希尔。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What you have to concentrate on in this facility is the central room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
你们在这个设施中需要集中注意力的是中枢室。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
What you are looking for might be in the place called the ^4d4dffcentral room^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你们要找的东西可能在被称为^4d4dff中枢室^000000的地方。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I stepped in to ensure a safe, successful procedure. But actually, we had already provided you with everything we can.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我介入是为了确保程序安全、顺利。但实际上，我们已经把能提供的都提供给你们了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}, once the Rebellion occupies the laboratory, you have to rush to the central room faster than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}，一旦反叛者占领实验室，你必须比任何人都更快地冲向中枢室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
And there ... you will find it.
I have a strong feeling that it is here.
I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
在那里... 你会找到它的。
我有一种强烈的预感，它就在这里。
我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Now let's get going.
It will be dark soon.
It's the end of the week, so security might not be so tight.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
现在出发吧。
天快黑了。
今天是周末，安保可能不会那么严密。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
地点在^4d4dff艾音布罗克北方田野的一点钟方向行动点^000000。
在田野里，请与反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The exact ^4d4dffcoordinates of the operation spot are 280, 332^000000. The person in charge of the operation may be ... ^4d4dffJulian^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
行动点的精确^4d4dff坐标是280, 332^000000。负责这次行动的人可能是... ^4d4dff朱利安^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Go find Julian!
Of course I'm going too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
去找朱利安！
当然，我也会一起去。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
... 别忘了。
你必须到达中枢室，找到^4d4dff泰拉·格洛丽亚^000000。
祝你在战争中好运。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will take a chance and participate.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我会冒险参与进去的。
保重！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
... 别忘了。
你必须到达中枢室，找到^4d4dff泰拉·格洛丽亚^000000。
祝你在战争中好运。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
地点在^4d4dff艾音布罗克北方田野的一点钟方向行动点^000000。
在田野里，请与反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, it seems like everyone is here. Maybe I can step out?
From now on, Rookie, the heron emeritus agent, will handle it!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看来大家都到齐了。也许我可以退场了？
从现在开始，新人，这只退休的鹭鸟特工会接手处理的！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've done my job~
Now I'm counting on Rookie!
I'm on vacation from now on!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我的任务完成了~
接下来就指望你了，新人！
从现在起我要休假了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Most of the squadron will be standing by in the operation spot.
They will take a chance to start it, right?
I think they will get in when it gets dark ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大部分小队会在行动点待命。
他们会找机会发起进攻，对吧？
我想他们会在天黑时潜入...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's get there before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
趁还没太晚，我们赶紧过去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will be in the shade.
Oh~ I'm excited to use a sword after such a long time!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我会躲在阴影里。
啊~ 好久没拿剑了，真让人兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
地点在^4d4dff艾音布罗克北方田野的一点钟方向行动点^000000。
在田野里，请与反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... I really hate training ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
... 我真的讨厌训练...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^4d4dffJulian^000000 is the person in charge of the operation here.
Please go and ask him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff朱利安^000000是这里行动的负责人。
请去问问他。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
They are like rats in a trap. All we have to do is the cleanup~ I'm going in, too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们就像陷阱里的老鼠。我们要做的只是收尾工作~ 我也要去。

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 很好，我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's natural.
You haven't found that thing you were looking for yet.
I will let you go. Could you just find that thing?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这是理所当然的。
你还没找到你在找的那个东西。
我放你走。你能不能先找到那个东西？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As they occupied this place, they are remodeling some of the routes to make a training camp.
... Oh ... I hate it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们占领这里后，正在改造部分路线，把它变成训练营地。
... 噢... 我已经开始讨厌了。

scripts.text: Enter the military base.
scripts.translation: 进入军事基地

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 很好，我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh ... arg ...

[Rookie]
There are still come remnants inside the research facilities.
Actually ... they are more like monsters.
Anyway, take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
研究设施里还有一些残余势力。
实际上... 它们更像是魔物。
总之，保重。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The ^4d4dffcentral area^000000 seems to be located in this laboratory, ^4d4dffdeep inside the building's basement^000000.
Since we, the Rebellion, have completely occupied this place, please feel free to go there.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff中枢区域^000000似乎位于这个实验室，^4d4dff在建筑地下的深处^000000。
既然我们反叛者已经完全占领了这里，请随意前往。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Teleport?
They cannot use it.
We have blocked it.
Actually, it's something we had never thought of ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
瞬间移动？
他们无法使用。
我们把它封锁了。
实际上，这是我们从未想到的...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The man with shiny blonde hair told me to block magic related to movement as well.
Well, I know that the magic is more common in Rune Midgarts. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那个金发闪闪发光的男子让我把与移动相关的魔法也封锁了。
嗯，我知道在鲁恩米德加尔特，魔法是比较常见的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
After all, I hope you will find what you are looking for as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，希望你能尽快找到你在找的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I heard a loud sound inside the central room. I tried to get in there, but it had already been blocked.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我听到中枢室里传来巨大的声响。我试图进去，但那里已经被封锁了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Right. I was bounced out by an unknown force and could not defend the entrance until the end.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的。我被一股未知的力量弹了出来，没能守住入口直到最后。
我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... What on earth was it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
...那到底是什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
On my god ... Seyren Windsor?
And you've found it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
天哪...塞伦温莎？
而且你找到了它？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then we must go back quickly.
Our mission is completed.
Let's go back to the hotel first.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
那我们得快点回去。
我们的任务完成了。
先回旅馆吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yeah. The rest of it is our task.
There are still plenty of monster experimental subjects inside, but
That's what we have to contend with.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的。剩下的事是我们的任务。
里面还有很多魔物实验体，
但那是我们必须应对的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Damn, go away!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
该死，滚开！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, I hate it here.
I want to go back to our hidout soon.
Shall we get out of here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
噢，我讨厌这里。
我想尽快回到我们的据点。
我们要离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm, are you the type of person who looks for trouble?
Well, we appreciate it if you help us clean up the remnants.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，你是那种喜欢找麻烦的人吗？
好吧，如果你能帮我们清理这些残余势力，我们会很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那就跟我来吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Shall we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们现在离开吗？

scripts.text: About the monster in the central room
scripts.translation: 关于中枢室的魔物

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: About YSF01
scripts.translation: 关于YSF01

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那就跟我来吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Since this fuss is likely to continue for a while, we'd be glad if you would stay here and help us~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然这场骚乱可能会持续一段时间，如果你能留在这里帮助我们，我们将不胜感激~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why did Werner do that?
I don't understand.
... No. Maybe it's weird to understand a lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
维尔纳为什么要那样做？
我不明白。
...不。也许理解一个疯兔是很奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyways, We have to observe the central room's core.
As long as there are magic inside, the same thing will happen again.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
无论如何，我们必须观察中枢室的核心。
只要里面还有魔法，同样的事情就会再次发生。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome.
Without any further ado,
We would like to hunt the ^4d4dffpet child^000000 guy. Will you join us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎。
不废话了，
我们想猎杀那个^4d4dff小可爱^000000的家伙。你愿意加入我们吗？

scripts.text: I am the pet child hunter!
scripts.translation: 我是小可爱猎人！

scripts.text: Reject!
scripts.translation: 拒绝！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, why?
It's just a monster!
We just have to kill it!
Then who should we ask to do it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，为什么？
它只是一只魔物！
我们只需要杀掉它！
那我们应该找谁来做这件事呢？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's reveal its secret!
Let's find out why it keeps showing up!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我们揭开它的秘密！
让我们弄清楚它为什么一直出现！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's in the central room. The place full of strange spirits in the middle of the central room.
Let me open the door for you first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
它在中枢室。中枢室中央那个充满奇怪精灵的地方。
让我先为您打开门。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great! You're so cool!
Was it a replication of the former experimental subject? Self-replication?
They haven't found out the exact mechanism yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
太棒了！您真酷！
它是之前实验体的复制品吗？自我复制？
他们还没有发现确切的机制。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyhow, thank you for your support.
We will count on you again next time.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
无论如何，感谢您的支持。
下次我们还会依靠您。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The same monster is regenerated every single day. Isn't it a bit odd?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
同样的魔物每天都会再生。这不是很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Maybe this guy is one of the objects that were split by transplanting the hearts of Ymir ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
也许这家伙是那些通过移植Ymir的心脏而被分裂出来的物体之一...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyway, let's see if that guy shows up again.
It's so~ interesting.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，让我们看看这家伙是否还会再次出现。
这太~有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you call it a pet child?
Seems like they are completely leaving that guy to the adventurer
scripts.translation:
[新人]
您叫它小可爱？
看来他们完全把这家伙交给冒险者处理了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want, do not hesitate to tell me any time.
I will give you a mission to kill the pet child.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果您愿意，请随时告诉我。
我会给您一个猎杀小可爱的任务。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Do you want me to send you out of the operation zone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者队员]
您想让我把您送出行动区域吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Well, good luck.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者队员]
嗯，祝您好运。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... How many more facilities like this are there in Schwaltzvalt?
Haa ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...施瓦茨瓦尔特还有多少像这样的设施？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Fortunately, the letter seems to have arrived.
There is a reward that we prepared for you but we have not given it to you yet. So I sent this letter to invite you.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
幸运的是，信件似乎已经送达了。
我们为您准备了一份奖励，但还没有给您。所以我寄了这封信来邀请您。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And our president said that his excellency would grant you enough compensation if you continue to help us get rid of the unwanted experimental subjects.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
而且我们的总裁说，如果您继续帮助我们清除不需要的实验体，他的阁下会给您足够的补偿。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As you helped our republic, his excellency is trying to get you some useful stuff for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
既然您帮助了我们的共和国，他的阁下正试图为您弄一些对冒险者有用的东西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The ^4d4dffSchwartz Honor Token^000000 that I am about to give you is a sort of reward currency used in the Rebellion as well.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我即将给您的^4d4dff施瓦茨荣誉徽章^000000是一种在反叛者中使用的奖励货币。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since you are an adventurer, we thought it would be helpful for you.
You can exchange it for an item you need.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
既然您是一名冒险者，我们认为这对您会有帮助。
您可以用它交换您需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You may have received it already through the Rebellion.
Since this token is a prize for someone who did a job for Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
您可能已经通过反叛者获得过它了。
因为这种徽章是奖励给为施瓦茨瓦尔特办事的人的...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you want, you can receive them by continuing to help us.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
如果您愿意，可以通过继续帮助我们来获得它们。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So, we would like to give you simple requests or missions.
This kind of association is likely to continue for a while.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
所以，我们想给您一些简单的请求或任务。
这种合作关系可能会持续一段时间。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
提前感谢您的支持。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since there are still some researchers hiding inside the laboratory, we plan to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
由于实验室里仍有一些研究员在躲藏，我们计划进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Please take charge of the investigation.
If you do this for us, we will give you the Schwartz Honor Token.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
请负责调查。
如果您为我们做了这件事，我们将给您施瓦茨荣誉徽章。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Not now?
Then get some rest and come back please.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
现在不行吗？
那就休息一下，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since we don't know where they are hiding, start looking in corners such as cabinets and boxes.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
由于我们不知道他们躲在哪里，请从柜子、箱子等角落开始寻找。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After finding researchers, please hand them over to a Rebellion squad member near you.
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
找到研究员后，请把他们交给附近的反叛者小队成员。
提前感谢您的支持。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Inside the laboratory, there are still some researchers hiding somewhere.
Please find them and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
实验室里仍有一些研究员躲在某个地方。
请找到他们，并交给反叛者小队成员。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
提前感谢您的支持。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We already heard of your performance from the Rebellion.
Thank you for cooperating with the republic.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们已经从反叛者那里听到了您的表现。
感谢您与共和国的合作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding. But we will find them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们突然袭击了他们，预计还有更多人在躲藏。但我们迟早会找到他们的。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding.
We will try to find those guys for now.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们突然袭击了他们，预计还有更多人在躲藏。
我们现在会试着找到那些人。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If possible, I would ask you to investigate again.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
如果可能的话，我想请您再次调查。

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.......
Then we cannot afford it.
... No, no.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
......
那我们负担不起了。
...不，不。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You're so cool, as usual.
Then could you please find the dregs hiding deep inside the laboratory and shaking like leaves?
I mean, the researchers.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
您一如既往地很酷。
那么，请找到躲在实验室深处、像树叶一样发抖的渣滓。
我是说，那些研究员。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As usual, please find the researchers who are hiding and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
一如既往，请找到躲藏的研究员，并交给反叛者小队成员。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
No ... why did I volunteer for this?
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
不...我为什么要自愿做这个？

scripts.text: What's wrong with the Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 神枪手怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Gunslinger is a place made by the Rebellion to train the upcoming generation, so they have a close relationship.
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
神枪手是反叛者建立的地方，用来训练下一代，所以他们关系密切。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
I heard that there was special training with the Rebellion so I volunteered. And what am I doing now?
I never imagined that I would be sent to this laboratory full of monsters!
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
听说有反叛者的特别训练，我就报名了。结果现在我在干什么？
我从来没想过会被派到这个满是魔物的实验室！

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Arrrgh, especially Ms. Elena ... She makes us suffer ...
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
啊...尤其是埃琳娜女士...她让我们受尽了苦头...

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Inside the laboratory, there is pandemonium due to the experimental subjects that broke out.
Although we kill them, more of them come out from somewhere. I came out rest for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
实验室里因为实验体逃脱而一片混乱。
虽然我们在击杀它们，但不知从哪里又不断涌出来。我出来稍微休息一下。

scripts.text: Help him defeat Chimeras.
scripts.translation: 帮他击败凯美拉

scripts.text: Wish him good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝他好运

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Well ... Yeah. This is a part of training, too. Phew.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
嗯...是啊。这也是训练的一部分。呼。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Then, please kill 10 of each
^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras^000000 and
^4d4dffHuman type Chimeras^000000
wandering around in the laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
那么，请去消灭在实验室里游荡的
^4d4dff物质型凯美拉^000000和
^4d4dff人型凯美拉^000000
各10只！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Thanks to your support, we can pause for breath!
Cheer up, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
多亏了你的支援，我们可以喘口气了！
加油，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Just defeat 10 of each type. That's all I ask.
They are ^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras and Human type Chimeras.^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
只要击败各10只就行了。这是我唯一的请求。
它们是^4d4dff物质型凯美拉和人型凯美拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
... The In Vivo Experiment is really horrible.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
...活体实验真的非常可怕。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Wow, you did a great job for us!
Thank you.
Thanks to your support, we managed to get a good rest.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哇，你帮了我们大忙！
谢谢。
多亏你的支援，我们得以好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Please be with us next time!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
下次请继续和我们在一起！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Hey, thank you for your great job.
But there are still more monsters inside.
We are trying our best to get rid of them. But honestly, it's tough.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
嘿，谢谢你做得这么好。
但里面还有更多的魔物。
我们正在尽力清除它们。但说实话，这很难。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Where do all of these experimental subjects come from?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
这些实验体都是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
They come out continuously. I can't imagine how many experiments they conducted.
I mean, Chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
它们源源不断地出现。我无法想象他们进行了多少次实验。
我是说，凯美拉。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
I never imagined that Chimeras would be tougher than Heart Hunters ...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
我从来没想过凯美拉会比心之猎手更难对付...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't pick a fight with USU recklessly.
When people start fighting, I'll be the only one who feels annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不要鲁莽地与USU挑起争端。
一旦人们开始打架，只有我会感到厌烦。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Although I leashed them, they keep thinking about running out ...
Maybe their brains are filled with gunpowder. Silly weirdos.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
虽然我把他们拴住了，但他们一直想着要跑出去...
也许他们的脑子里装满了火药。一群愚蠢的怪人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Cookie? I don't like sweets.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
绿饼人？我不喜欢甜食。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Lebedev guys baked it...
Then, I have no choice but to taste it. Give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
列别捷夫那群人烤的...
那我别无选择，只能尝尝了。给我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why are you empty-handed? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...你两手空空？绿饼人呢？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
It smells good.
Seems like they gave a great effort. Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
闻起来不错。
看来他们很用心。替我谢谢他们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Wait, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
等等，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I haven't seen you before.
You can't be in this place. Strangers like you are not supposed to be here.
^FF0000>>>Snap<<<^000000
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我从未见过你。
你不该出现在这里。像你这样的陌生人，本不该踏入此地。
^FF0000>>>弓身弹影<<<^000000

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Tell me exactly how you got here and where you came from unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
除非你想死，否则告诉我你是怎么来到这里的，以及你从哪里来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am... You revealed you're an adventurer who came to help Secret Wings and requested cooperation to the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是...你曾表明自己是一名冒险者，前来协助秘密之翼，并向反叛者寻求合作。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Secret Wings? They are just rookies. All they do is suck up to the president.
You're so brave. Who told you to visit me?
I don't want to dance to chicks flapping their wings. Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
秘密之翼？他们只是一群新人。整天只会向总裁拍马屁。
你还真大胆。是谁让你来见我的？
我可不想被那些扇动翅膀的小丫头牵着鼻子走。滚开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, wait please. In fact, I... no, my companion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，请等一下。其实，我...不，是我的同伴...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Your companion saved Gonie?
...... So? You want a reward?
I really hate those who try to use other's lives as they please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你的同伴救了戈尼？
......所以呢？你想要奖励？
我真的很讨厌那些随意拿别人的生命当筹码的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well... I have a better idea.
Unlike the wimp chatting downstairs, you look quite interesting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...我有个更好的主意。
不像楼下那个只会瞎聊的胆小鬼，你看起来挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You said you were just an adventurer, didn't you?
Great. If you defeat me in a fight, I will listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你说你只是个冒险者，对吧？
很好。如果你能在战斗中击败我，我就听你说话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恕我直言？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Let's fight! I will listen to someone who fights me.
Talk to me when you are ready. Then I will let you enter the waiting room of the arena.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
让我们打一架吧！我会听与我交手之人的话。
当你准备好了，再来找我。届时我会让你进入竞技场的候场室。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I fight you all of a sudden? Well, I don't feel like...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
突然就要和我打架？嗯，我并没有那个意思...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you don't want to fight, I guess you don't need any cooperation. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果你不想打，看来你也不需要任何合作。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I'm in trouble. What shall I do?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我陷入困境了。该怎么办？）

scripts.text: Fight Elena.
scripts.translation: 与埃琳娜战斗

scripts.text: I don't listen to someone weaker than me.
scripts.translation: 我不听弱者说话

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I have no choice. Let's prepare for the fight and talk to Elena Volkova again.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（别无选择。准备战斗，再次与埃琳娜·沃尔科娃交谈。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't listen to someone weaker than m...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不听弱者说话...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm? I misheard something. Haha, could you repeat it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯？我好像听错了。哈哈，能请你再说一遍吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...我会做的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. Tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你准备好了吗？
我们现在去候场室吗？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候场室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候场室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
在候场室，有负责竞技场入场事务的^0000CD伊万^000000。
请按照伊万的指引，依序进入竞技场。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你有两分钟时间。如果你能在两分钟内击败我，你就赢了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果在战斗中你想投降，请告诉伊万旁边的^0000CD索丽塔^000000。
然后你就会受到斥责。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... By the way, are you really going to fight me?
I am an expert in killing people. And fighting is not your main occupation. You cannot beat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...顺便问一下，你真的要和我战斗吗？
我是杀人专家。而战斗并不是你的主业。你赢不了我的。

scripts.text: But I will fight.
scripts.translation: 但我还是要战斗

scripts.text: I agree with you. I give up.
scripts.translation: 我同意你的看法。我放弃

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. Knowing one's limit is wise.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。知难而退是明智的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're a cleric. Fighting is not your duty. I'm sure your companion also knows that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你是牧师。战斗不是你的职责。我相信你的同伴也明白这一点。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Besides, you're just an adventurer. You have no business with us and those guys either. I'm afraid you might get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
况且，你只是个冒险者。你和我们，以及那些人没有任何关系。恐怕你会受伤。

scripts.text: No, I will fight.
scripts.translation: 不，我要战斗

scripts.text: ...I think you're right. I give up.
scripts.translation: ...你说得对。我放弃

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. You don't have to get hurt yourself being nosy.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。多管闲事只会让自己受伤。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You must a fool who doesn't know what's going on.
Do you think I'm kidding? Or your life is too heavy and you'd like to put everything down?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你一定是个不知道发生了什么事的傻瓜。
你以为我在开玩笑吗？还是说你的命太沉重，你想放下这一切？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is the final warning. You stay out of this.
Tell the guy downstairs that you had no choice because I intimidated you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
这是最后的警告。你最好离这件事远点。
告诉楼下的那个人，说你别无选择，是因为我威胁了你。

scripts.text: This is my problem too.
scripts.translation: 这也是我的问题。

scripts.text: Since I don't want to die, I give up.
scripts.translation: 既然不想死，我就放弃吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Life is important, especially when it's mine.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。生命很重要，尤其是我的命。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why is this your problem?
That talkative guy is a stooge of the President. But you're an adventurer who can just leave.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...为什么这是你的问题？
那个话多的人是总统的走狗。但你只是个可以随意离开的冒险者。

scripts.text: This is the problem of those who trust me.
scripts.translation: 这是信任我的人的问题。

scripts.text: I guess I'd better go.
scripts.translation: 我想我还是走吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Enjoy your adventure in a safer place.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。去更安全的地方享受你的冒险吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, well, well.
Haha, you are so obstinate.
I like your spirit. You said you need a cooperation? Why not? I agree.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。
哈哈，你真是固执。
我喜欢你的精神。你说你需要合作？为什么不呢？我同意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Pardon?!

[USU commander Elena]
You said you needed my approval to persuade us. So I approve it.
I like spunky fellows. It's fun to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你说你需要我的批准来说服我们。所以我批准了。
我喜欢有冲劲的人。和他们战斗很有趣。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ah, don't misunderstand it. I'm not saying I will fight you. I'm saying that I will be on your side.
I didn't mean to fight you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
啊，别误会。我不是说我要和你战斗。我是说我会站在你这边。
我本来就没打算和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't mess with clerics. I don't feel good after fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不跟牧师打交道。和他们打完架我会感觉不好。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I'll support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
所以我会支持与秘密之翼的合作。你需要我的签名吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不需要。下次请在别人面前表明你的立场。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
No problem.
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
没问题。
既然你现在是我们的合作者，去四处看看有没有人有问题。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
谁知道呢？如果你一直帮助他们，他们可能会对你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
虽然我们从未忘记必须复仇的血债，但我们也不忘感恩。
如果你帮助他们，他们会给你一个证明你荣誉的信物。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
就像我现在给你的这个一样。
如果你想知道这是做什么用的，去楼梯下面问问那个叫“斯特拉瑟”的固执家伙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation between the Secret Wings and Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我战斗吗？
你不是来这里请求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你要放弃战斗吗？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放弃战斗

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，继续战斗

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。我会在这里等你。
等你准备好战斗时再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
一个害怕我的胆小鬼，对反叛者没有任何帮助。
滚开。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Hmm. So this is it.
If you want to fight me again, I will give you another chance.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
... 嗯。原来如此。
如果你想再和我打一次，我会再给你一次机会。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 进入候场室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不进入候场室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. You have guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender during a fight, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。你很有胆量。
伊万会带你进去。
如果在战斗中想投降，就告诉索丽塔。
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation with the Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我战斗吗？
你不是来这里请求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你要放弃战斗吗？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放弃战斗

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，继续战斗

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。我会在这里等你。
等你准备好战斗时再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
一个害怕我的胆小鬼，对反叛者没有任何帮助。
滚开。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! I lost.
My feeling was right. It was such a thrilling fight after a long time!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈！我输了。
我的直觉没错。真是久违的酣畅淋漓的战斗！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I promised, I will listen to you. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如我所承诺的，我会听你说。请讲。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So she's listening to me now. Persuading her will be much more difficult.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她现在愿意听我说话了。想要说服她恐怕会更难。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I have come to request a cooperation between the Secret Wings and the Rebellion.
In order to persuade the people of Rebellions, I would like to ask you for help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我来请求秘密之翼与反叛者之间的合作。
为了说服反叛者的人，我想请你帮个忙...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Okay. I will help you.
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好的。我会帮你的。
我该做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon? You haven't heard my story yet...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉？你还没听我讲完故事呢...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You don't have to tell me the story. You've already told me the story physically. If I can fight on the same side with you, I will welcome whatever it is.
So I support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你不必告诉我故事。你已经用拳头告诉我了。如果我能和你并肩作战，无论是什么我都欢迎。
所以我支持与秘密之翼的合作。需要我签字吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不需要。下次请在别人面前表明你的立场。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. ...... By the way,
If you have time, visit the arena any time.
I will fight you even if you come every day.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。...... 顺便说一下，
如果你有时间，随时可以来竞技场。
即使你每天都来，我也愿意和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
既然你现在是我们的合作者了，去四处看看，有没有谁遇到了麻烦。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
谁知道呢？如果你一直帮助他们，他们可能会对你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
虽然我们从未忘记必须复仇的血债，但我们也不忘感恩。
如果你帮助他们，他们会给你一个证明你荣誉的信物。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
就像我现在给你的这个一样。
如果你想知道这是做什么用的，去楼梯下面问问那个叫“斯特拉瑟”的固执家伙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
Have you met our members?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗨。怎么了？
你见过我们的成员了吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
A fight? Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗨。怎么了？
打架？欢迎！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
Are you sure you have to fight me now?
If you really think so, come back tomorrow. I called it a day now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。
你确定现在就要和我打吗？
如果你真的这么想，明天再来吧。我今天已经收工了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
No. Not now.
I would like to fight you when you are in the top condition. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。
不。不是现在。
我想在你状态最好的时候和你打。明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, great!
Tell me when you are fully ready. I will go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哦，太好了！
等你完全准备好了告诉我。我会去休息室等着。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm...?
I told you. I don't fight clerics.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...？
我告诉过你。我不打牧师。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would like to fight you! Please allow me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想和你打！请允许我！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, every time I beat the hell out of a cleric, I become quite unlucky on that day. It's true.
So I'd rather not fight a cleric...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哦，每次我把牧师打得落花流水，那天就会变得很不走运。这是真的。
所以我宁愿不打牧师...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
............

[USU commander Elena]
...Huh, look at your eyes. I have no choice but to fight you.
But I will ^0000CDgo very easy on^000000 you. Don't make drama after you defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
... 呵，看看你的眼神。我别无选择，只能和你打了。
但我^0000CD会手下留情的^000000。别在我输给你之后搞什么戏剧性的一出。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你准备好了吗？
我们现在去候场室吗？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候场室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候场室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
在候场室，有负责竞技场入场事务的^0000CD伊万^000000。
请按照伊万的指引，依序进入竞技场。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你有两分钟时间。如果你能在两分钟内击败我，你就赢了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果在战斗中你想投降，请告诉伊万旁边的^0000CD索丽塔^000000。
然后你就会受到斥责。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我打吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你要放弃战斗吗？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放弃战斗

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，继续战斗

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好，我会等着的。
我很享受和你战斗。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, you don't have to do this... You're so persistent.
Well, I remember I told you that I like it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我告诉过你，你不必这样做的... 你真是执着。
好吧，我记得我说过我喜欢这样。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...You made me expect it. And what are you doing now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
... 你让我期待了。那你现在在做什么？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good idea. You'll be quite sad if you are beat up without having done anything wrong. Won't you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好主意。如果你没做错事却被揍了一顿，肯定会很难过吧？不是吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't you think you've had enough of it by now? If you want to quit, tell me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你觉得你受够了吗？如果你想退出，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Hmm. You're not in a top condition?
If you want to do this again, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
... 嗯。你状态不好？
如果你想再试一次，欢迎。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 进入候场室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不进入候场室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ho, you have the guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
呵，你有胆量。
伊万会带你进去。
如果你想投降，告诉索丽塔。
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I like it.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我喜欢。
伊万会带你进去。
如果你想投降，告诉索丽塔。
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition? Go inside and take some rest.
Shall we stop?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你状态不好？进去休息一下吧。
我们要停止吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition?
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你状态不好？
照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
别让我为你感到难过。

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放弃战斗

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，继续战斗

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hey, you don't have to do this...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嘿，你不必这样做的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好，我会等着的。
我很享受和你战斗。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Right. Let's stop the fight.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好吧。我们停止战斗。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...We have no choice. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...我们别无选择。稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I told you that I'd ^0000CDgo easy on you^000000. Although won the fight, you didn't actually win it. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我说过会^0000CD手下留情^000000的。虽然你赢了这场战斗，但实际上你并没有赢。明白吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Being mean is not my character. This is why I don't want to be entangled with clerics...
Hey, pronounce the benediction for me before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...刻薄不是我的性格。这就是为什么我不想和牧师纠缠不清...
嘿，离开前给我施个祝福吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hahaha, great fight!
What a pity. I wanted to win today...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，精彩的战斗！
真可惜。我今天本想赢的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm glad that you are becoming stronger.
I can see the result of steady training.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很高兴看到你变得更强了。
我能看出你刻苦训练的成果。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Come back. I can fight you everyday.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
回来吧。我随时都可以和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good.
Enjoy it while you can.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那很好。
趁现在好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good news.
Apart from fighting... I would like to ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那是好消息。
除了战斗...我想请你帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm not sure if I can say this to an outsider... But you are close to the Rebellion now.
Will you keep the secret?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不确定能不能对外人说出这些...但你现在和反叛者很亲近。
你会保守秘密吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意。

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 这会很困难。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Then I can't tell you.
Forget what I've said.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...那我不能告诉你。
忘掉我刚才说的话。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Yes. Make sure you keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
是的。务必保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. First of all... do you know about USU that I am commanding?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。首先...你知道我指挥的USU吗？

scripts.text: Superior... unit?
scripts.translation: 超级...单位？

scripts.text: Isn't it where you isolated problem children?
scripts.translation: 不是用来隔离问题儿童的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... No. It's not true.
It's actually the opposite.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...不。那不是真的。
实际上恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... What?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...什么？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha... Kaka. Right. You know very well about it.
But don't say that in front of the troops. They might shoot you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈...卡卡。没错。你很清楚那是怎么回事。
但别在部队面前这么说。他们可能会开枪打你。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
USU stands for ^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000. It's a group of weirdos who did some crazy things.
Since they had done great job for the Rebellion, we isolate them with lead on their neck rather than death penalty or discharging.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
USU代表^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000。这是一群做过疯狂事情的怪人。
因为他们为反叛者立下过汗马功劳，所以我们没有处死或开除他们，而是让他们戴着铅项圈被隔离起来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, it's a unit outside our regulation. So I can't tell you about it in detail. But we do several things that Rebellions don't do.
You can imagine all you want, including murder or violence. It will be worse than that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
正如我所说的，这是一个不受常规管辖的单位。所以我不能详细告诉你。但我们做了一些反叛者不做的事情。
你可以随意想象，包括谋杀或暴力。实际情况会比那更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But we still have a absolute rule. We don't mess up with other Rebellions.
Although we let them do whatever they want outside, we teach them who's holding their lead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
但我们有一条绝对规则。我们不会去招惹其他反叛者。
虽然我们在外面允许他们为所欲为，但我们教会他们是谁在掌控着他们的铅项圈。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And there are new members... ^0000CDJana Levedeva^000000 and ^0000CDIlya Lebedev^000000. They are twins and still young.
Although they are young, their ability is outstanding. The problem is that they are out of control.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
还有新成员... ^0000CD雅娜·列别杰娃^000000和^0000CD伊利亚·列别捷夫^000000。他们是双胞胎，而且年纪还小。
虽然年幼，但他们的能力非常出色。问题在于他们无法控制自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
They skip the training and hurt a squadder by causing an accident during training... Recently, they tried to run away from the unit and got caught. So the duty manager and I had a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他们逃课，还在训练中制造事故伤害了一名斯夸德... 最近，他们试图逃离单位被抓了回来。这让值班管理员和我都很头疼。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
According to the regulation, we have to discharge them.
... But they are still under age. According to the commander of their former unit, they don't have parents.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
根据规定，我们必须开除他们。
...但他们还未成年。据他们原单位的指挥官说，他们没有父母。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If we kick out these guys, they might become hooligans. At the worst, they will be involved in crime.
It sounds funny that I'm saying this as a commander of USU...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果我们把这些家伙赶出去，他们可能会变成流氓。最坏的情况是，他们会卷入犯罪。
作为USU的指挥官，我说这话听起来可能有点讽刺...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
At least I don't want to see kids disgracing themselves.
But by looking at what they are doing, they will live as animals with lead in USU at best.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
至少我不想看到孩子们自暴自弃。
但看他们的所作所为，在USU里戴着铅项圈像野兽一样生活，已经是最好的结果了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Maybe they are already regarding me as an enemy. So they won't listen to me.
I know how to make them listen to me. But it will only make the situation worse.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...也许他们已经把我视为敌人了。所以他们不听我的。
我知道怎么让他们听话。但那只会让情况变得更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I request you to check their problem and solve it, adventurer.
If they don't say anything, ask other fellows around them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
所以，我请求你去调查他们的问题并解决它，冒险者。
如果他们什么都不说，就去问问他们周围的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't want to demand you to do this.
It's a problem inside our unit. So we'd better handle ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不想强迫你这样做。
这是我们单位内部的问题。所以我们最好自己处理。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Forget what I told you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
忘掉我告诉你的事吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Thanks.
^0000CDYana and Ilya twins^000000 are in the lobby.
They have bright silver hairs and they're always together. You'll find them easily.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
谢谢。
^0000CD雅娜和伊利亚双胞胎^000000在大厅里。
他们有着亮银色的头发，而且总是形影不离。你很容易就能找到他们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In case you don't get any outcome after talking to them, talk to other fellows.
The mess personnel... and another fellow in the outside store seems to want to say something.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果你和他们交谈后没有任何结果，就去问问其他人。
食堂的工作人员...还有外面商店里的另一个人似乎想说什么。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, you talked to them?
Hmm, not yet...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
那么，你跟他们谈过了吗？
嗯，还没...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You are the only one I can trust now.
I'll count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
现在你是唯一我能信任的人。
我就指望你了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Did you talk to them?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你跟他们谈过了吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you cannot judge it easily, you can talk to ^0000CDother fellows around them^000000.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果你无法轻易判断，可以去问问^0000CD他们周围的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, how is it going?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
那么，进展如何？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... Not at all?
I though they might open their mind to a stranger. But I was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...完全不行吗？
我以为他们或许会对陌生人敞开心扉。但我错了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...There's someone you should talk to lastly.
I didn't want to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...最后还有一个人你需要去谈谈。
我并不想这样做。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Go downstairs and find ^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000. He must be nearby the fireplace.
He's middle-aged man... and a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
去楼下找^0000CD埃里克松·阿德勒，他是分队的指挥官^000000。他应该在壁炉附近。
他是个中年男子...也是双胞胎的前上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since the guys have been assigned to my unit, I wanted to take care of them here. But they're not helping us.
If I ask Adler about the guys, it won't look so good. That's why I am requesting you. Please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
既然那家伙被分配到了我的部队，我想在这里照顾好他们。但他们并没有帮助我们。
如果我直接问阿德勒关于那家伙的事，情况会显得很不妙。所以我才请求你帮忙。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000 must be nearby the fireplace.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
^0000CD埃里克松·阿德勒，分队的指挥官^000000应该在壁炉附近。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
He's a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他是双胞胎的前上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
How's it going on now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
现在情况怎么样了？

scripts.text: You told Elena Volkova what Lebedev twins told you.
scripts.translation: 你告诉了埃琳娜·沃尔科娃列别捷夫双胞胎告诉你的话。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So... That was the reason.
I had already heard about that accident.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
原来...那是原因。
我已经听说过那次事故了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But I had no idea they were feeling such a burden.
Since they were out of control... there was no way for me to recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
但我没想到他们会背负这么大的压力。
因为他们当时失控了...我没有办法察觉到这一点。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, they're still kids after all. Since they have great ability, Me and other squadders treated them as adults.
We should not have done it...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好吧，毕竟他们还只是孩子。因为他们很有天赋，我和其他斯夸德队员就把他们当作大人对待了。
我们不该那样做的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And I should have talked to Adler beforehand.
Thanks, {0}. You helped me so much.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
而且我应该事先和阿德勒谈谈的。
谢谢你，{0}。你帮了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I guess I have to tell them something anyway.
Will you help me once again? Tell them that I'm looking for them. And you come with them please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我想我无论如何都得跟他们说点什么。
你能再帮一次忙吗？告诉他们我在找他们。请和他们一起回来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
The twins will be nearby the place where they've always been.
Tell them about me and come back with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
双胞胎应该在他们常待的地方附近。
告诉他们我的情况，然后带他们回来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So you're all here? I've heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们都在吗？我已经听说了整件事的经过。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
是的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Yes...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
......是的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev! Attention!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列别杰娃和伊利亚·列别捷夫！立正！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you insane? You ran away from the unit for a private reason. And you hurt your companion!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们疯了吗？为了私事擅自离开部队。还伤害了你们的同伴！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This may look like a mercenary group like a piece of garbage. But we deal with people's life. We have disciplines that you must abide by.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
这看起来可能像是一群像垃圾一样的佣兵。但我们处理的是人们的生命。我们有你们必须遵守的纪律。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
......

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......We're sorry...
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
......对不起...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But before I scold you about it...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
但在责备你们之前...
我要先道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I didn't know that you had been forced so much and could not consider it. And I wasn't there for counseling even though I was your boss.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不知道你们承受了这么大的压力，以至于无法考虑周全。而且，尽管我是你们的上级，却没有在你们需要时提供咨询。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is totally my fault and my mistake.
I apologize. You had a rough time of it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
这完全是我的责任和错误。
我很抱歉。你们经历了一段艰难的时光。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......No, no... We have to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
......不，不... 是我们该道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
From now on, I will pay more attention to you.
Would you please try to make sure this never happens again?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
从现在开始，我会更加关注你们。
请你们也试着确保这种情况不再发生，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...No... We are the ones who should apologize.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...不... 是我们该道歉。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It will never happen again...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
这种事绝不会再发生了...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since this is a military group, you have regulations to abide by.
But since you are minors, I would like to give you an opportunity to grow as much as possible.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
既然这是一个军事团体，你们必须遵守规章制度。
但考虑到你们还是未成年人，我希望给你们一个尽可能成长的机会。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev. I will exclude you from the real fight for some time.
Instead, feel free to do the works that you can do inside the unit.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列别杰娃和伊利亚·列别捷夫。我会暂时将你们排除在实际战斗之外。
相反，请随意在部队内部做你们能做的事情。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You can make new friends, start a hobby or enhance your shooting ability. You can even do things that I cannot expect.
Do what you want to do. Make sure you abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们可以结交新朋友，培养爱好，或者提升射击能力。甚至可以做我意想不到的事情。
做你们想做的事，但务必遵守规章制度。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
So we're... not being kicked out?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
所以... 我们不会被开除吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me say it twice. I told you I was responsible for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
别让我说第二遍。我告诉过你们，我对发生的事负责。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Oh... Thank you so much!
And... Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
哦... 太感谢您了！
还有... 对不起。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Thank you, commander...!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
谢谢您，指挥官...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
That's all about it. You can go back now. There's something I'd like to discuss with the adventurer.
And if you need anything, talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
事情就是这样。你们可以回去了。我有件事想和冒险者谈谈。
如果你们需要任何帮助，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
是！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Phew...
Great job, {0}.
Thanks to your support and concern, we managed to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
呼...
干得好，{0}。
多亏了您的支持和关心，我们才能做到这一点。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ha... I told them to do what they want. And they will wonder what to do for a while.
For those guys to do what they want, they'll need your help again.
Please help them at that time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈... 我让他们做想做的事。他们可能会有一段时间不知道该做什么。
对于那两个孩子来说，要做想做的事，还需要您的帮助。
到时候请帮帮他们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
......Thanks.
I will count on you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
......谢谢。
今后就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you taking care of them well?
Wow, I am relieved that they have a babysitter now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你照顾他们得不错嘛？
哇，既然有人当保姆，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! Just kidding. Thank you for your support. You're so reliable.
Take care of the guys please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈！开玩笑的。感谢你的支持，你真可靠。
请好好照顾那群家伙。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What is it now?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索里塔]
怎么又怎么了？

scripts.text: I want to go out.
scripts.translation: 我想出去。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Do not talk to me when you have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索里塔]
没事别跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What are you talking about? So you're telling me you would like to run away without fighting? Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索里塔]
你在说什么？你是想不战而逃吗？不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
You must be kidding. What kind of nonsense is this! Why did you come here in the first place and annoy me?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索里塔]
你开什么玩笑。这是什么胡话！你一开始来这里就是为了烦我吗？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Dang, I have been quite upset after the commander gave me this useless work. And you make me even more upset. Get the hell out of here!
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索里塔]
该死，指挥官给我派了这种没用的工作，我已经够烦了。你还让我更烦。滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你迷路了，去楼下问问别人。
他们会告诉你怎么出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to the others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你迷路了，去楼下问问其他人。
他们会告诉你怎么出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hey, you two there!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
嘿，你们两个！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes!!! Yep!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
是！！！好的！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Escort this adventurer safely downstairs.
Seems like he has lost his way.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
把这个冒险者安全地送到楼下。
看来他迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes! I will!!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
是！我会的！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
And if by any chance...... Well, I guess you already know that part. I will hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果万一...... 嗯，我想你已经知道那部分了。我会把它交给你。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Oh.. Yes Sir!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
哦.. 遵命，长官！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
请跟我来，这边。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!

[Rebellion leader]
Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
还有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Tell the leader about having saved Gonie.
scripts.translation: 告诉首领你救了戈尼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Oh!
I see!
Thank you so much for helping our youngster.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哦！
我明白了！
非常感谢你帮助我们的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hmm.. As I expected......
Gonie......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
嗯...果然不出所料......
戈尼......

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The one who went to Einbroch not long ago......
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
就是不久前去了艾音布罗克的那个人......

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ah!
That guy?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
啊！
那个人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Haha!
This fellow is full of chivalry! It's difficult to find people like this nowadays.
Normally they just pass by......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哈哈！
这家伙真是充满侠义精神！现在像这样的人很难找了。
通常他们只会路过......

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Especially after finding that he was wearing a Rebellion suit.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
尤其是发现他穿着反叛者的制服后。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
By looking at your eyes, I see you haven't come to hear gratitude from us.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
看着你的眼睛，我知道你来这里不是为了听我们的感谢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
The man called Lazy who came with you...
He's been wandering around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
和你一起来的那个叫懒散的家伙...
他一直在这一带徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You helped Gonie by chance. But you didn't come here by chance. Did you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你救戈尼是出于偶然。但你来这里绝不是偶然的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You'd better think twice before you answer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
回答之前最好三思。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Be careful on your way home.
The public order is not so good in this area.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
回家路上小心。
这一带治安不太好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Help?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
帮助？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ha...
I think you are misunderstanding something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哈...
我想你误会了什么。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Surely, I want to express my gratitude for what you did for Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
当然，我想对你为戈尼所做的一切表示感谢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
But!
What you are saying now is a totally different issue.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
但是！
你现在说的是完全不同的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
秘密之翼？
哈！别让我笑！
你现在提这个，说明你知道我们和他们之间的关系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你不这么做，那就意味着你只是在被利用。既然如此，你就该识趣地离开了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
这就是我能告诉你的全部了。
请现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
请跟我来，这边。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Leave the adventurer alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
别管那个冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
He must know his position better than anyone else.
The man called Lazy, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
他肯定比任何人都清楚自己的处境。
那个叫“懒散”的家伙也是。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
秘密之翼？
哈！别让我笑！
你现在提这个，说明你知道我们和他们之间的关系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你不这么做，那就意味着你只是在被利用。既然如此，你就该识趣地离开了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
这就是我能告诉你的全部了。
请现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What is it?
Are you still here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么事？
你还在这里？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
If I didn't see a ghost, you are living a pretty long life. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
如果我没看错的话，你活得可真够长的。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Guard leader!
Good that you're here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊！
卫队长！
你来得正好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Take this fellow out, now.
I thought you would leave on your own, if you cared for your life. But you are still hanging around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
现在就把这家伙带走。
我以为你要是惜命的话，早就自己走了。没想到你还赖在这里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's so annoying to see this rat wandering around in my space.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
看到这只老鼠在我的地盘上乱窜，真是令人厌烦。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
There's something more important now. Here's a letter from Dien.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
现在有更重要的事情。这是迪恩寄来的信件。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
A letter from Dien?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
迪恩的信件？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes. Here it is...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是的。给您...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's quite unusual to receive a letter from her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
收到她的信，还真是稀罕事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me see... I agree. Do you agree, too?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
让我看看...我同意。你也同意吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm?
Agree with what?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯？
同意什么？

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm..........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯..........

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长...
我想我刚才看到了幽灵。你想看看这封信吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊？
是的！大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm.........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯.........

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长...
我想我刚才看到了幽灵。你想看看这封信吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊？
是的！大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
The commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么？
指挥官？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What the hell... Is that jerk still alive after sending this letter to the commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
该死……那个混蛋给指挥官寄了信之后居然还活着？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What did the commander say?
He is not the type of a man who would just sit down after listening to it. Is he?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
指挥官说了什么？
他可不是那种听了之后就会坐视不管的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Erst agrees with it, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
厄斯特也同意这个看法。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ha!
This is nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
哈！
真是胡扯。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我无法接受。
我不知道你对他们做了什么。但我还要再跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
迪恩在哪里？
在房间里吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你不用进来，鲁伯特。
外面太吵了，所以我出来了。原来是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我无法接受。
我不知道你对他们做了什么。但我还要再跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
迪恩在哪里？
在房间里吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你不用进来，鲁伯特。
外面太吵了，所以我出来了。原来是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
What are you doing!
Escort Dien to the room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
你在干什么！
把迪恩护送回房间。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You and I just do not appear to communicate.
I didn't know you were so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
看来我们俩就是没法好好沟通。
没想到你竟然这么固执……

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's all because of you, Dien.
I still remember you telling me a story about them. You were so angry with them. Now you make this choice.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
都是因为你，迪恩。
我还记得你跟我讲过关于他们的事。当时你对他们那么生气。现在你却做出了这样的选择。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
As you put on years, your memory and judgment are not as good as they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
随着年岁增长，你的记忆和判断力都不如从前了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What!
What have you just said!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
什么！
你刚才说了什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
At that time, you were just an infant in diapers. How do you happen to know so much about them?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
那时候你还只是个穿尿布的婴儿。你怎么会对他们的事这么清楚？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Did you experience that incident yourself?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
难道你亲身经历过那场变故？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm the one who saved your life during the ravage of war.
And just look at your big mouth now!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
是我在战乱中救了你一命。
看看你现在这副嘴脸！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Is it the way I taught you?
Come on, say that again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
是我教你的吗？
来，再重复一遍！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
What the hell are you doing!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊……！！
你在干什么！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Just release your hold.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
放开手。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien! Please calm down!
You shouldn't do this here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
迪恩！请冷静一下！
你不该在这里这么做！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You just shut up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你给我闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
哈……

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Whatever you say, I'm against it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
不管你说什么，我都反对！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You are still chattering with the big mouth!
Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你这张大嘴还在喋喋不休！
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
Come on, it hurts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊……！！
喂，很痛！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What are you doing! They are all looking at you!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你在干什么！大家都在看着你！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Well, I don't care who's looking at me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哼，我才不在乎谁在看我。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What have you done so far with that vengeance alone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你光靠复仇，到现在为止做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Are you going to hate them forever, doing nothing until I die?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
难道你要一直恨他们，什么都不做，直到我死为止吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
How many years do you think I have ahead!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你觉得我还能活多少年！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
By looking at you now, I'm sure you can live for 100 more years!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
看你现在的样子，我敢肯定你还能再活100年！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Great!
Let me live for 100 more years and pull out your beard!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
太好了！
让我再活100年，把你的胡子拔光！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrgh!!!!
Stop it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊……！！
住手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Okay! I got it!
Do as you wish!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊！
好！我知道了！
随你便！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
But you will to have to face the consequences. Be prepared!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
但你必须承担后果。做好准备！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That's exactly what I was hoping for.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
这正是我所希望的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
No...
Guard leader!
Tell each senior and commander to gather now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
不……
卫队长！
通知所有前辈和指挥官，立刻集合。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
让我说清楚。
我们会帮你。但别指望得到太多帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们没有理由为你做出牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Hey! You are saying this again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
嘿！你又说这种话了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since you got the approval from Rupert, {0} why don't you go back for report?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
既然鲁伯特已经批准了，{0}，你回去汇报一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
It seems like the youngsters will be busy for a while. Please help the old people, whenever you have time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
看来年轻人们要忙一阵子了。有空的时候，请多关照我们这些老人家。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ah!! Rupert!
Talk to me before the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
啊！鲁伯特！
开会前跟我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
让我说清楚。
我们会帮你。但别指望得到太多帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们没有理由为你做出牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I read it, too. What you have said just now was written there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
我也读了。你刚才说的话，信里都写了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
The same thing was written in the letter that I handed to Erst.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
我交给厄斯特的那封信里，写的也是同样的内容。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien!
It's dangerous outside. There are outsiders there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
迪恩！
外面很危险。有外人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's alright. Larcis.
They are not so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
没事的，拉西斯。
他们没那么危险。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Dien!
I was about to visit you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
迪恩！
我正要去找你。
