scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Your letter... What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你的信……这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
As written in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
正如信中所写。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Are you saying that you agreed to help the Secret Wings?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你是说，你同意帮助秘密之翼了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Yes.
As I wrote in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
是的。
正如我在信里写的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ridsh, Cotnes and I will agree to help the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
里德什、科特内斯和我，都同意帮助秘密之翼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Even Ridsh and Cotnes...? No. I can't believe that you agree to it, even after I have heard it from you personally.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
连里德什和科特内斯都……？不。即使是我亲自听你这么说，我也无法相信你们会同意。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I heard Erst agrees as well.
Since there are so many people who agree to it, you should not resist it alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我听说厄斯特也同意了。
既然有这么多人都同意，你不应该独自抗拒。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I can't laugh it off this time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
这次我没法一笑置之了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
You are the one who knows how silly this is more than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你是最清楚这件事有多愚蠢的人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Of course I do.
That's why I accepted it.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我当然知道。
所以我才接受了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Why!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
为什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
The time is passing. Rupert.
We cannot stick on the same spot forever.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
时间不等人，鲁伯特。
我们不能永远停滞不前。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Although the time passes, it doesn't mean that the past goes away!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
虽然时间流逝，但这并不意味着过去就会消失！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
We sacrificed too much to forget it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们为了遗忘它，付出了太多的代价！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Regarding this issue, I, as the person in charge here, will decide on it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
关于这件事，作为这里的负责人，我会做出决定。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Trying to respect you as a senior, I have overlooked your behavior so far. However, this time, you crossed the line.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
出于对前辈的尊重，我此前一直容忍你的行为。但是这次，你越界了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Now! Please go back to your room and enjoy your tea party.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
现在！请回你的房间去享受你的茶会吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
等等！
我无法忽视你刚才说的话。
你是想无视我的意见，甚至无视我这个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
等等！
我无法忽视你刚才说的话。
你是想无视我的意见，甚至无视我这个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
I joined the Rebellion, because their shooting looked so cool to me. But now I am so busy handling the documents that I have no time to get my hands on a gun.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
我加入反叛者，是因为他们的射击看起来很酷。但现在我忙着处理文件，根本没时间拿枪。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The problem is that I feel like this work suits me.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
问题是，我觉得这份工作很适合我。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
When I'm lucky, I can get some snacks from seniors.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
运气好的时候，还能从前辈那里得到一些零食。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
It's amazing that the taste is different when I purchase the snacks myself.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
真神奇，自己买零食吃，味道竟然不一样。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你这里怎么有这么多东西？背包得轻一点，才能装下更多新东西。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你这里怎么有这么多东西？背包得轻一点，才能装下更多新东西。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh~ It's wonderful here. It's so cozy. ^0000cdWhat is this place for^000000? I want to stay here for a day.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦~这里真不错。好温馨。^0000cd这是做什么的地方^000000？我想在这里待上一天。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never imagined there would be a place like this behind the store... What's this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我从没想过商店后面会有这样的地方...这是什么？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
A sanatorium that looks after novices and senior citizens. There is nothing to see here. And it's too cold in here and your mouth might be twisted if you sleep here. That's why you'd better leave after drinking the tea.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
这是一个照顾初心者和高龄市民的疗养院。这里没什么好看的。而且这里太冷了，睡在这里可能会嘴歪。所以喝完茶最好就离开。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are too stingy. How can you do this to me after I saved his life?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你也太吝啬了。我救了他的命，你怎能这样对我？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I gave you a cup of tea and I promised you to compensate. What else do you need?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我给了你一杯茶，并承诺会补偿你。你还想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
There are things you cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
有些东西是买不到的。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Well, then, you're leaving me with my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
好吧，那你只能让我带着这份感激之情了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No. According to my experience so far, everything that I cannot buy is useless.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不。根据我过去的经验，凡是买不到的东西都是没用的。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I can't figure out what you want. Have a sit there anyway. I will give you a cup of tea that you desired.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我搞不懂你到底想要什么。反正先坐那儿吧。我会给你泡一杯你渴望的茶。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Lucky~~~ Where have you been!! I've been waiting for a while! I'm going out for a mission and wish me a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
拉基~~~ 你去哪儿了！！我都等好一会儿了！我要去执行任务了，祝我好运。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Rookie!!!! Help me arrange the warehouse quickly. There are bunch of them and I can't do it alone. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
新人！！快帮我整理仓库。东西太多了，我一个人忙不过来。快点。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Hey, I came before you. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
嘿，我比你先到。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I'm in a hurry!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但我赶时间！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I have a customer. I will get to you after giving them cups of tea. Both of you, please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我有位顾客。等我把茶给他们泡好就回来。你们两个，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm in a hurry...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我赶时间...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I can wait! I cannot put pressure on Lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我可以等！我不能给拉基压力。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I can wait too!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我也能等！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
They are looking for you everywhere. You are so popular. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他们到处都在找你。你人气很高嘛。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie, where have you been? Everyone's looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
新人，你去哪儿了？大家都在找你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
He has healthy legs, so he can go around.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
他腿脚健康，所以能到处跑。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, bring a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，泡杯茶来。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, they are strangers. Who are they?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，他们是陌生人。他们是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
They saved Gonie's life. They came to this quiet Einbech. They found injured Gonie ^0000cdaccidentally^000000 and healed him. Then they brought him ^0000cdright^000000 here.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他们救了戈尼的命。他们来到这个安静的艾音贝赫。他们^0000cd偶然^000000发现了受伤的戈尼并治好了他。然后把他^0000cd正好^000000带到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes. I did it. I did it!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是的。是我做的。是我做的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You take too much credit to yourself after helping someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
帮了人之后，你未免太爱居功了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You have to exaggerate your performance. That's the way to be appreciated by others.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你得夸大自己的表现。这样才能得到别人的赞赏。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
So, why did you come here? By the way, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
那么，你们为什么来这里？顺便问一下，你们是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Me? Lazy. Although it's not my real name, call me Lazy now.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我？懒散。虽然这不是我的真名，但现在请叫我懒散。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I am an, ^0000cdagent of Secret Wings^000000, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我是^0000cd秘密之翼^000000的特工，该机构直接隶属于施瓦茨瓦尔特总统。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! Why did you tell them who you are all of a sudden? You kept telling me not even to mention it. And you revealed it officially!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿！你怎么突然告诉他们你是谁了？你一直叮嘱我连提都不要提，结果你竟然正式暴露了身份！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's all right. This is our destination. ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000, the stronghold of Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没关系。这里就是我们的目的地。^0000cd夜巡者转职考试地点^000000，反叛者的据点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then the store outside the door was a ^0000cdtrickery^000000. The collapsed man is a member of ^0000cdRebellion^000000... That's why...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，门外的那个商店就是个^0000cd幌子^000000。那个倒下的男人是^0000cd反叛者^000000的成员...原来如此...

scripts.text: Clank.
scripts.translation: 咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Get out of here now!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
现在立刻滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We get rid of them!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们解决掉他们！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Hey, calm down please! Put your guns in! No wonder you are hot headed elders!!
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
嘿，请冷静点！把枪收起来！难怪你们这些长老脾气这么火爆！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Although they have come here with a fishy purpose, it's true that they carried injured Gonie all the way here. Behave yourself, old men.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
虽然他们来这里的目的可疑，但他们确实把受伤的戈尼一路背到了这里。老家伙们，收敛点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are not surprised? So you knew it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不惊讶吗？看来你早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I didn't know who you were. But I knew you had a certain purpose. I had not told you my name but you were shouting 'Come out Rookie'. So I had a clue.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我不知道你是谁。但我知道你们有特定的目的。我还没告诉你我的名字，你就在喊“新人出来”。所以我有了线索。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I heard that the brain of a Rebellion is filled with bullets, but maybe not every Rebellion! So, is your name Lucky, or Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我听说反叛者的脑子里装满了子弹，但可能不是每个反叛者都这样！那么，你的名字是拉基，还是新人？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^0000cdRookie^000000. Lucky is my nickname.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^0000cd新人^000000。拉基是我的绰号。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie! You already knew who he was, and you..!!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
新人！你早就知道他是谁，竟然还...！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I told you! Old men, are you deaf now? I didn't know who they were! This is unfair!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我说过！老家伙们，你们聋了吗？我不知道他们是谁！这太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If they had an intention to attack us, they would have done it already, rather than asking for tea. And what can these two do against many of us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果他们想攻击我们，早就动手了，而不是在这里喝茶。而且，就凭他们两个，能对抗我们这么多人吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Whatever they do, you are going to handle them. Aren't you? You are legends of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管他们做什么，你们都会处理好的吧？毕竟，你们是反叛者的传奇人物。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know where they come from. But by the time they came all the way here, perhaps they need to talk to the seniors. I will bring the tea and enjoy the talk.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道他们是从哪里来的。但既然他们大老远来到这里，也许是想和前辈们谈谈。我去泡茶，顺便听听他们的想法。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hahaha! Nice to meet you. Did I surprise you by coming in all of a sudden in leisure hours?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哈哈！很高兴见到你们。突然在休息时间闯进来，吓到你们了吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But I am not a dangerous person, so please relax. And this adventurer is much less dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
但我不是危险人物，请放松。还有这位冒险者，危险性更低。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This person is an adventurer who settled various problems of the continent, including Schwaltzvalt. The adventurer is currently under the protection of Rune Midgarts Kingdom.{0}
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这位冒险者解决了大陆上的许多问题，包括施瓦茨瓦尔特。目前，这位冒险者正受到卢恩米德加特王国的保护。{0}

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And I am a member of Secret Wings, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt Republic. Since the President guarantees my identification, you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而我是“秘密之翼”的成员，这是一个直接对施瓦茨瓦尔特共和国总统负责的机构。既然总统担保了我的身份，你们就不必担心了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
How can I trust you?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我凭什么信任你？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You are the most dangerous guy here!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你才是这里最危险的人！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
President? Since I heard that unpleasant word, let me wash my ears!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
总统？一听到那个令人不快的词，我就想洗洗耳朵！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What is a spoiled crow of the President doing here?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
总统的宠儿来这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's what I am about to tell you now. Haha. So please put your guns down... Let's sit down first.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这正是我现在要告诉你们的。哈哈。所以请放下枪... 先坐下吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey, you are standing up too!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
嘿，你也站起来！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ahaha. I've got a disease that I can't sit down. By the way... As a guest, I couldn't come here with empty hands. This is a specialty good of Yuno... Please have some.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊哈哈。我有个病，坐不下来。顺便... 作为客人，我不能空手而来。这是尤诺的特产... 请尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Guest? You're just a jerk.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
客人？你只是个混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What do you mean by guest? We never invited you.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
什么客人？我们从来没邀请过你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We never know what you put on this food! There is nothing we would like to hear from you. So get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
谁知道你在食物里放了什么！我们不想听你说话。所以滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Drink tea, please.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
As soon as you drink the tea, leave at once~ We won't see you off!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
喝完茶就立刻离开~ 我们不会送你的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where are you going? I brought the tea in reference to the number of people here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你要去哪里？我按照这里的人数带了茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I don't drink tea in uncomfortable place. I don't want to have an upset stomach while drinking tea.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我不在让人不舒服的地方喝茶。我不想喝茶时肚子不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on, what's wrong with you~ You can drink it so quickly. It's not good after it gets cold. Your stomach must have got cold by now. You're not so healthy either.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，你怎么啦~ 喝得这么快。茶凉了就不好喝了，你的胃肯定已经受凉了。看来你的身体也不太好嘛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you just drink the tea before leaving? I struggled to get this tea... You also liked it...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
难道不能喝完茶再走吗？我费了好大劲才弄到这些茶... 你明明也很喜欢喝的...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And if we feel uncomfortable, they also feel uncomfortable. So it's not such a bad condition. Come on. Drinking a cup of tea is not a hard thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
而且如果我们感到不舒服，他们也会感到不舒服。所以情况并没有那么糟糕。来吧，喝一杯茶又不是什么难事。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I mean, the spoiled crow of the President-
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我是说，总裁那只被宠坏的乌鸦——

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please. The tea is innocent. have a peaceful tea time. Never fight in front of food. You taught me all these words. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜托了。茶是无辜的。请享受一段宁静的茶歇时光。不要在食物面前争吵。这些都是你教我的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Ahem, ahem.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
咳，咳。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow~ This tea is great. It matches well with this specialty good. Try it. The President prepared it for you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇~ 这茶真不错。和这道特色点心很配。尝尝看吧，这是总裁为您准备的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please listen to me. I'm here to ask you a very difficult request.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请听我说。我这次来，是想向您提出一个非常困难的请求。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Why should we accept a difficult request?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们为什么要接受一个困难的请求？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I came here. This mission cannot be accomplished by anyone except Rebellion. So the President sent me here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才来到这里。这项任务除了反叛者之外，没有人能够完成。所以总裁派我来了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I think it will be such a confidential and cautious story. Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我想这会是一个需要高度保密和谨慎处理的故事。请收下这个...

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Just tell us your point.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
直接说重点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes! Although you pretend not to know, it's the story you all know.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是的！虽然你们装作不知道，但这其实是你们都知道的故事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The President certainly regrets what happened in the past. His excellency has always been thinking about you and wanted to start a talk.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总裁确实对过去发生的事情感到后悔。他一直挂念着你们，并希望能开启对话。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Upon your approval, his excellency wants to meet you in person, apologize, and wants to have an opportunity to harmonize with you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在得到您的同意后，总裁希望能亲自与您会面，道歉，并寻求与您和声演奏的机会。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I was also extremely sad to hear what happened to you. And I was looking for a chance to meet you and talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到你们遭遇的事情，我也感到非常难过。我一直在寻找机会与你们见面并交谈。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Tell us your point!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
说重点！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are so cool. I like it. Then I will get down to the business.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你们真酷。我喜欢这样。那么我就直入正题了。

scripts.text: [Lazy began to talk about what happened recently and the request of the President.]
scripts.translation: [懒散开始讲起最近发生的事，以及总裁的请求。]

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I see. But it's your business and I don't get why we should help you. Do I?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我明白了。但这是你的事，我不明白我们为什么要帮你。是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You ignored us when we were in trouble. And you are asking for help now? How can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们遇到困难时，你置之不理。现在却来求我们帮忙？你怎么能这样？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Sounds like a bunch of nonsense. I don't want to listen any more.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
简直是一派胡言。我不想再听了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That won't harm you under any circumstances!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
无论如何，这都不会伤害到你们！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The adventurer approved by the royal family of Rune Midgarts is together with us in this mission.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
获得伦米加尔特王国皇室认可的冒险者，正与我们一同执行这项任务。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
With the cooperation of Schwaltzvalt President and Rune Midgarts Kingdom, you can now use the power of the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在施瓦茨瓦尔特总裁与伦米加尔特王国的合作下，你们现在可以使用这位冒险者的力量了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Why would we need the power of the adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们为什么需要冒险者的力量？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
How can we trust a stranger? Are you going to stab us in the back again?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们怎么能信任一个陌生人？难道你又要背后捅我们一刀吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is your opportunity. Along with this cooperation, you can eliminate the dishonor!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是你们的机会。通过这次合作，你们可以洗刷耻辱！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you cannot trust the President, please trust the adventurer and the royal family of Rune Midgarts. They have already promised a full support.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你们无法信任总裁，请信任冒险者和伦米加尔特王国的皇室。他们已经承诺给予全力支持。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on, say somthing.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
拜托了，说点什么吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right! If you need my help, I will support you actively.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错！如果你需要我的帮助，我会积极支持你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
This is not a matter of benefits. It's about our feeling!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
这不是利益的问题，而是感情的问题！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, thanks for the tea. Send them now. Let the crow go back to its nest.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，谢谢你的茶。现在送他们走吧。让乌鸦回到它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We will never see them again. So send them gently. Rookie.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们不会再见到他们了。所以，请温柔地送他们离开。新人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please, you can't leave like this...!!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
拜托了，你们不能就这样离开...!!!

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hmm... I knew it would be difficult. But I'm surprised that they are not even listening to me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯...我知道这会很困难。但没想到他们连我的话都不肯听。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. These old men will never change.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼。这些老头子永远不会变。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Your name is Rookie. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你的名字是新人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You know it already. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你早就知道了。为什么还要问？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Sorry. I guess I made a wrong judgment. I should have collected more accurate information.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
抱歉。我想我做出了错误的判断。我应该收集更准确的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's wrong with you? You make me nervous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底怎么了？你让我感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Before I came here, I knew people who were sitting here had the authority, but I now realize that it is a little different.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我来这里之前，知道坐在这里的人拥有权威，但现在我发现情况有点不同。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Unless you live here, it's hard to find out who has the authority.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
除非你住在这里，否则很难弄清楚谁拥有权威。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what you are talking about. If you finished drinking the tea, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道你在说什么。如果你茶喝完了，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Rookie, please help us. If you think about it, you can tell that it's a win-win proposition. You don't want to hide yourself in this corner of the woods forever, do you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
新人，请帮帮我们。仔细想想，你会发现这是一个双赢的方案。你不想永远躲在这个森林的角落里，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You know that this is the opportunity to take advantage of the government's support and compassion for you. It will provide better fundamentals for Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你知道这是利用政府对你支持和同情的机会。这将为反叛者提供更好的基础。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If this works well. you'll be free to work in Schwaltzvalt and Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果这行得通，你们将可以自由地在施瓦茨瓦尔特和鲁恩米德加特工作。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look at this place. It's just a tiny shop. Can you call it headquarters? Don't you want to reclaim your glory?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看看这个地方。这只是一间小商店。你能叫它总部吗？难道你们不想重夺荣耀吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And when we are in trouble, you'll abandon us again. There are still many people who haven't washed the wound from what happened in the past. Do you really think they'll help you?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
当我们陷入困境时，你又会抛弃我们。过去发生的事留下的创伤，许多人还没有愈合。你真的认为他们会帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I am asking for your help. I guess you can change their mind by persuading them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才请求你的帮助。我想你可以说服他们改变主意。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who? Me?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁？我？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
In every place, there is a hidden key person who moves the whole group even though you cannot that person easily. Here, it's you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在每个地方，都有一个隐藏的关键人物，即使你不容易发现那个人，他们也能推动整个群体。在这里，那个人就是你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, I guess you are overrating me. They regard me as an unimportant guy here. I dont't take any important mission. All I do is errands and clean-ups. Do you honestly think I'm a key person?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，我想你高估我了。他们把我看作这里无关紧要的人。我不负责任何重要任务。我只做跑腿和清理工作。你真的认为我是关键人物吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, no. That's not what I am talking about. Normally they call it a mood maker.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不，不。我不是那个意思。通常他们称之为气氛调节者。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
A while ago, you convinced the old men to listen to me. That's what I am talking about. You have such abilities.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不久前，你说服了那些老头子听我说话。我说的是这个。你有这样的能力。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what you mean by 'such abilities'. But I guess you have nothing to talk about by now. The seniors are gone.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道你所谓的“这样的能力”是什么意思。但我想你现在没什么可说的了。前辈们已经走了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I'm trying to help you. Please convince others.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才试图帮助你。请说服其他人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have nowhere else to go. Neither does everyone else here. We cannot just help you trusting your promise.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们别无去处。这里的每个人都是如此。我们不能仅仅因为你的承诺就帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It may be a matter of cooperation for you. But for us, it's a matter of survival.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
对你来说，这可能只是合作的问题。但对我们来说，这是生死攸关的问题。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please. We are also desperate. The fates of the royal family of a country and another country are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请帮帮我们。我们也走投无路了。一个国家的王室和另一个国家的命运都岌岌可危。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But if you help us, we can sort it out. That's something only you can do. We really need your help.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
但如果你帮了我们，一切都能解决。这是只有你能做到的事。我们真的需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you really need help, go to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你真的需要帮助，去找别人吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are as cold as ice. How merciless. Please show some mercy and help us.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你冷得像冰一样。真是无情。请发发慈悲，帮帮我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The people who were sitting here are seniors. They are anchors and symbols of Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
刚才坐在这里的是前辈们。他们是反叛者的支柱和象征。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But as they got old, they retired from the front line. Now they drink tea and watch the junior Rebellions grow up.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
但随着他们年事已高，便从前线退役了。现在他们喝茶，看着年轻的反叛者成长。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So other people are responsible for all the inside jobs. They are the ones ^0000cdwho move the Rebellion practically^000000. They are decision makers.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以其他人负责所有内部事务。他们是^0000cd实际推动反叛者行动的人^000000。他们是决策者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you convince them, the public opinion change. Once the public opinion changes, what can seniors do about it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你说服了他们，舆论就会改变。一旦舆论改变，前辈们又能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Thank you. I prefer those who are wise and smart like you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
谢谢你。我更喜欢像你这样明智聪明的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
In my opinion, I think it's better for us to be accepted in a wide world rather than living here like this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
在我看来，与其像这样生活在这里，不如被广阔的世界所接纳更好。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, it's time for you to take an action. Please persuade them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，是时候采取行动了。请说服他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you seen the response from the seniors? Once I introduce myself, they might shoot at me make dozens of holes in my body.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你看到前辈们的反应了吗？一旦我自我介绍，他们可能会朝我开枪，在我身上打出几十个洞。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Since those seniors were relatively rational, we are alive and talking like this. If only there was one person with a short-temper... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
幸好那些前辈相对理性，我们才能活着像这样交谈。要是有一个脾气暴躁的人...呼...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer. You are a symbol of faith. Please go and show them your faith. That will take care of everything. Did you see what I did a moment ago? Do as I did.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者。你是信任的象征。请去向他们展示你的信任。那样就能解决一切。你看到我刚才做了什么吗？照我做的去做。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, maybe...

[Rookie]
They are in the ^0000cdroom in the 2nd floor2^000000. You can go up and meet them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们在^0000cd二楼的房间^000000。你可以上去见他们。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you see the rooms on the 2nd floor? I don't know how many of them are there. But you only have to meet the most important people.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你看到二楼的房间了吗？我不知道那里有多少个房间。但你只需要见最重要的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's see... You meet ^0000cdRupert^000000, the strict gentleman and ^0000cdElena^000000, the hunting dog first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我想想...你先见^0000cd鲁伯特^000000，那位严谨的绅士，还有^0000cd埃琳娜^000000，那条猎犬。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
By the way, never call Elena 'hunting dog' in front of her. She's going to disintegrate you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
顺便说一句，千万别在埃琳娜面前叫她“猎犬”。她会把你撕碎的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyone else...? Oh, the next one is the good-hearted ^0000cdold women, I mean ladies^000000. Then you meet the Special Force commander ^0000cdErst^000000...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
还有谁...？哦，下一位是心地善良的^0000cd老妇人，我是说女士们^000000。然后你会见到特种部队指挥官^0000cd厄斯特^000000...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You can meet these ^0000cdfour teams^000000 and talk to them. As I told you earlier, be careful when you talk. Some of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你可以去见这^0000cd四支队伍^000000，并和他们交谈。正如我之前所说，说话时要小心。其中有些人脾气很暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, good luck! I will be talking to Rookie. Cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，祝你好运！我要去和新人的谈话了。加油。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer! How was it? You met all of them and persuaded them? Not yet? I guess not. If you go to the 2nd floor, you can meet all of them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者！怎么样？你见到他们所有人并说服他们了吗？还没有？看来是没有。如果你去二楼，就能见到他们所有人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I will be cheering for you. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我会为你加油的。去吧，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're back! So, have you met them? Are they going to help us?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你回来了！那么，你见到他们了吗？他们会帮助我们吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... Several things happened, but they were not bad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...发生了一些事情，但结果还不错。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No wonder you are a symbol of faith!! Now, we can wait for seniors and staffs. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
难怪你是信任的象征！！现在，我们可以等前辈和职员们了。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on. Sit here and listen to Rookie's story. It's so interesting.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
来吧。坐在这里听听新人的故事。非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So, why did you leave your home?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
那么，你为什么离开家？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's quite obvious. My family had a secondhand store. As you know, the amount iron consumption is so great in this area. Some people joke that they steal your spoon while your eyes are closed.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这很明显。我家开了一家二手店。你知道的，这个地区对铁的需求量很大。有些人开玩笑说，趁你闭眼时偷走你的勺子。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Normally they use the iron dug from mines. But since it cannot meet the demands, a lot of used iron is also consumed. Our family bought the iron and resold it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
通常他们使用从矿山挖出的铁。但由于无法满足需求，大量的废旧铁也被消耗掉了。我们家收购铁并转卖。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And you were not able to help them?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而你无法帮助他们？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
My brothers helped my parents. As you see, I'm so small and used to be sick when I was a kid.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我的兄弟们帮助了父母。你看，我很小，小时候经常生病。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, so they regarded you as a useless kid?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，所以他们把你看作一个无用的小孩？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I had no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I don't agree with you. Everyone has different ability and you must be good at something. You just didn't find it earlier. Anyway, what happened next?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我不同意你的看法。每个人都有不同的能力，你肯定擅长某些事情。你只是之前没发现而已。总之，后来发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As my family ignored me, I decided to leave the house to find something I am capable of.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然家人忽视我，我决定离开家，去寻找我擅长的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well done. If you stayed there, you would have become such a useless person.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
做得好。如果你留在那里，就会变成一个那样无用的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then I met Gonie and came here. But I found that there's nothing I could do here as well.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
然后我遇到了戈尼，并来到了这里。但我发现这里也没有我能做的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Everyone is a monster here. Look at Gonie. He was bleeding and almost dead. But He was still alive. The truth is that other guys are extraordinary and you are normal.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在这里每个人都是魔物。看看戈尼。他流着血，几乎死了。但他还活着。事实是，其他人是非凡的，而你是普通的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But I'm not at the level they require here. Whenever I get a gun in my hand, my eyes are sore and my hands are shaking. I can't aim a target properly...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
但我达不到这里的要求。每次我拿起枪，眼睛就会酸痛，手也会发抖。我根本瞄准不了目标...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So you are in charge of the housekeeping here?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以你是负责这里的家务？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not a housekeeping. A sort of cleaning-up?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不是家务。算是打扫清理吧？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey Rookie. Why did you bring those jerks in here? They are wandering around and humiliating us! Rookie, are you a spy from the government?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
嘿，新人。你为什么要带那些混蛋进来？他们到处乱逛，简直是在羞辱我们！新人，你是政府的间谍吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
The government ignored us when we were dying! We can never help them!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
政府在我们垂死挣扎时对我们视而不见！我们绝不能帮他们！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Have you forgotten why we are hiding here?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你忘了我们为什么躲在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
The government caused this tragedy!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
这场悲剧是政府造成的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Fine. You live forever in this isolated place! But what about the children who don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧。你就在这与世隔绝的地方永远生活下去吧！但那些对此一无所知的孩子怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey kid! Do you know how much pain we had on that day?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
嘿，小孩！你知道那天我们遭受了多少痛苦吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know! However, no one else will know it unless we talk about it. Go out there and ask anyone.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道！但如果我们不谈论它，其他人也不会知道。走出去问问任何人吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ask them if they know that happened on that day. I bet nobody does. Unless we talk about it, how can anyone ever find it out?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
问问他们是否知道那天发生了什么。我敢打赌没人知道。除非我们说出来，否则没人能发现真相。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You hate to help the government that once abandoned us? It shows that we used to be nothing for them, but now they our help. Does that mean some compensation for us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你讨厌帮助那个曾经抛弃我们的政府？这说明我们曾经对他们来说毫无价值，但现在他们需要我们的帮助。这难道不是某种补偿吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If they need our help, we can just use them. We are not as weak as we used to.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果他们需要我们帮忙，我们可以利用他们。我们不再像以前那样弱小了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want a revenge, maybe this is the opportunity! A revenge doesn't always mean an armed revenge.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你想复仇，也许这就是机会！复仇并不总是意味着武装复仇。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You are young and not wise enough. No matter what happens, we are never helping the government. Never!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你还年轻，不够明智。无论发生什么，我们绝不会帮助政府。绝不！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What the hell is he saying after showing up all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
他突然出现，到底在说什么鬼话？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Are you still doing the silent meditation?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你还在进行无声冥想吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
For the favor...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为了那个恩情...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear that? He is in the middle of a silent meditation. How spiteful!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到了吗？他正在进行无声冥想。真够恶毒的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Be quiet. I hear it all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
安静点。我都听到了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Gonie says we have to pay for the favor they did to him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
... 戈尼说，我们必须为他对我们的恩情付出代价。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Well. They did the favor for you, not for us.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
哼。那是他帮了你，不是帮了我们。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
If you want to help them so badly, you two go and help them. But make sure you take the clothes off!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
如果你这么想帮他们，你们两个就去帮吧。但记得把衣服脱了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear that? They are so cool.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到了吗？他们真酷。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hear it all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我都听到了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What did that guy say?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
那家伙说什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He says everyone on the 2nd floor decided to help them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他说二楼的人都决定要帮他们。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What? The ladies and Rupert as well?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
什么？连女士们和鲁伯特也一起？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you are curious, go upstairs and check it. They might slap you on the back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你好奇，就上去看看。他们可能会拍你的背。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Seems like most of us agree. I don't think anything good will happen if you're still against it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
看来大家都同意了。如果你还反对，恐怕不会有什么好事发生。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Phew... Sir, what would you do now? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
呼... 先生，您现在打算怎么办？呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Oops... We have no other choice if the ladies and Rupert agreed with them...
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
哎呀... 既然女士们和鲁伯特都同意了... 我们别无选择...

scripts.text:
[Senior]
But I will never trust you guys! I will keep my eyes on you!!!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
但我永远不会信任你们！我会一直盯着你们的！！！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, what a passionate propose. I've never had anything like this in my life. I feel a little shy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，多么热情的提议。我生平从未经历过这种事。我感到有点害羞。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I'm not leaving until I close his big mouth! I'm not leaving!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
在他闭上那张大嘴之前，我不会离开！我不走！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes. Let me handle this place. You go inside and get ready.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的。让我来处理这里。你进去准备一下。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've never imagined that this would be done so perfectly. I owe you for this. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我从未想过事情会如此完美地解决。我欠你一个人情。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please go and send them a message. Tell them 'The Heron spread its wings' and they will understand.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请去给他们送个信。告诉他们“鹭鸟展翅”，他们就会明白的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I go alone? Don't you have to send the message directly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要一个人去吗？难道你不应该亲自送信吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I am staying here. Hahaha. I really like this fellow and we can work together.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我要留在这里。哈哈哈。我真的很喜欢这家伙，我们可以合作。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Work with me? I don't think I can do anything useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
跟我合作？我觉得我帮不上什么忙。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Exactly. That's something you should change. Self-confidence. In your case, the lack of confidence caused the lack of self-confidence.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错。这是你需要改变的。自信。就你而言，缺乏自信导致了缺乏自信心。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Confidence can be obtained by yourself, through an achievement or by being approved by someone else a person. It's impossible here. This place is like a suit that does not fit for you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
自信可以通过自己的成就或他人的认可来获得。在这里是不可能的。这个地方就像一件不合身的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
As long as there is just one person who trusts you, you can grow to infinity.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只要有一个人信任你，你就能无限成长。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You may not have realized it. But you are already doing it to everyone here. They all counting on you. Just trust yourself a little more.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你可能没有意识到。但你已经在对这里的每个人这样做了。他们都依赖着你。请多相信你自己一点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you don't get it, trust me. Because I trust you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你不明白，那就相信我。因为我信任你。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now the generation has shifted. Today is the last day for the old generation and the first day for the new generation. And you are the link.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在世代交替了。今天是旧时代的最后一天，也是新时代的第一天。而你就是连接两者的纽带。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're too good to waste your talent here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你太优秀了，不该在这里浪费才华。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
First, you had the ability to find out that I had a certain purpose. You were also able to find out what's helpful for Rebellions. Then you had the guts to implement it. You also have the humanity...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
首先，你有能力发现我有一定的目的。你也发现了什么对反叛者有帮助。然后你有胆量去实施。你还有人性...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Just a little polishing will help you spread your wings. You're supposed to use your brain. Why do you suffer by working physically?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只需稍加打磨，你就能展翅高飞。你应该动脑筋。为什么要靠体力劳动来受苦？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you want, I can help you. What do you think? I need a partner and I'm sure we can make a great duo.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你愿意，我可以帮你。你觉得怎么样？我需要搭档，我相信我们能组成很棒的双人组。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, could you be explain it to me in detail?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，你能详细解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Sure. I have plenty of time. By the way, is it okay for me to stay here continuously?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然。我有的是时间。顺便问一下，我可以一直留在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We are now cooperating, aren't we?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们现在不是正在合作吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you think you're scouting him too plainly in someone else's house?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你觉得在别人家里这么明目张胆地招揽人合适吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Is there anything wrong with it? You have this talented guy but you are not utilizing his ability. Are you? He's so talented!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这有什么不对吗？你有这样一个有才华的人，却不利用他的能力。是吗？他很有才华！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He says we have prepared someone to proceed the cooperation. If you go to the passage to the store, you can meet that person.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他说我们已经安排了人来推进合作。如果你去商店的通道，就能见到那个人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will meet that person and listen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。我会去见那个人并听他怎么说。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, I need to have a long talk from now on. So I'm counting on you. When you go there, don't forget to use that place. I mean 'that place'.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，接下来我需要长时间谈话。所以拜托你了。当你去那里时，别忘了使用那个地方。我是说“那个地方”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon? I see.. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉？我明白了... 回头见。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yikes! Wait a minute! I almost forgot. This is the reward specially prepared for this mission. I am giving all of them to you. You can exchange this with something useful.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀！等一下！我差点忘了。这是专门为这次任务准备的奖励。我把它们都给你。你可以用它们交换有用的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Token of honor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
荣誉代币？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Seems like the dull middle-aged person standing beside the stairs receives the tokens. His name is Strasse. If you are interested, go.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看起来是站在楼梯旁的那个沉闷的中年人接收代币。他的名字是斯特拉瑟。如果你感兴趣，就去吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I gave you everything. Bye now. Say hello to the President!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我都给你了。再见。替我向会长问好！！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yo! Welcome! Do you want a cup of tea? Did you send the message properly?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哟！欢迎！你想喝杯茶吗？你好好把消息送出去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry.
You cannot enter here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
抱歉。
你不能进入这里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry.
You cannot enter here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
抱歉。
你不能进入这里。

scripts.text: Tell the guard that Rookie sent you.
scripts.translation: 告诉卫兵是新人派你来的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
新人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
What's wrong with that guy?
Although he sent you here, you cannot enter.
Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
那家伙怎么了？
虽然是他派你来的，但你不能进入。
请回去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Why is it so noisy here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
这里为什么这么吵？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
对不起！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Shut up!
How many times do you think I told you to be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
闭嘴！
我告诉过你多少次要保持安静！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I am sorry..
This person wants to go inside, claiming that Rookie sent him/her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
对不起..
这个人想进去，声称是新人派他/她来的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
新人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Arrrgh... That kid?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
啊... 那个小孩？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
The kid sent you. So, what about it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
是那个小孩派你来的。所以，那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
You...... You're the one who made a fuss downstairs a moment ago.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
你...... 你刚才在楼下闹事的那个。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
I have no idea what brought you here. But I can't let you in.
Do not make a fuss. Go back!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
我不知道你为什么会来这里。但我不能让你进去。
不要闹事。滚回去！

scripts.text: Ask him again.
scripts.translation: 再问他一次

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
You cannot change anything by asking me for a favor.
No.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
你求我也没用。
不行。

scripts.text: Ask him again.
scripts.translation: 再问他一次

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
I said no!
You're so annoying!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
我说不行！
你真烦人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
If it hadn't been for the order of our leader, I could just knock you out right here......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
要不是我们首领的命令，我刚才就把你打晕了......

scripts.text:
[???]
...... It's noisy outside.
What's going on? Larcis.
scripts.translation:
[???]
...... 外面好吵。
发生什么事了？拉西斯。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Nothing.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
没什么。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Hey, leave now.
You will be in trouble, if you keep making a fuss.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
喂，现在离开。
如果你继续闹事，会有麻烦的。

scripts.text: Shout at him.
scripts.translation: 对他大喊

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
A good idea.
The exit is downstairs. Go there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
好主意。
出口在楼下。去那里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
What the hell was that!
You're so rude!
Do you want to die right now?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
你他妈的在干什么！
你真没礼貌！
你想现在就死吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Oops!
This is the voice I've never heard before. Is it the adventurer who helped that kid?
scripts.translation:
[???]
哎呀！
这是我从未听过的声音。是那个帮助小孩冒险者吗？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[???]
Larcis.
We cannot leave our savior outside. Let the adventurer come in.
Let me give him/her a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[???]
拉西斯。
我们不能把救世主留在外面。让冒险者进来。
让我给他/她倒杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
But.. Dien!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
但是.. 迪恩！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
...... I see.
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
...... 我明白了。
跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you behave rudely, you won't go back alive.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
如果你行为粗鲁，你就别想活着回去了。

scripts.text: - The door seems to be locked -
scripts.translation: - 门似乎被锁住了 -

scripts.text: - You hear the conversation from inside the room. -
scripts.translation: - 你听到房间里的对话声。 -

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
... So I was thinking that you were having dementia.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
...... 我还以为你得了老年痴呆症呢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm not that old yet.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我还没那么老呢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come to think of it, you should make yourself up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
说起来，你应该好好打扮一下！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
This is why you look older!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
这就是你看起来显老的原因！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Sometimes you look older than Cotnes!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
有时候你看起来比科特内斯还老！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oops, really?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哎呀，真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Phew!
Not so old!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
呼！
还不算太老！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
It seems like you have more wrinkles these days.
Why don't you put on some anti-wrinkle cream?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
感觉你最近皱纹变多了。
不如涂点抗皱霜吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
This all is because of the air here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
这都是这里的空气造成的！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
You're right!
This type of air is critical to the dry skin like yours!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
你说得对！
这种空气对像你这样干燥的皮肤很不利！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come to think of it, remember that kid who came here before?
Tell him to buy some cosmetics from Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
说起来，还记得之前来过这里的那个小孩吗？
让他去卢恩·米德加兹买点化妆品！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I have heard there's a fascinating cosmetic shop there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我听说那里有一家很迷人的化妆品店。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
It's difficult for our kids to go all the way there to buy cosmetics.
There is a problem with the position as well...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
对我们的小孩来说，跑那么远去买化妆品很困难。
而且位置也是个问题...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That kid? Who are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
那个小孩？你说的是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
The kid from the Secret Wings~
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
就是那个来自秘密翅膀的小孩~

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oh!
I remember I asked him for an errand. Will he be back here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哦！
我记得我让他帮我办过一件事。他会回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
It's like you solved the whole problem. And they won't get past you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
这就好像你解决了所有问题。而且他们过不了你这一关。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Of course, we have some important thoughts~
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
当然，我们也有重要的想法~

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
You're so great. How can you think of such an idea in that short moment?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
你真厉害。怎么能在那么短的时间内想到这种主意？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Not to mention the president, Heart Hunters are irritating to us as well.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
除了会长，心之猎手对我们来说也很讨厌。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Although they are all novices, they can be an obstacle for us in defeating the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
虽然他们全是初心者，但在击败秘密翅膀时可能会成为我们的障碍。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
That's true.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Let's say we attack the Secret Wings recklessly and Heart Hunters takes the chance to attack us. We'll collapse in a minute.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
假设我们鲁莽地攻击秘密翅膀，而心之猎手趁机袭击我们，我们很快就会崩溃。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
So we will pretend to cooperate with the Secret Wings and get rid of the annoying ones first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
所以我们要假装与秘密翅膀合作，先除掉那些讨厌的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Let's finish them before they realize we have a plan to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
让我们在他们意识到我们要攻击他们之前，先解决掉他们。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
We're Rebellions. And we are at the end of guns.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我们是反叛者。而且我们已经到了弹尽粮绝的地步。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Let me finish my karma in my generation.
I don't want to leave it to youngsters.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
让我在这一代结束我的业障吧。
我不想把它留给年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
This is good to have this opportunity before I die.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
能在死前拥有这个机会，真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come on, sister!
Don't talk about dying!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
哎呀，姐姐！
别老说死啊！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I saw Rupert crying after you said that.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我刚才看到鲁伯特听到你这么说后哭了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
He's not cute anymore, he is just a middle-aged man. But to him, you're like mother.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
他现在已经不可爱了，只是个中年男子。但对他来说，你就像母亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
And to me...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
而对我...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Yes, I see.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What we have now is a pleasant party. I'm looking forward to it.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我们现在拥有的是一场愉快的聚会。我很期待。
哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I'm expecting it so much!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我也非常期待！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Then I'll fix the party accessories in advance.
Hohohoho.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
那我就提前准备好聚会的装饰品吧。
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Nice to meet you.
Take a seat and have some cookies.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
很高兴见到你。
请坐，吃点饼干吧。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Phew.. It sounds so serious.
It's dangerous to be excited at our age...
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
呼...听起来很严肃。
我们这个年纪，激动起来可是很危险的...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Oops! Welcome.
We have been talking about the party that will be held soon.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
哎呀！欢迎。
我们刚才正在讨论即将举行的聚会。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It's been a long time since an outsider came in here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
上次有外人进来，已经是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
如果你不想让我在你头上打个漂亮的洞，现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Don't be so panic.
I talked it out with my sister.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
别那么慌张。
我已经和我姐姐谈过了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Don't just be standing there. Sit down here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
别光站着，坐这边来。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let me persuade the people who are against this.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
让我去说服那些反对的人。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Sister!
Are you crazy?
What the hell are you saying!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
什么！！！！！！！！！！
姐姐！
你疯了吗？
你在说什么鬼话！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That's the request from the president!
The guy who destroyed us!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
那是总统的要求！
那个毁了我们的人！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Calm down, Ridsh.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冷静点，里德什。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I will never accept it!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我绝不会接受！

scripts.text:
[???]
Well... If Dien agrees, I will agree, too.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯...如果迪恩同意，我也同意。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What's wrong with you, Cotnes!
This is the request from those guys!
Those guys who destroyed us!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
科特内斯，你怎么回事！
这是那帮人的要求！
那帮毁了我们的人！

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Dien must have some thoughts about it.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
迪恩一定有自己的想法。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Although you are my sister, I will never accept this!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
虽然你是我的姐姐，但我绝不会接受这件事！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... You'd better go out now.
If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...你最好现在出去。
如果你再待在这里，我可能会在你头上打个空气洞。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I know you've met Rupert. Have you met ^ff0000Erst^000000?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过^ff0000厄斯特^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... You'd better go out now.
If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...你最好现在出去。
如果你再待在这里，我可能会在你头上打个空气洞。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I know you've met Rupert. Have you met Erst?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过厄斯特吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm surprised that Erst accepted it so easily.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
没想到厄斯特这么爽快地就答应了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Without further delay, meet Rupert again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
事不宜迟，再去见见鲁伯特吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Welcome.
Since most of the kids are busy these days, I feel somewhat bored.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
欢迎。
最近孩子们都很忙，我觉得有点无聊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
By the way, what brought you here? I thought you finished your business.
I guess I answered your question...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
话说回来，你这次来有什么事吗？我还以为你的事情都办完了呢。
看来我已经回答你的问题了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oops!
You haven't forgotten about the errand?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哎呀！
你还没忘记那件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I didn't really mean to ask you for a favor. It's so kind of you to remember it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我其实没真想麻烦你。你还记得，真是太好了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
We were talking about the party we are planning soon.
It was nearly over. But several ingredients are missing.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我们刚才在讨论即将举行的聚会。
差点就谈完了，但还缺几种食材。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since Larcis is in charge of our business, please ask him. He will tell you what we need.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
既然拉西斯负责我们的事务，请去问问他。他会告诉你我们需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well...... I heard what they said about you.
Did you help the kid when he fell on the ground?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯......我听说了一些关于你的事。
那个小孩摔倒在地时，是你帮了他吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Sister, he is Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[???]
姐姐，他是戈尼。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oops.
Is his name Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哎呀。
他的名字是戈尼吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
You know, that tall guy who doesn't talk much.
scripts.translation:
[???]
就是那个很高、不太爱说话的人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！

scripts.text:
[???]
He bought some expensive cookies for us on his way to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[???]
他去里希塔乐镇的路上，给我们买了一些很贵的饼干。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh! Right!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！对了！
是的！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It was so delicious.
Have we finished it all?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
那饼干真好吃。
我们都吃完了吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
It was so delicious and we finished it that day. Didn't we?
The quantity was so small.
scripts.translation:
[???]
太好吃了，我们那天就吃光了。不是吗？
数量很少。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Did we finish it?
It would have been better if we saved it for visitors.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我们吃完了吗？
要是留一点给客人就好了。

scripts.text:
[???]
If you save it, there will be mold on it.
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果留着，就会发霉的。

scripts.text:
[???]
By the way, what happened to Gonie that time?
scripts.translation:
[???]
话说回来，那次戈尼后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh, my goodness! Really?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
I was lucky to find him early.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
幸好我早点发现了他。

scripts.text:
[???]
I heard what they were saying.
It sounds like he has been cured and is all right now.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我听到他们在说什么了。
听起来他已经被治愈了，现在没事了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is that so?
What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
是吗？
真是让人放心。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Ah~
The kids are struggling......
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
啊~
孩子们正在努力呢......

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I hope they don't get hurt.
Every time they leave the base, I'm afraid they might get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
希望他们不要受伤。
每次他们离开基地，我都担心他们会受伤。

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, sister!
You worry too much!
They are adults, not babies. They can take care of themselves.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，姐姐！
你太担心了！
他们是成年人，不是婴儿。他们能照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[???]
By the way, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[???]
顺便问一下，你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[???]
I don't think you came here for tea and chatting with us.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我觉得你来这里不是为了喝茶和聊天的。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text:
[???]
Hey!
Get out of here!

[???]
Where do you think you are? That's sheer nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你以为你在哪里？这简直是胡说八道！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Calm down, Ridsh!
Do not make a fuss.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冷静点，里德什！
不要大惊小怪。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
How can I calm down on hearing that?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
听到那种话我怎么能冷静？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
No wonder they started talking about Gonie. It seemed like they were hiding something from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
难怪他们开始谈论戈尼。看起来他们从一开始就在隐瞒什么！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
如果你不想让我在你头上打个漂亮的洞，现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
And tell them!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
告诉他们！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Before we kill you all, there's no chance in hell we can ever cooperate with you!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
在我们杀了你们之前，我们绝不可能与你们合作！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
How dare you....
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们怎么敢....

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You expected this before you came here, right?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你来这里之前就预料到了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
But we like your courage. So we will listen to you first.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
但我们欣赏你的勇气。所以，我们先听听你的话。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You must have been ready to die by the time you came here. So I will say this is the price of your life.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你来到这里时，想必已经做好了赴死的准备。所以，这就是你生命的代价。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister!
Don't even listen!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
姐姐！
别听他的！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Ridsh!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
里德什！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
...
Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Wow... Heart Hunters...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哇...心之猎手...

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What!
Whatever it is, it is none of our business!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
什么！
不管是什么，都与我们无关！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why do we have to help you?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我们为什么要帮你？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You are the ones who abandoned us in suffering!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
是你们抛弃了我们在苦难中挣扎！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Rune-Midgarts?
I don't care what happens to their royal family!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
卢恩·米德加兹？
我才不在乎他们的皇室发生什么事！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
For Schwartz?
The biggest wish of my life is the collapse of Schwartz!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
为了施瓦茨？
我毕生的愿望就是施瓦茨的覆灭！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You can't handle Heart Hunter kids and ask us for help!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们连心之猎手的孩子都处理不了，还来求我们帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Where is the arrogance you showed us when you abandoned us?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们当初抛弃我们时的那副傲慢嘴脸呢？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It serves you right!
Fools!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
活该！
一群蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... That's enough!
Can you give us some time to think about it?
It's not an easy decision.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...够了！
能给我们一点时间考虑一下吗？
这不是一个容易的决定。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in your inventory.
Please arrange your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 您的物品栏已满。
请整理物品栏后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Quiet inside!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
里面安静点！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
What's going on here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这里发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Preparation for the party?
She has never told me anything about party!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是在准备队伍活动？
她从来没跟我提过什么队伍的事！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Oh! I remember she told me to bring something suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
哦！我想起来了，她让我带点可疑的东西过来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
High Class Tea for Dien, Old Letter for Ridsh and Very Shining Ring for Cotnes.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
给迪恩的上等茗茶，给里德什的旧信，还有给科特内斯的闪亮戒指。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
At first sight, they don't look strange. But their locations are quite suspicious... They are in the northeastern corner of Einbroch. I have no idea how we can get them in such a place...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
乍一看它们没什么奇怪的。但它们的位置很可疑... 它们都在艾音布罗克的东北角。我完全不知道我们是怎么能拿到那些地方的东西的...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
But... they told us to bring them. So we have to go and get them.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
但是... 她们让我们带这些过来。所以我们必须去把它们取回来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you're willing to go, tell me!
Of course, we will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
如果你愿意去的话，告诉我！
当然，我们会给你报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
You're here!
Then would you please have a look at the tasks given by Dien, Ridsh and Cotnes?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
你来了！
那么请看一下迪恩、里德什和科特内斯交给你的任务吧？

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well.. I do not force you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
好吧... 我不勉强你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
This is {0} {1} asked you for.
If you meet Julian in the northeastern corner of the northern field in Einbroch, he will let you in.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这是{0} {1}让你找的东西。
如果你在艾音布罗克北边田野的东北角遇到朱利安，他会让你进去的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Right there, defeat {0}.
I don't know what's going on. But since it's order of {1}, we have to do it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
就在那里，击败{0}。
我不知道发生了什么。但既然是{1}的命令，我们就必须执行。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Look at other requests.
scripts.translation: 查看其他请求

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
保重！

scripts.text: A request you are currently doing.
scripts.translation: 你正在进行的请求。

scripts.text: A request you have already completed.
scripts.translation: 你已完成的请求。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
This is the High Class Tea Dien told me about... But why was it located in such a place?
... Anyway, you did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这就是迪恩告诉我的上等茗茶... 但它为什么会在那个地方？
... 总之，你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
如果你把这个令牌交给位于2楼走廊10点钟方向楼梯处的斯特拉瑟，你会得到一些有用的东西作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well done.
This is the Old Letter Ridsh talked about... By the way, why does she need this letter...?
There must be a reason, as Ridsh told us to bring it...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
这就是里德什提到的旧信... 顺便问一下，她为什么需要这封信...？
既然里德什让我们带它回来，肯定是有原因的...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
如果你把这个令牌交给位于2楼走廊10点钟方向楼梯处的斯特拉瑟，你会得到一些有用的东西作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well done.
This is the Very Shining Ring Cotnes talked about... As an accessory, it looks tremendous, doesn't it?
Cotnes said it's a ring. Then it's a ring...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
这就是科特内斯提到的闪亮戒指... 作为饰品，它看起来非常华丽，不是吗？
科特内斯说它是戒指。那它就是戒指...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
如果你把这个令牌交给位于2楼走廊10点钟方向楼梯处的斯特拉瑟，你会得到一些有用的东西作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Special Force commander]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者特种部队指挥官]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Special Force commander]
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者特种部队指挥官]
滚开。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
And who's the guy beside you?
I haven't seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那你旁边那个人是谁？
我从来没见过你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ah.. that is....
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊...那个是...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Ssssh!
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嘘！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Stop stalling...
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
别磨蹭了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I am sorry!
Dien sent you a letter!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
对不起！
迪恩给你寄了一封信！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What?
What did that grandma send?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么？
那个老奶奶寄了什么？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Show it to me.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Here..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
给...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's see..
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
I agree. Do you agree, too?
What the hell is this nonsense?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
我同意。你也同意吗？
这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Explain him.
scripts.translation: 向他解释

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What?
Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么？
你在开玩笑吗？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Finally, that old woman is out of her mind.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
终于，那个老女人疯了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Hey!
Larcis.
Are you sure she wrote this?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嘿！
拉西斯。
你确定是她写的吗？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Regardless of the old women, the vixen will not be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
不管那个老女人怎么说，那只狐狸精不会安分的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
It's clear that Dien wrote this!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
很明显是迪恩写的！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Well, that's why she sent you here.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嗯，所以她派你来了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
......
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
......

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
This could be the last wish of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
这可能是那位老奶奶最后的愿望了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's agree with it.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那就答应她吧。
至少暂时是这样。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
This could be the last wish of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
这可能是那位老奶奶最后的愿望了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's agree with it.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那就答应她吧。
至少暂时是这样。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What is it?
Stop wandering around and get lost now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
怎么了？
别到处乱逛然后迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Our commander is a great person!
There are no words to describe... how great he is!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我们的指挥官是个了不起的人！
言语无法形容...他有多伟大！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Make sure you properly maintain your weapons.
Although there is dust on your shoes, your gun must always be shiny... That's what they call 'hard-boiled'!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
一定要好好保养你的武器。
虽然你的长靴上沾了灰尘，但你的枪必须时刻闪闪发光...这就是所谓的“硬汉”！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you know the meaning of this position?
Huhuhuhuhu
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你知道这个职位的意义吗？
呼呼呼呼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
To become strong, you need an opportunity.
If your determination is not strong enough, you will always be in the same place.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
想要变强，就需要机会。
如果决心不够坚定，你将会永远停留在原地。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress, because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续前进。 -

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
[Strange man]
Are you the adventurer who is making a fuss in Clana Nemieri?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
你就是那个在夜巡者转职考试地点闹事的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: You heard a voice of the man who showed up all of a sudden. Where on earth did he appear from?
scripts.translation: 你听到了那个突然出现的男人的声音。他到底是从哪里冒出来的？

scripts.text: The man named Vero has not shown up. It seems like they are not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 名叫维罗的男人还没有出现。看来他们还没准备好。

scripts.text: It is time. Let me talk to them now.
scripts.translation: 时间到了。让我现在去和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops?! Here are you. Have you arrived already?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀？是你啊。你已经到了吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You have to talk to me. Not to the elder sister.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你要和我说话。不是和姐姐说。

scripts.text: You are to meet Vero in Einbech. Let's go to Einbech.
scripts.translation: 你要在艾音贝赫见维罗。我们去艾音贝赫吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Kahaha. Welcome, pal.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈哈。欢迎，伙计。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text: I promised to meet Vero at Lighthalzen. Let's go to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 我答应在里希塔乐镇见维罗。我们去里希塔乐镇吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Have you brought the Star Crumb?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带星星的角了吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
It seems like Vero has already departed.
Let's go to Yuno quickly.
scripts.translation:
维罗似乎已经出发了。
我们快去尤诺吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl is looking at books and documents, as usual.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩像往常一样，正在翻找书籍和文件。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I have seen you talking to that kid lately. Do you care about her?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我最近看你经常和那个小孩说话。你在意她吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl is looking at books and documents, as usual. Shall I say hello?
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩像往常一样，正在翻找书籍和文件。我要打个招呼吗？

scripts.text: Say hello.
scripts.translation: 打个招呼

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: The Gunslinger girl is not interested in what's happening here and goes on with her business.
scripts.translation: 那位神枪手女孩对这里发生的事不感兴趣，继续忙她的事。

scripts.text: What shall I say to the Gunslinger girl?
scripts.translation: 我要对那位神枪手女孩说什么？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl stole a glance at me and resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩偷偷看了我一眼，然后又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正在翻找书籍和文件，她偷偷看了我一眼。然后，她又继续翻找书籍和文件了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha, I'm here, sister.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈，姐姐，我来了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
So it was you.
The hottest fellow in Clana Nemieri, right? I hate to admit that you're hotter than me. Being hot has always been my part here.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
原来是你啊。
夜巡者转职考试地点最酷的家伙，对吧？我不愿意承认你比我更酷。在这里，耍酷一直是我的强项。

scripts.text:
[Strange man]
Oh~! Now I have to introduce myself.
I am Arivero Yurhik.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哦~！那我得自我介绍一下。
我是阿里维罗·尤尔希克。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We have met today for the first time, but I guess we will be friends from now on. So you can just call me Vero.
Only my close friends call me Vero. Hahaha. So you are honored.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们今天才第一次见面，但我猜我们以后会成为朋友。所以你可以直接叫我维罗。
只有我的好朋友才这么叫我。哈哈。所以你很有面子。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
And the lady here who is passionately interested in you is my elder sister, Arinoa Yurhik. You can see it from the name. We are siblings!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还有，这位对你很感兴趣的女士是我的姐姐，阿里诺亚·尤尔希克。从名字就能看出来，我们是姐弟！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对我感兴趣？

scripts.text:
It's strange. The lady has been looking at the documents, without showing any interest in me.
The man who has been speaking loudly became serious all of a sudden. He started talking to himself.
scripts.translation:
真奇怪。那位女士一直在看文件，对我没有任何兴趣。
那个说话很大声的男人突然变得严肃起来。他开始自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are showing such a great interest in him..? Sister, perhaps you are trying to give the mission to this fellow?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你对他这么感兴趣...？姐姐，难道你想把这个任务交给这家伙？

scripts.text: Since I was looking at her continuously, I knew that the lady did not speak or act. But the man named Vero seemed to understand what she was thinking and continued speaking.
scripts.translation: 因为我一直在看着她，我知道那位女士没有说话或行动。但那个叫维罗的男人似乎理解她在想什么，继续说道。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yeah.. Really? Hahaha. I knew we'd become friends.
Hey friend. We have a task to work on together.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
是啊...真的吗？哈哈。我就知道我们会成为朋友。
嘿，朋友。我们有个任务要一起完成。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It's not a hard job. All we need is to go to about four places and destroy several things.
You'll do it. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这不是个难任务。我们只需要去大约四个地方，摧毁几样东西。
你会做的，对吧？

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 开始吧。

scripts.text: Do it without hesitation.
scripts.translation: 毫不犹豫去做

scripts.text: Do it at all events.
scripts.translation: 无论如何都去做

scripts.text: Since you are being forced, do it.
scripts.translation: 既然被逼无奈，那就去做吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
When I saw you for the first time, I knew you were faithful. Oh! Right.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
第一次见到你时，我就知道你是个忠诚的人。哦！对了。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1} is my name.

[Arivero Yurhik]
{0}?
Hmm, what an arrogant name. But it's the name that deserves to be hot. Now I have to acknowledge you..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
{0}？
嗯，真是个傲慢的名字。但这个名字确实很酷。现在我要承认你了...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I have several things to prepare. I believe you also need some time to get ready before departing, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我还有几样东西要准备。我相信你在出发前也需要一些时间做准备，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I will be fully ready after 4:00 am tomorrow. Once you are ready after that time, tell my elder sister. Then I will get here quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
明天凌晨4点我就准备就绪了。在那之后，当你准备好了，请告诉我的姐姐。我会很快赶过来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are not only faithful, but diligent as well!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你不仅忠诚，而且很勤奋！

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! The preparation is finished and you have arrived here. So let me give you a briefing on what we are going to do.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！准备工作已经完成，你也到了。那么让我给你讲讲我们要做什么。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Teleporting is not available in the Schwaltzvalt area. I'm sure you know that.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
施瓦茨瓦尔特地区无法使用瞬间移动。我相信你知道这一点。

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道。

scripts.text: I didn't know.
scripts.translation: 我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good. Actually, you don't need to know that.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
很好。其实，你不需要知道这一点。
这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I like your honesty. You don't actually need to know that.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我喜欢你的诚实。其实你不需要知道这一点。
这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
According to the government of Schwaltzvalt, the use of teleport in the village is prohibited to prevent the overuse of magic. But it's just nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
根据施瓦茨瓦尔特政府的规定，为了防止魔法过度使用，禁止在村庄使用瞬间移动。但这只是胡说八道。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
There was an incident called 'Magic overuse'. Due to this incident, they passed the law to prohibit teleporting. In my opinion, 'Magic overuse' was manipulated by the government of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
曾发生过一起被称为“魔法过度使用”的事件。由于这起事件，他们通过了禁止瞬间移动的法律。在我看来，“魔法过度使用”是施瓦茨瓦尔特政府操纵的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We think the Schwaltzvalt government installed the equipment to limit teleporting to protect the secret research of the Rekenber enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们认为施瓦茨瓦尔特政府安装了限制瞬间移动的设备，以保护雷肯贝尔企业的秘密研究。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Looking at the series of incidents that happened after the equipment was installed, our conviction has become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
看着设备安装后发生的一系列事件，我们的信念更加坚定了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Series of incidents?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
