一系列事件？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Haven't you heard of the mysterious disappearance in the slum?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你没听说过贫民窟的神秘失踪案吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since it's an incident that has already happened and it is not important now, I will skip the explanation. If you are curious about it, you can search it later on.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
既然这是一起已经发生且现在不重要的事件，我就跳过解释了。如果你好奇，可以稍后去调查。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
In any case, we will destroy all the 'Teleport prohibition equipment' installed in Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
无论如何，我们将摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特安装的所有“瞬间移动禁止设备”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know its location?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道它的位置吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Wow~ That's so sharp..
What a sharp question.
You deserve to be a hot person.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哇~ 真敏锐...
问得好。
你真是个厉害的人。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
That's the problem we face now. This equipment is being hidden and protected by various technologies, including magic.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这正是我们现在面临的问题。这些设备被各种技术隐藏和保护着，包括魔法。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahahaha. But you don't have to worry.
At least, I know the location of one part of the equipment.
Do you know 'Einbech, the mining village'?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈。不过你不用担心。
至少，我知道其中一部分设备的位置。
你知道“艾音贝赫，那个采矿村庄”吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha. Of course you do, this area, Clana Nemieri, is also in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈。当然知道，这个区域，夜巡者转职考试地点，也在艾音贝赫。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Anyway, our agent in Einbech reported that a suspicious device showed up at the end of a freight train and disappeared quickly. The problem is..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
总之，我们在艾音贝赫的特工报告说，一列货运列车的末端出现了一个可疑装置，并迅速消失了。问题是...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
There is no way to reveal the hidden and protected device for us to destroy..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们无法揭示被隐藏和保护的设备，以便将其摧毁...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
In this case, we can revise the incident step by step from the beginning, right?
Maybe we can find something we missed.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
在这种情况下，我们可以从头开始逐步回顾事件，对吧？
也许我们能发现一些遗漏的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你同意吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It's been a long time since I used my head for the last time. Let's take a break to clear our minds.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我很久没动脑子了。让我们休息一下，理清思路。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! It's high time to use my head, after a long while.
I will tell you the situation step by step from the moment when the agent found an unusual device. Once you find anything abnormal, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！是时候动动脑子了，已经很久没用了。
我会从特工发现异常装置的那一刻起，逐步告诉你情况。一旦发现任何异常，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
One day, our agent H in Einbech came out of the guardroom for the usual night patrol with a torch and club in each hand. H was wearing guard clothes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
有一天，我们在艾音贝赫的特工H拿着火把和棍棒，从警卫室出来进行例行的夜间巡逻。H穿着卫兵的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H finished the patrol following the usual order. Finally, H went to the end of the freight train where he found an abnormal device.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
H按照惯例完成了巡逻。最后，H走到货运列车的末端，在那里发现了一个异常装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Normally, there is a strong wind every now and then. But, on that day, the wind was strong enough to turn off the light. Then..
H said that a suspicious device appeared for a moment and disappeared quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
通常，时不时会有强风。但那天，风大到足以吹灭火光。然后...
H说，一个可疑装置出现了一瞬间，然后迅速消失了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
That's it..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
就是这样...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The only information we have is the statement by the agent.. After listening to this story, did you find anything unusual?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们唯一的信息就是特工的证词...听完这个故事，你发现有什么异常吗？

scripts.text: Guard clothes
scripts.translation: 卫兵的衣服

scripts.text: Club
scripts.translation: 棍棒

scripts.text: The way H patrolled
scripts.translation: H巡逻的方式

scripts.text: Freight train
scripts.translation: 货运列车

scripts.text: A strong wind
scripts.translation: 强风

scripts.text: The turned-off torch
scripts.translation: 熄灭的火把

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
He was wearing neat guard clothes cleaned and ironed by his daughter. But it's not unusual to wear neat guard clothes
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
他穿着女儿清洗熨烫过的整洁卫兵制服。不过，穿整洁的卫兵制服也没什么不寻常的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H says he carries a club every time he patrols, to prepare for some unexpected situations. This is not unusual either.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
他说每次巡逻都会带一根棍棒，以防突发状况。这也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H patrols through the same course every day. He says it's written in the guard manual. I find nothing strange about it. Do you?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
他每天沿着固定的路线巡逻。他说这是卫兵手册里规定的。我觉得没什么奇怪的。你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It was a train that carried coal from the mine. Since it was night, the train stopped. Well, they say the train is not operated a lot these days due to a great deal of monsters in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
那是从米内运煤的列车。因为是晚上，列车就停在那里了。听说最近米内魔物很多，列车很少运行。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since it is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind, even in normal times.. It happens every day, so I don't find it strange.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这里是山区，即使在平时，偶尔也会刮起强风。这种事每天都发生，我觉得没什么奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
A strong wind.. The turned-off torch..
Oh?! I think I have found it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
强风...熄灭的火把...
哦？！我想我找到线索了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahahahaha. You are a genius. Thanks to your support, the puzzle is solved. Now we have a reliable theory and let's test it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈哈哈哈。你真是天才。多亏你的提示，谜题解开了。现在我们有了一个可靠的理论，让我们来验证一下吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What kind of theory is it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是什么样的理论？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hmm? You haven't noticed yet? I thought you noticed it already and then gave me a hint.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嗯？你还没发现吗？我以为你已经发现了，所以才给我提示的。
不过这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The Turned-off torch.. Fire!! Yes, it's the fire. Since Einbech is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind there, even in normal times. What was different from usual was that the torch was turned off.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
熄灭的火把...火！没错，就是火。因为艾音贝赫是山区，即使在平时，偶尔也会刮起强风。不同寻常的是，火把熄灭了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Normally they say the fire is the strongest right before being turned off. So my theory focused on the fact that the device appeared for a while and disappeared quickly right before the torch was gone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
通常人们说，火在熄灭前是最旺的。所以我的理论集中在这一点上：装置出现了一会儿，就在火把熄灭前迅速消失了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The very moment when the fire is strong and disappears!! That is the condition for the device to appear.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
火最旺且即将熄灭的那一刻！这就是装置出现的条件。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What do you think about my theory? Isn't it worth trying?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你觉得我的理论怎么样？值得一试吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem so excited and I really don't get what you are saying. But if you are so positive about it, let's try. Trying won't hurt. Would it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来好兴奋，我完全没听懂你在说什么。但既然你这么肯定，那就试试吧。尝试一下又不会受伤。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since you are a hot person, your answer is also hot. Great! Let's go and try it. It's in this village anyway.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
既然你是个急性子，回答也这么热烈。太好了！我们去试试吧。反正就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You come to the very end of the freight train with the items with full of fire attributes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
带着充满火属性的物品，来到货运列车的尽头。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
See you at the end of the freight train.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们在货运列车的尽头见。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You were awesome. You deserve to be the hottest fellow in Clana Nemieri these days.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你太棒了。你配得上成为夜巡者转职考试地点最近最火热的人物。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey look! My elder sister is so glad to hear that the equipment was destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿，你看！我姐姐听到装备被销毁的消息，高兴坏了。

scripts.text: His elder sister was just fishing around books and documents that she was looking at. But Arivero didn't seem to care about it and continued to speak in excitement.
scripts.translation: 他的姐姐只是在翻阅她正在看的书籍和文件。但阿里维罗似乎并不在意，继续兴奋地讲着。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! I almost forgot.
Since we revealed the secret of teleport prohibition equipment, our agent in Lighthalzen was able to spot the location and attributes of the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！我差点忘了。
既然我们揭露了禁止瞬间移动装备的秘密，我们在里希塔乐镇的特工已经锁定了装备的位置和属性。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hmm..
The location is inside the mansion. The attribute is water. This information is too simple. Can we find it with this?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嗯...
位置在别墅内部。属性是水。这些信息太简单了。凭这些我们能找到它吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Water on four sides.. Water attribute..
What kind of relationship is there between its installed location and the attribute of teleport prohibition device?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
四面是水...水属性...
它的安装位置和禁止瞬间移动装置的属性之间有什么关系呢？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It gives me a headache. Let me think about it later.
What do we need here? We need one Mystic Frozen to reveal the device.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这让我头疼。让我稍后再想想。
我们需要什么？我们需要一块水灵原石来揭露这个装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Is Wind strong against Water? Hey pal. What is the attribute stone for wind attribute? Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
风克水吗？嘿，伙计。风属性的属性石是什么？你知道吗？

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火灵原石

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水灵原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土灵原石

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not Flame Heart. It's a fire attribute stone that revealed the device in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不是火灵原石。那是火属性石，是用来揭露艾音贝赫那个装置的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
And Mystic Frozen is a water attribute stone required to reveal the device in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
而水灵原石是水属性石，是用来揭露里希塔乐镇那个装置的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yes, it is! Rough Wind! This is the attribute stone of Wind attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
没错！风灵原石！这就是风属性的属性石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great Nature? Isn't it for the Ground attribute? I don't think we need it right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
土灵原石？那不是土属性的吗？我觉得我们现在不需要它。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! Bring me one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds.
See you in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！给我带一块水灵原石和三块风灵原石。
我们在里希塔乐镇见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's strange. Why are you in such a hurry?
Is there anything urgent?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真奇怪。你为什么这么着急？
有什么紧急的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh, did I look like that? We already have the information and I was trying to destroy the equipment quickly before they become aware of it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦，我看起来像那样吗？我们已经掌握情报了，我想在他们察觉之前尽快销毁装备。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! I see.
It is a great idea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！我明白了。
这是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
As I told you, I used to be the hottest person in Clana Nemieri before you showed up!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
正如我告诉你的，在你出现之前，我可是夜巡者转职考试地点最火热的人物！

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh!
Hey, let's get down to the business. Bring the materials and see you in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！
嘿，让我们正事要紧。带上材料，我们在里希塔乐镇见。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You were marvelous in Lighthalzen. No wonder you're such a hot person.
Look at her! My elder sister is even more pleased than before.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你在里希塔乐镇的表现太棒了。难怪你是这么火热的人物。
看看她！我姐姐比之前更高兴了。

scripts.text: Upon any consideration, I think Vero is misunderstanding something. The poker-faced lady he calls his sister is still fishing around books and documents. And why is he saying that she is pleased? Why does he say that?
scripts.translation: 无论怎么想，我觉得维罗误解了什么。他叫他姐姐的那位面无表情的女士，还在翻阅书籍和文件。而且他为什么说她很高兴？他为什么这么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I wanted to ask you about this. Is she really pleased?
Look at her. She's not even looking here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想问问你这件事。她真的很高兴吗？
看看她。她甚至都没看这边。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What?! Can't you see her being pleased? Look at her now. She is pretending to ignore us, because she is shy. But the glow around her cheeks shows that she is pleased. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
什么？你看不出她很高兴吗？看看她现在的样子。她只是在假装无视我们，因为她害羞了。但她脸颊上的红晕出卖了她，她其实很开心。明白了吗？

scripts.text: Well, I don't get it. But I will just accept it, as her younger brother says so.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我不太懂。但既然弟弟这么说了，我就先接受这个说法吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey! Friend!! There's something more important than it.
We have a problem. According to our schedule, we were planning to destroy the equipment in Yuno right after destroying the equipment in Lighthalzen..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿！朋友！！还有比这更重要的事。
我们有个麻烦。按照日程安排，我们原本计划在破坏里希塔乐镇的设备后，紧接着去破坏尤诺的设备...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Remember the device that prevented the prohibition equipment from disappearance?
You know that stuff? That is out of order now.
So we have to fix it before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还记得那个防止禁忌设备消失的装置吗？
就是那个东西。它现在出故障了。
所以我们必须在离开前修好它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are dragging on.. You have something to ask me for, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你磨蹭什么呢...你肯定有什么事想求我，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha. You figured it out? We are lucky to have all the materials to repair it, except for one core material. As usual, core materials are always a problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈。你猜到了？我们运气不错，除了一个核心材料外，修复所需的材料都齐了。老样子，核心材料总是个问题。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
So please bring one Star Crumb, the core material. Once you bring it to me, we can repair it and leave right away. I will be ready for it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
所以请带一颗星星的角来，那是核心材料。一旦你把它带给我，我们就能修好它并立刻离开。我会准备好的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
All we have to do is to insert the Star Crumb. So once you bring it, we can leave right away.
Regarding the location and required attribute stone, I will inform you then. I haven't finished collecting the information yet. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们只需要插入星星的角。所以一旦你带来它，我们就能立刻离开。
关于位置和所需的属性石，我到时候会通知你。我还没收集完信息。就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The basic repair is all over.
Now let me insert a Star Crumb, the core material..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
基础修复已经完成了。
现在让我插入核心材料，星星的角...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The basic repairing is all over. But you haven't brought the Star Crumb yet. Please bring it soon.
Let's complete this operation quickly.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
基础修复已经完成了。但你还没带星星的角来。请快点带来。
让我们尽快完成这次行动。
就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The repairing is nearly over. Oh! You've brought it.
Now let me insert a Star Crumb on the device. It's the end of repairing!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
修复快结束了。哦！你带来了。
现在让我把星星的角插入装置。修复即将完成！！

scripts.text: It's quite suspicious that Vero is not looking straight into my eyes. Maybe all he needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning. Shall I ask him about this?
scripts.translation: 维罗不敢直视我的眼睛，这很可疑。也许他从一开始就只需要星星的角。我要问他这件事吗？

scripts.text: Just laugh it off.
scripts.translation: 一笑置之

scripts.text: Ask him.
scripts.translation: 问他

scripts.text: Phew.. Let's just laugh it off. Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation: 呼...还是算了吧。公平起见，就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is suspicious. Tell me honestly.
I won't be mad. All you needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很可疑。老实告诉我。
我不会生气的。你从一开始就只需要星星的角，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
No! What kind of jerk do you take me for? Just look into my eyes!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不！你以为我是那种人吗？看着我的眼睛！

scripts.text: It's very suspicious of him to be mad like it. But I decided to laugh it off.
scripts.translation: 他这么生气，真的很可疑。但我决定一笑置之。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Although there has been a minor incident, now we have two more prohibition equipment devices to destroy.
But since we found the location and attribute of the prohibition equipment installed in Yuno, we can leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
虽然发生了点小插曲，但现在我们还有两台禁忌设备要破坏。
不过既然我们已经找到了尤诺禁忌设备的位置和属性，我们现在就可以出发了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The coordinates of Yuno's prohibition equipments are 206 224
It has a Wind attribute. Our agent will give us a Rough Wind, so we will be able to destroy it once we get there.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
尤诺禁忌设备的坐标是 206 224
它具有风属性。我们的特工会给我们风灵原石，这样我们到达后就能破坏它了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Please get four Great Natures and come to Yuno. They have opposite attributes to the Wind attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
请去收集四块土灵原石，然后来尤诺。它们具有与风属性相反的属性。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
See you in Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们在尤诺见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! Sir, that's not what I am talking about.. You briefly reported to the Rebellion leader regarding what you did with Vero.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！先生，我不是那个意思... 您刚才向反叛者首领汇报了你与维罗一起执行的任务内容。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Have you been doing such a great mission?
But it's strange. I've never been reported that there's been such a mission lately.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你执行了这么重要的任务？
但这很奇怪。我最近从未收到过关于此类任务的报告。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No mission? Then what happened to the mission I did?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有任务？那我执行的任务是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I'm curious about it, too. I know you are exhausted after coming back from your mission. But please tell me about your mission in detail.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我也很好奇。我知道你从任务归来后一定很疲惫。但请详细告诉我关于你任务的情况。

scripts.text: You told the Rebellion leader about what happened during your mission to eliminate Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt with Vero.
scripts.translation: 你向反叛者首领讲述了与维罗一起执行的任务，内容是摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特（Schwaltzvalt）的禁止瞬间移动设备。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Arivero Yurhik.. As you said, that Gunslinger's surname seems to be same with that of Noa here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
阿里维罗·尤尔希克... 正如你所说，那位神枪手的姓氏似乎与这里的诺亚相同。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
But as far as I can remember, there is no Gunslinger named Arivero Yurhik in Clana Nemieri..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
但据我所知，在夜巡者转职考试地点并没有一位名叫阿里维罗·尤尔希克的神枪手...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops?! I don't get it.. Although he disappeared in Einbroch all of a sudden, he was certainly doing the mission with me..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？！我不明白... 虽然他突然在艾音布罗克消失了，但他确实和我在一起执行任务...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Wait! Calm down and listen to me.
The young man named Arivero told you he's a younger brother of Noa. Right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
等等！冷静下来，听我说。
那位名叫阿里维罗的年轻男子告诉你，他是诺亚的弟弟，对吧？

scripts.text: I nodded.
scripts.translation: 我点了点头。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I have a strong feeling that Arivero guy you met is Noa's brother, even if Noa's younger brother died in an accident when he was young.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我强烈感觉你遇到的那个阿里维罗就是诺亚的弟弟，尽管诺亚的弟弟小时候就因事故去世了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really?! Did you say he died..?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？！你说他去世了...？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
In this world, there are so many things that we cannot identify.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
在这个世界上，有很多事情是我们无法确定的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Well! That's all about it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
好了！事情就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I can't tell you any further, because it is Noa's personal information. Let's not talk about this anymore. By the way..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我无法告诉你更多，因为这是诺亚的个人信息。我们不要再谈这个了。顺便说一下...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You did a great job. Maybe, two of you?
You two destroyed all Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt.
Although the mission started unusually, it is surely a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你们做得很好。也许是你们两个人？
你们两人摧毁了施瓦茨瓦尔特所有的禁止瞬间移动设备。
虽然任务开始得很不寻常，但这绝对是一项了不起的成就。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Since it was not an official mission, I cannot give you a huge reward. But it's still a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
由于这不是官方任务，我无法给你们丰厚的奖励。但这仍然是一项了不起的成就。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Let's say this is a small compensation for your great work.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
让我们把这当作对你们出色工作的一点小小补偿吧。

scripts.text:
The Rebellion leader disappeared like that.
What the hell happened to me?
I will remember this as a mission with various questions remaining.
scripts.translation:
反叛者首领就这样消失了。
我到底经历了什么？
我会将这次任务铭记于心，尽管其中仍有许多未解之谜。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。你带来我让你找的那个充满火属性力量的物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet? Please bring an item full of Fire attributes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没吗？请带来一个充满火属性力量的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。你带来我让你找的那个充满火属性力量的物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Flame Heart?
Oh, Flame Heart? I heard it's an item with a strong fire attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
火灵原石？
哦，是火灵原石啊。我听说这是一种火属性非常强的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Shall I try? Let's see. This seems to be the place the agent told us about. Now we have to break the Flame Heart you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
让我试试？看看情况。这里似乎就是特工告诉我们的那个地方。现在我们需要把你带来的火灵原石打碎...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yeah~ Great. It's a success.
The equipment showed up. Yikes! Turn on the device you brought before the equipment disappears..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
耶~ 太好了。成功了。
设备出现了。哎呀！在设备消失之前，快把你带来的装置打开...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It was a vague theory, but it succeeded.
Shall we destroy it, pal?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
虽然只是个模糊的推测，但成功了。
我们要把它毁掉吗，伙计？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What? Why is it unscathed?
I thought the attack was strong enough..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
什么？为什么它完好无损？
我以为攻击足够强了...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
. . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
......

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! Perhaps..? Hey, pal. This equipment has a Fire attribute. What is the attribute opposite to Fire?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
噢！也许...？嘿，伙计。这件设备带有火属性。与火属性相反的是什么属性？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Water.

[Arivero Yurhik]
That's it!! Water!! A water attribute.
If we attack it using a Water attribute, the equipment will be destroyed. Hey, pal. Bring an item with a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
没错！！水！！水属性。
如果我们用水属性攻击它，设备就会被摧毁。嘿，伙计。带来一个水属性很强的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Obviously we will need more than one. Please bring me several of those. I will be guarding here to prevent the equipment from disappearing.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
显然我们需要不止一个。请给我带来几个这样的物品。我会留在这里看守，防止设备消失。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of Water attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。你带来我让你找的那个充满水属性力量的物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet?
We need an item that has a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没吗？
我们需要一个水属性很强的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. But one or two will not be enough.
I think we need at least three of them.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石？确实是一种水属性很强的物品。没错。水灵原石足以满足我们的需求。但一两个是不够的。
我想我们至少需要三个。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. Let's try it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石？确实是一种水属性很强的物品。没错。水灵原石足以满足我们的需求。让我们试试。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! We destroyed the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！我们摧毁了设备。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good job, pal.
Although we destroyed the equipment, there is some magic power remaining. Therefore, teleporting will not be possible in this area for a while.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
干得好，伙计。
虽然我们摧毁了设备，但仍残留着一些魔力。因此，这个区域暂时无法使用瞬间移动。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
But, eventually, teleporting will become possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不过，最终，瞬间移动功能会恢复的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We destroyed the prohibition equipment. Now let's go back to Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们摧毁了禁忌装备。现在让我们回到夜巡者转职考试地点。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
抱歉！抱歉！其实我早就到了。但我必须找特工确认准确的位置。我应该早点到并通知你的。抱歉让你一个人跑来这里。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You're so great!
Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你太厉害了！
只凭那些信息就一路找来了！我找不到这里，所以不得不去见特工。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
重要的是我们都安全地到了这里。记得我让你带一个水灵原石和三个风灵原石吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Where are the items I asked you for?
We must destroy this before they realize that the equipment items are being destroyed one by one. Bring them quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我让你带的物品在哪里？
在他们发现装备正被逐个摧毁之前，我们必须销毁这个。快拿来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops! There's someone passing by.
I might look suspicious, so I will hide myself.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
糟糕！有人经过。
我看起来可能很可疑，所以我要躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
抱歉！抱歉！其实我早就到了。但我必须找特工确认准确的位置。我应该早点到并通知你的。抱歉让你一个人跑来这里。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You're so great!
Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你太厉害了！
只凭那些信息就一路找来了！我找不到这里，所以不得不去见特工。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
重要的是我们都安全地到了这里。记得我让你带一个水灵原石和三个风灵原石吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen. The location is clear, because I checked it with our agent. If we break the Mystic Frozen you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石。位置很明确，因为我通过特工确认过了。如果我们把你带来的水灵原石打碎...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good! The equipment has showed up..
And we installed the device we brought..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
很好！装备出现了...
而且我们安装了带来的装置...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great. Now we can destroy it. Prepare the Rough Wind.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了。现在我们可以摧毁它了。准备好风灵原石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Nevertheless, the first one is always tough and it is easier from the second one. Now let us disappear with teleporting..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不过，第一个总是最难搞定的，从第二个开始就容易多了。现在让我们用瞬间移动消失吧...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
. . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
......

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yikes! I almost forgot.
We cannot teleport immediately after destroying it. I told you about it and I forgot it myself! What a shame.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀！我差点忘了。
摧毁后不能立刻使用瞬间移动。我告诉过你的，结果我自己都忘了！真丢人。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Ha! In the past, due to the magic power of this prohibition equipment.. Oh! It's nothing.
We cannot help walking.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈！过去，由于这件禁忌装备的魔力... 哦！没什么。
我们只能走路离开了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
To avoid getting caught, let's scatter.
See you in Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
为了避免被抓，我们分散行动吧。
夜巡者转职考试地点见。

scripts.text: Is this it? The mansion surrounded by water? According to the condition, it seems like it.
scripts.translation: 是这个吗？被水包围的豪宅？根据条件，看起来像是这里。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops?! My hot friend has already arrived.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀？！我的老朋友已经先到了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal! I have just arrived now. I summoned the equipment and mounted it to prevent from disappearing.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计！我刚到。我召唤了装备并安装好，以防它消失。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Have you brought Great Nature?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带土灵原石了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet. I will be guarding this here. Please bring it quickly.
According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没。我会在这里看守。请快点拿来。
根据特工的消息，雷肯贝尔和政府现在很认真。
我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are a reliable friend of mine.
Since we don't have enough time, let's destroy the equipment quickly and go to Einbroch. According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你是我可靠的朋友。
既然时间不多，我们赶紧摧毁装备，然后去艾音布罗克。根据特工的消息，雷肯贝尔和政府现在很认真。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I will destroy the equipment right now.
Prepare Great Nature.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我现在就摧毁装备。
准备好土灵原石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We destroyed the prohibition equipment and there appear to be.. no eyewitnesses. Just in case, let's scatter and move to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们摧毁了禁止传送设备，而且似乎没有目击者。为了保险起见，我们分散行动，前往艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! I haven't told you the location.
It is the place where Einbroch Wind turbine is located. You bring three Flame Hearts and one remaining Great Nature. We will use them to destroy the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！我还没告诉你地点。
就在艾音布罗克的风车那里。你带三块火灵原石和一块剩下的土灵原石过来。我们要用它们来摧毁设备。

scripts.text: Vero disappeared in a hurry, as if he was being chased by something. Take three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature and go to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 维罗匆忙消失了，好像被什么东西追赶着。带上三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石，去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
have you brought three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石了吗？

scripts.text: Vero is pressing me, as if he does not have much time left. Something is fish. But I'm not asking him, as I know he won't tell me.
scripts.translation: 维罗催得很急，好像时间不多了。有些不对劲。但我没有问他，因为我知道他不会告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Please. And the last one is...
No! Nothing. Please bring it here as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
拜托了。还有最后一件东西...
不！没什么。请快点把它带过来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! Destroy the Great Nature now, so that the equipment will show up!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
很好！现在摧毁土灵原石，让设备显现出来！！

scripts.text: His voice betrays his panic. And he also asked me to do the job that he had been doing by himself. Is there something wrong? I was curious. I broke the Great Nature into pieces as he asked.
scripts.translation: 他的声音泄露了恐慌。他还让我做他之前独自做的工作。是不是出了什么事？我很好奇。我按照他的要求把土灵原石敲碎了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Now! Time to use the Flame Heart!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
现在！是时候用火灵原石了！

scripts.text: As Vero asked me, I smashed the Teleport Prohibition equipment with the Flame Heart.
scripts.translation: 按照维罗的要求，我用火灵原石砸毁了禁止瞬间移动的装置。

scripts.text: The equipment was destroyed quickly. Then I realized that Vero looked a bit abnormal. Is he sick or something?
scripts.translation: 装置很快就被摧毁了。然后我意识到维罗看起来有点不对劲。他是生病了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey, pal! I know I have been naughty. But, thanks to your support, I managed to eliminate every Teleport Prohibition equipment in Schwaltzvalt.
Thank you for helping me. This was my wish.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿，伙计！我知道我一直很调皮。但多亏了你的支持，我成功清除了施瓦茨瓦尔特所有的禁止传送设备。
谢谢你的帮助。这是我的愿望。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What.. Why are you saying that?
As if you were going far away?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...你为什么要这么说？
好像你要去很远的地方？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What's that look? Hahaha. I would like to take a photo of you. Well..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
那是什么表情？哈哈。我想给你拍张照片。好吧...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I must be showing my gratitude now. But I have to ask you for one more favor. Please talk to my elder sister once in a while. She is lonely quite often..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我现在应该表达感谢。但我还得请你再帮个忙。请偶尔和我姐姐聊聊天。她经常很孤独...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh.. It's time.. Bye.. Thanks..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦...时间到了...再见...谢谢...

scripts.text:
Vero disappeared all of a sudden after saying goodbye. What's going on here? Has he been summoned for an urgent mission?
Vero's gone. Shall I go back to Clana Nemieri?
scripts.translation:
维罗道别后突然消失了。这里到底发生了什么？他是被紧急征召了吗？
维罗走了。我要回夜巡者转职考试地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You...?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你...？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You... You're the adventurer who showed up with the Secret Wings.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你...你是那个带着秘密翅膀出现的冒险者。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: You told him what you heard from Elena Volkova and asked him for a consultation.
scripts.translation: 你告诉他从埃琳娜·沃尔科娃那里听到的消息，并请求他提供咨询。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
If it was about the Secret Wings, I would not have mentioned anything. But for that issue, I will help you.
As commander Volkova said, I brought those kids.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
如果是关于秘密翅膀的事，我本不该多嘴。但既然涉及这个问题，我会帮你的。
正如沃尔科娃指挥官所说，我把那些孩子带来了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...I heard what happened to them lately. But I didn't know they were suffering like that.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...我最近听说了他们的遭遇。但我没想到他们会过得那么辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I want to talk to Lebedev twins myself. But it is an arrogation and it will be bad for Commander Volkova.
Commander Volkova knows that too. That's why she sent you.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我想亲自和列别捷夫双胞胎谈谈。但这属于越权行为，对沃尔科娃指挥官不利。
沃尔科娃指挥官也明白这一点。所以她才派你来。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
There are some people who do not like commander Volkova.
Her unit is USU. The commander didn't manage to take care of her squadders so the squadders talked to their former commander? It's a bad scenario.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
有些人并不喜欢沃尔科娃指挥官。
她的部队是USU。如果指挥官没能照顾好她的斯夸德，斯夸德们就会去找他们的前任指挥官？那可不是什么好局面。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Let me give you this. Eat them together with the twins. And tell them to trust me and tell their problems to you.
Forget advices or recommendations and just listen to them for a while. They are good kids and they will definitely understand you. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
把这个给你。和双胞胎一起吃吧。告诉他们要信任我，把他们的烦恼都告诉你。
别急着给建议或推荐，先听他们说说。他们是好孩子，一定会理解你的。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You're back! Don't be so nervous. They are good kids. Go speak to them.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你回来了！别那么紧张。他们是好孩子。去和他们对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Don't preach at them too much. If they have problems, listen to them. Make sure you give them cookies.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
别对他们说教太多。如果他们有问题，就听他们说。记得给他们绿饼人。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Cookies? Lebedev twins made them?
Then I have no choice but to eat them. Give them to me.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
绿饼人？是列别捷夫双胞胎做的吗？
那我别无选择，只能吃了。给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You said there were cookies. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你刚才说有绿饼人。在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Smells good. Of course it's not as good as Lucy's...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
闻起来不错。当然，没有露西做的好吃...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Hmm, good! Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
嗯，不错！替我谢谢他们。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I'm happy, thank you. One bouquet for today is enough.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我很高兴，谢谢。今天的一束花足够了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You must have other things to do, come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你肯定还有其他事要做，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...?
You...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...？
你...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You are the adventurer who created a huge noise in our hideout.
By the way, ... Hmm, no. Never mind.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你是那个在我们据点制造巨大噪音的冒险者。
顺便说一句...嗯，算了。没什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(... Seems like he wants to say something.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...感觉他有什么话想说。）

scripts.text: Would you like to say anything?
scripts.translation: 你想说点什么吗？

scripts.text: See you.
scripts.translation: 再见。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oops, sorry. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
哎呀，抱歉。回头见。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oh, actually... I wanted to ask you for a little favor.
You'll have to visit Einbroch for a while. Would you accept it?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
啊，其实...我想请你帮个小忙。
你需要去艾音布罗克待一会儿。你愿意吗？

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮您的。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Sorry for this inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thanks. It's not a tough job.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find a ^0000CDflower girl^000000.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢。任务不难。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走，你会遇到一位^0000CD卖花女孩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Could you buy a Bunch Of Flowers from that kid and lay it beneath the tree beside her?
There is a small sign below the tree, so you will find it easily.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
请从那个女孩那里买一束花，放在她旁边的树下。
树下有个小牌子，很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I will count on you. Come back and report, I mean... tell me.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
拜托你了。回来告诉我...我是说，向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oh, it's you.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
哦，是你啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've spoken with Lucy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我和露西谈过了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Good. How was her health?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
很好。她身体怎么样？

scripts.text: She was fine.
scripts.translation: 她很好。

scripts.text: She was talking about you.
scripts.translation: 她在谈论你。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Really? That's good. Didn't she say anything else to you?
Great. Please don't tell about it anyone else except Lebedev twins.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
是吗？那很好。她没跟你说别的吗？
很好。除了列别捷夫双胞胎，请不要告诉任何人这件事。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
They used to help me for this. But I cannot request them now.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
他们以前帮我做过这件事。但现在我不能请求他们了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I see. What did she say?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我明白了。她说了什么？

scripts.text: You told him what you heard from Lucy.
scripts.translation: 你告诉他你从露西那里听到的话。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...Perhaps there must have been a huge misunderstanding.
Please don't tell about it anyone else in the Rebellion, except Lebedev twins.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...也许这是一个巨大的误会。
除了列别捷夫双胞胎，请不要告诉反叛者中的任何人。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
If only she was alive...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
如果她还活着就好了...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
No, I shouldn't think like that.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
不，我不该这么想。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thank you for going.
If you do not mind, will you stop by sometimes and put down some flowers?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢你跑了一趟。
如果不介意的话，以后有空时能顺便来放些花吗？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Will you stop by Einbroch again and offer flowers?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你会再去艾音布罗克献花吗？

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮您的。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Is that so.
I'm sorry. It's not fun anyway.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
是吗。
抱歉，反正也没什么意思。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I hope you can stop by later when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
希望你有空时能再来一趟。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
There is a tree on the south side from the Einbroch observatory. You will find a ^0000CDflower girl^000000 nearby.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
在艾音布罗克天文台的南边有一棵树，附近能找到一位^0000CD卖花女孩^000000。
非常感谢。

scripts.text: I've been to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 我去过艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thank you for going. I'd have to stop by myself, but I seldom have time.
Because these are busy times.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢你跑了一趟。我自己也得去一趟，但很少有时间。
因为最近很忙。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello. How about a flower?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好。要不要买束花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please bring me a bouquet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请给我一束花。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Yes, I understand!
Oh, what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
好的，我明白了！
哎呀，该怎么办呢...

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
I have the flowers, but I ran out of paper to make a bouquet.
The shop I usually buy the paper from is closed...
I cannot go very far alone.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
我有花，但用来包花的纸用完了。
我平时买纸的店关门了...
我一个人走不了太远。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Please.
If you bring ^0000CD3 Slick Paper^000000, I will make a bouquet for you without having to pay for the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
拜托了。
如果你带来^0000CD3张光滑的纸^000000，我就免费为你包一束花。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Did you bring ^0000CD3 Slick Paper^000000?
If you bring, I will make a bouquet for you without having to pay for the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你带了^0000CD3张光滑的纸^000000吗？
如果你带来，我就免费为你包一束花。

scripts.text: Hand over the slick paper.
scripts.translation: 交出光滑的纸

scripts.text: Do not give the paper.
scripts.translation: 不给纸

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oh, I'm sorry... Didn't you need a bouquet?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
啊，抱歉...你不是需要一束花吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Here, this bouquet is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
给你，这束花很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello, welcome back. Which flower do you need?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好，欢迎回来。你需要哪种花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could you make me a Bunch Of Flowers with carnations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能用康乃馨给我做一束花吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oops... As you know, I still don't have enough paper to wrap the flower.
If you bring me ^0000CDthree smooth paper^000000, I will make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀...你知道的，我还没有足够的纸来包花。
如果你给我^0000CD三张光滑的纸^000000，我就为你做。

scripts.text: Hand over the slick paper.
scripts.translation: 交出光滑的纸

scripts.text: Do not give the paper.
scripts.translation: 不给纸

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oops! Sorry. A Bunch Of Flowers... Don't you need it?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀！抱歉。一束花...你不是需要吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Sorry. If I don't have enough smooth paper, I cannot make a Bunch Of Flowers...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
抱歉。如果没有足够的光滑的纸，我就做不出一束花...

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Here, this bouquet is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
给你，这束花很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Flower quickly wither, but they are beautiful when they bloom.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
花儿虽然很快就会枯萎，但盛开时真的很美。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello, you're here again. What flowers do you need?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好，你又来了。你需要什么花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can you make a bouquet of carnations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能做一束康乃馨吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oh my... I'm sorry, I still don't have enough paper to make a bouquet...
If you bring 3 pieces of ^0000CD smooth paper ^000000, I will make it.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀...抱歉，我还没有足够的纸来做花束...
如果你给我3张^0000CD光滑的纸^000000，我就给你做。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Flowers, buy some flowers.
Phew... The air is so hazy that the flowers wither quickly...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
卖花啦，买些花吧。
呼...空气太浑浊了，花儿很快就枯萎了...

scripts.text: You searched through your back.
scripts.translation: 你翻遍了背包。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I put the flower...?
It's not there. Maybe I should buy another one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把花放哪儿了...？
不在那里。也许我该再买一束...

scripts.text:
[Strange Voice]
There is a small sign in front of the tree.
 
 - Here lies a kind {0} -
 
Should I put the bouquet down?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的声音]
树前有一块小牌子。
 
 - 这里长眠着一位善良的{0} -
 
我要把花束放下吗？

scripts.text: Put the bouquet down.
scripts.translation: 放下花束

scripts.text: Don't put the bouquet down.
scripts.translation: 不放下花束

scripts.text: Before laying the flower, you checked whether that tree was the right one.
scripts.translation: 在放下花之前，你确认了一下这棵树是不是正确的那棵。

scripts.text: I put down the Cherished Bouquet and took a moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 我放下了吊唁花篮，默哀片刻。

scripts.text:
[Strange Voice]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的声音]
谁在那里？

scripts.text: Beside the tree, a small grandmother held out her hand.
scripts.translation: 树旁，一位矮小的老奶奶伸出了手。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Do you... know who it is? did you know Irene??
Looking at the clothes, I think you're a traveler. My memory is fading.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你...知道她是谁吗？你认识艾琳吗？
看你的穿着，我想你是一位旅行者。我的记忆有些模糊了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here out of a favor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受人之托来的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
A favor? Adler's and that?
I'm Irene's grandmother who fell asleep here. My name is Lucy.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
受人之托？是阿德勒和那个吗？
我是艾琳的奶奶，在这里睡着了。我叫露西。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
At this time of year, Adler is the children who come to me always at this time of year, but this year I will not be able to candles.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
每到这个时候，阿德勒都会带着孩子们来找我，但今年我恐怕无法点亮蜡烛了。

scripts.text: Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 再见。

scripts.text: Report on Commander Ericsson and Mrs. Irene.
scripts.translation: 汇报关于指挥官埃里克森和艾琳夫人的事

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Bye. Thank you for coming all the way to this countryside.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
再见。谢谢你特意来到这乡下地方。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Irene will thank you. Bye...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
艾琳会感谢你的。再见...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did commander Adler know Irene?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿德勒指挥官是怎么认识艾琳的？

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Commander?
...So it was true. Mr. Adler was a soldier with high position after all.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
指挥官？
...原来是真的。阿德勒先生果然是位地位很高的军人。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Although it's a long story to tell a stranger, I will tell you. And you've been sent by Mr. Adler..
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
虽然对陌生人说来话长，但我会告诉你的。而且你是阿德勒先生派来的...

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
I've been living in Einbech with Irene for a long time.
Irene's mom and dad left the house seeking a better job. It's been more than 10 years since we lost contact.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
我和艾琳在艾音贝赫住了很久。
艾琳的父母为了寻找更好的工作离开了家。我们已经失去联系十多年了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
As you know, there are many accidents in Einbech.
There were only old people left in the village. So it must have been boring for Irene. But she didn't want to move to another village because she believed that her parents would come back one day.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
你也知道，艾音贝赫经常发生事故。
村里只剩下老人了。对艾琳来说一定很无聊。但她不想搬去别的村子，因为她相信父母总有一天会回来。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
And... About this time that year, it was when the mine was not closed yet. I heard a rumor that there were bad guys called rebel forces deep inside the mine.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
还有...大约在那个时候，矿场还没有关闭。我听说矿场深处有一群被称为叛军的坏人。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
She would go to the mine every day to sell some food. And on that day, I told her not to go there.
But she said it would be okay and went to the mine...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
她每天都去矿场卖一些食物。那天，我劝她不要去那里。
但她说不碍事，还是去了矿场...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Grandma Lucy started to shed tears and you handed her your handkerchief)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（露西奶奶流下了眼泪，你递给了她手帕）

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thank you... There was an accident on that day... One of the tunnels was collapsed and some people never came back.
Irene was one of them...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
谢谢...那天发生了事故...其中一个隧道坍塌了，有些人再也没有回来。
艾琳就是其中之一...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must have been devastated...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您一定很痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Although they said it was an accident, there was a rumor.
People told me that there were bad guys hiding in the mine and soldiers came to get them.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
虽然说是事故，但有些传言。
人们告诉我，有坏人藏在矿场里，士兵们去抓他们。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
But it was not important to me at all.
I just felt devastated to lose my son, daughter-in-law and granddaughter. I was absent-minded and did not find any reason to live on...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
但这对我来说并不重要。
我只是因为失去了儿子、儿媳和孙女而悲痛欲绝。我神志恍惚，找不到活下去的理由...

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
That's when Mr. Adler visited me.
I was so surprised when he knocked the door of my house...He came in and bowed down to me all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
就在那时，阿德勒先生来拜访我。
当他敲我家门时，我非常惊讶...他进来后突然向我鞠躬。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
I was surprised again and asked him why. Then he told me about Irene.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
我很惊讶，问他为什么。然后他告诉了我关于艾琳的事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
He said that Irene's death was his fault and apologized knocking his head on the floor...
I didn't know what was going on and just told him to stop it.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
他说艾琳的死是他的错，并磕头道歉...
我不知道发生了什么，只是让他别这样。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
He didn't tell me a detailed story. He left the house and came back later. Then he would send flowers and money to me.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
他没有告诉我详细经过。他离开了家，后来又来了。然后他会给我送花和钱。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thanks to his support, I recovered myself. Then I moved to Einbroche and planted this tree to remember Irene.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
多亏了他的支持，我恢复了精神。后来我搬到了艾因布洛克，种下这棵树来纪念艾琳。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Every time he gave me flowers or money, I always refused. But he insisted to give them to me...
I wondered why he was doing this. Nevertheless, he was a high-ranking soldier...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
每次他给我送花或钱，我都拒绝了。但他坚持要给我...
我想知道他为什么这么做。不过，他确实是一位高级军官...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
.........
Thank you very much for telling me the hard story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
.........
非常感谢您告诉我这段痛苦的经历。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Welcome. Thanks to you, I heard the story about Mr. Adler. It makes me feel much better now.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
欢迎。多亏了你，我听到了关于阿德勒先生的故事。这让我感觉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thank you. If you don't mind, please stop by my house occasionally and talk to this old woman...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
谢谢你。如果不介意的话，请偶尔来我家坐坐，陪陪这个老婆子...

scripts.text: You searched through your back.
scripts.translation: 你翻遍了背包。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I put the flower...?
It's not there. Maybe I should buy another one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把花放哪儿了...？
不在那里。也许我该再买一束...

scripts.text: You dedicated the Bunch Of Flowers and paid a silent tribute briefly.
scripts.translation: 你献上了一束鲜花，并默默致意片刻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rest in peace, Irene...

[Grandma Lucy]
Traveler. You came again. Thank you.
If you see Mr. Adler, please send him my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
旅行者。你又来了。谢谢你。
如果你见到阿德勒先生，请转达我的谢意。

scripts.text: Just then, you met grandma Lucy near the tree and said hello to her.
scripts.translation: 就在这时，你在树旁遇到了露西奶奶，并向她打了个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Huge Tree]
There is a small sign in front of the tree.
- Here lies a kind girl -
scripts.translation:
[巨树]
树前立着一块小牌子。
- 这里长眠着一位善良的女孩 -

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临。这里是武器店，夜巡者转职考试地点。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
We have various weapons including firearms, gunpowder, cannon, mortar and Molotov cocktails. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我们这里有各种武器，包括枪械、火药、大炮、迫击炮和燃烧瓶。请常来光顾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Oh, you only have firearms!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...哦，你们只有枪械！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Firearms are the tres... Sorry? Nemi? We are closed today?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
枪械是至...抱歉？内米？我们今天休息吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Ah.. Yes. We are closed today. Please visit us later.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
啊...是的。我们今天休息。请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
About the twins in our unit? You are an adventurer. Why do you ask me such a thing?
I am not interested in you and the noisy tourist either.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
关于我们部队的那对双胞胎？你是冒险者。为什么问这种问题？
我对你和那个吵闹的游客都不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
......Phew, a request from commander Volkova... I have no choice but to answer you. But I can only tell you negative things about those kids.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
......呼，沃尔科娃指挥官的请求...我别无选择，只能回答你。但我只能告诉你那些孩子的坏话。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
There's nothing they can do properly. Plus, they don't even listen to us.
They are the worst kids. I don't know why we have to keep them here.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们什么都做不好。而且，他们根本不听我们的话。
他们是最差劲的孩子。我不知道为什么我们要留他们在这里。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Can you see the bandage here? I got this injury by the stray bullet shot by the boy.
They are idiots who cannot even hit an automatic target. They were terrible as if they did not hit it on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你能看到这里的绷带吗？这是我被那个男孩射出的流弹打伤的。
他们是一群连自动靶都打不中的白痴。他们糟糕得好像故意打不中似的。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
That's why I had to move to here, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
所以我才搬到了这里，夜巡者转职考试地点。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Well, this job fits in my talents...
The fact I dislike those kids is a different story.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
嗯，这份工作很适合我的才能...
至于我讨厌那些孩子，那是另一回事。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
After being deployed in the actual battle, they made trouble and run away. I don't know why they call them genius. Someone like me can be called genius.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
在实战部署后，他们惹了麻烦然后逃跑了。我不知道为什么他们被称为天才。像我这样的人才能被称为天才。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
People were just excited about small kids shooting guns.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
人们只是对小孩子开枪感到兴奋罢了。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Cookies? Hmm, let me see. Where did you get these?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
饼干？嗯，让我看看。你从哪里弄来的？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
......Made by those kids?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
......是那些小孩做的？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
No, no. I don't have any prejudice against them any more.
Please give it to me. Let me judge it with my talented taste!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不，不。我现在对他们没有偏见。
请给我尝尝。让我用我天才般的味觉来评判一下！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Why aren't you giving me the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你为什么不把饼干给我？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please give it to me. I won't be too harsh.
You don't have them?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
请给我。我不会太苛刻的。
你没有带吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...Hmm... Yum yum...
Well, not bad.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...嗯...好吃好吃...
嗯，还不错。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
It is dry and I feel like it's not fully baked. It's too sweet and the shapes are not consistent. But...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
有点干，感觉没烤熟。太甜了，形状也不统一。但是...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I can see how much effort they gave to make them. It's delicious.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我能看出他们花了很多心思。很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临。这里是武器店，夜巡者转职考试地点。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Phew... Oh, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呼...啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
You... Yeah. You're the one who made a fuss in there, aren't you?
It's good. I would like to ask you for a favor. Will you accept it?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你...是的。你就是刚才在里面大闹的那位，对吧？
很好。我想请你帮个忙。你愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I will give you an opportunity to be in charge of one wing of my talented work.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我会给你一个机会，负责我天才作品的一个部分。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Talented work?

[Mason Bender]
Well, it's a figure of speech. Haha...
Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
嗯，那是个比喻。哈哈...
你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他。

scripts.text: I don't feel good about him. Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 对他没好感。无视他。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Phew... You have been stimulated by my talented eloquence. That's why you cannot even respond. Of course I understand it...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呼...你被我的天才口才所震撼了。所以你甚至无法回应。我当然能理解...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please calm down and talk to me again. Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
请冷静下来，再和我谈谈。呼呼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Not even close!

[Mason Bender]
Great. You've been persuaded by my talented eloquence.
So here's my request.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
很好。你被我的天才口才说服了。
那么，这是我的请求。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
This is the leaflet of our weapon store that I prepared with my talented writing skill.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
这是我用天才的写作技巧准备的武器店传单。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Any who reads this will definitely come to this store and buy 81mm mortar.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
任何读到这份传单的人，一定会来到这家店购买81mm迫击炮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Who's going to buy such a stuff?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（谁会买这种东西啊？！）

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
But I have a slight problem.
Although I bring these to the village bench or plaza, none of the villagers take the leaflet.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不过我有个小问题。
虽然我把传单放在村子的长椅或广场上，但村民们都不肯拿。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Therefore! You bring this yourself! And give the leaflets kindly to each person. Make sure you pass it on someone's hand with a kind smlie on your face.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
所以！你自己去发！
面带微笑，亲切地把传单递给每一个人。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Nemi has been angry about this malignity stock. If you do that, they will surely be sold well. Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
内米一直为这些滞销的库存感到烦恼。
如果你这么做，它们肯定能卖得很好。呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now! I will give you the leaflets. See you!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
好了！我把传单给你。再见！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
现在，就拜托你了。
在此期间，我会准备好接待顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Whoops... Have you lost the leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哎呀...你把传单弄丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please don't mistreat the leaflets. This time, I will give them to you again.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
请别糟蹋传单。
这次，我再给你一份。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now! There you go!
You will be spreading my talented writing in the entire village!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
好了！给你！
你将把我天才的文案传遍整个村庄！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome back! How did they respond?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎回来！反响如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Just so so...

[Mason Bender]
Oh? Really?!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哦？真的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
... Oh, I see. My pink brain cells finished the deduction!
They haven't read my leaflets yet!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...啊，我明白了。我粉红色的脑细胞完成了推理！
他们还没读我的传单！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
They were fascinated by my talented opening so they forgot to read the rest of the leaflet!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们被我天才的开头迷住了，以至于忘了读剩下的部分！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Huhu... I can't do anything about it. Let us wait evenly.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呼呼...我也没办法。让我们耐心等待吧。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
There will be so many people visiting us tomorrow. So I will ask Eri about how to receive many customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
明天会有很多人来光顾。所以我要问问绘理如何接待这么多顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
If you don't mind, could you please come back tomorrow and help me receiving customers? Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
如果不介意的话，明天能回来帮我接待顾客吗？呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome! Glad to meet you! Have you come to buy the mortar... Oh?
... It's you, adventurer. Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临！很高兴见到你！你是来买迫击炮的吗...哦？
...是你啊，冒险者。欢迎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait. Were you disappointed! You were!
Seems like your business is in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等。你失望了！你确实失望了。
看来你的生意不太顺利啊。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
No! The buyers are strategically judging the situation. In other words, they are warming up.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不！买家们正在战略性地评估局势。换句话说，他们正在热身。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Soon they will realize that buying this mortar will bring them great profit and rush to Clana Nemieri! Come on, if you are not buying anything, please leave! Come back later!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
很快他们就会意识到购买这门迫击炮能带来巨大利润，然后涌向夜巡者转职考试地点！喂，如果你不买任何东西，请离开！稍后再来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many of them did you sell!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你卖出了多少门？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
^FF0000Please leave!!!^000000

[Nemi]
How many of them? Not a single mortar.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
多少门？一门迫击炮都没卖出去。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Mason is an excellent sniper and people called him genius. After he got injured, he volunteered here provisionally and now he loves this job.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
梅森是一名优秀的神射手，人们称他为天才。受伤后，他自愿暂时在这里工作，现在他很喜欢这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Although he does not have any talent in commerce, he is misunderstanding something by chance. Now he is so excited and has too many irons in the fire.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
虽然他在商业方面没有任何天赋，但他碰巧误解了某些事情。现在他非常兴奋，同时处理的事情太多了。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
I guess we have to stop him as soon as possible.
Otherwise the store might be completely ruined.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
我想我们必须尽快阻止他。
否则商店可能会彻底完蛋。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
I apologize on behalf of Mason that he kicked you out. Please come back tomorrow and give him a valuable advice so that he can rouse himself.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
我代表梅森向您道歉，因为他把您赶了出去。请明天回来给他一些宝贵的建议，让他清醒一下。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome! Clana Nemieri... Oh?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临！夜巡者转职考试地点...哦？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...Oh, what is it? {0}, it was you. I thought it was a customer...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...哦，怎么了？{0}，原来是你。我还以为是顾客...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you sell your cannons?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你卖掉那些大炮了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
They are mortars, not cannons. I thought they would be sold today...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
那是迫击炮，不是大炮。我以为今天能卖出去...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
This is strange. According to my calculation, these mortars should have been sold today... And four days later, we are supposed to reach the break-even point. After that, we will begin the turnaround.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
这很奇怪。根据我的计算，这些迫击炮今天应该能卖出去...四天后，我们就能达到盈亏平衡点。之后，我们就会开始扭亏为盈。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I don't know why. Hmm..
While I analyze the phenomenon, {0} could you please hand out the leaflets to villagers once again?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我不知道为什么。嗯..
在我解析这一现象的同时，{0}你能再向村民们分发一次传单吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Go to the village and find three people who seem to need the mortar earnestly. And give them these leaflets.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
去村庄里找三个看起来非常需要迫击炮的人。然后把这些传单给他们。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我会去做的。

scripts.text: Sorry. I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。我不做。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Come on... Why aren't you helping me?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
拜托...你为什么不帮我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, nobody needs a mortar here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，这里没有人需要迫击炮。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
If you can only sell something to someone who needs it, you are a newbie. I will sell something to some people, and they will need it just because they bought it!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
如果你只能把东西卖给需要它的人，那你还是个新手。我会把东西卖给一些人，他们买了之后就会需要它！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I will sell electric heaters to the people of Moroc. And I will sell refrigerators in Manuc!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我要向莫洛克的居民推销电暖器。
还要在曼努克推销冰箱！

scripts.text:
[Eri]
...I hope he uses that passion elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
...希望他把这份热情用在别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
My brain cells already knew that you would accept it.
Three sheets of leaflets. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我的脑细胞早就知道你会答应。
三张传单。就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I don't think there will be anyone who seem to need the mortar earnestly)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我觉得不会有人真的迫切需要迫击炮）

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
现在，就拜托你了。
在此期间，我会准备好接待顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Whoops... Have you lost the leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哎呀...你把传单弄丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please don't mistreat the leaflets. This time, I will give them to you again.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
请别糟蹋传单。
这次，我再给你一份。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
现在，就拜托你了。
在此期间，我会准备好接待顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome back! How did they respond?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎回来！反响如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Just so so...

[Mason Bender]
Oh? Really?!
If I were you, I would have read the strong desire and flutter toward mortars in their eyes using my talented intuition.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哦？真的吗？！
如果是我的话，早就用我敏锐的直觉，看出他们眼中对迫击炮的渴望和向往了。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Then I will get ready to receive customers again!
I will be busy tomorrow. If you want to visit us, make a reservation in advance.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
那么，我要准备再次接待顾客了！
明天会很忙。如果你想来光顾，请提前预约。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
After working hard all day long, I enjoy watching the railway and smoking a cigarette. That's the pleasure of my life.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
辛苦工作一整天后，我喜欢看着铁路，抽根烟。这就是我的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
I call it a pleasure... What's wrong with my life?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
我称之为乐趣...我的生活有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Oh, I won't buy it. Besides, you're empty-handed.
I'm so tired after a hard work. Don't annoy me and just leave.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
哦，我不买。而且你两手空空。
工作了一天我很累。别烦我，快走吧。

scripts.text: You handed him the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给他传单。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
What's this? A leaflet? I'm not interested... What the hell do you sell there?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
这是什么？传单？我不感兴趣...你卖什么鬼东西？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Mortar? Are we having a war? Why would I buy it?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
迫击炮？我们要打仗吗？我为什么要买？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Oh, no. I won't buy it.
I'm so tired after a hard work. Don't annoy me and just leave.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
哦，不。我不买。
工作了一天我很累。别烦我，快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
Look at the muddy water that does not reflect anything.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
看看这浑浊的水，什么都映不出来。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
Not a single fish lives here. What's going to happen to this village after the remaining old men are gone?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
这里连一条鱼都没有。等剩下的老人都走了，这个村庄会变成什么样？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
No. I don't need a cannon.
No matter how much you suggest it to me, I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
不。我不需要大炮。
无论你怎么向我推销，我都不需要。

scripts.text: You handed him the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给他传单。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
What is this... What do you ask me to buy? A cannon? Why would I need it?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
这是什么...你让我买什么？大炮？我为什么需要它？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
I will take the leaflets if you give me... But I only need a little amount of gunpowder in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
如果你给我...我就收下传单。但我只需要在矿里用一点点火药。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
No. I don't need a cannon.
No matter how much you suggest it to me, I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
不。我不需要大炮。
无论你怎么向我推销，我都不需要。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
At my age... The only pleasure is to be bathed in the sun sitting in a warm place.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
到了我这个年纪...唯一的乐趣就是坐在温暖的地方晒太阳。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
I cannot see and hear well. But listen carefully and don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
我看不太清也听不太清。但请仔细听，别担心。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What? Lunch? I've had it already. By the way, you didn't even bring any food.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
什么？午饭？我已经吃过了。顺便说一句，你连食物都没带。

scripts.text: You handed her the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给了她传单。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What is this? I can't see it properly. Is it a baked chestnut? Looks like a sheet of paper to me.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
这是什么？我看不太清楚。是烤栗子吗？看起来像是一张纸。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
Dried filefish fillet? Are you selling it? Oh, I don't have tooth so I can't eat it.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
干鲳鱼片？你是要卖给我吗？哦，我没牙，吃不了这个。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What? Lunch? I've had it already. Hehe...
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
什么？午饭？我已经吃过了。呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It's not my fault that our meals are terrible.
If they give me more time and budget, I can cook much better food.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
饭菜难吃不是我的错。
如果给我更多时间和预算，我能做出更好的食物。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Phew, what should I serve the gluttons today? What would they like...?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
呼，今天该给那些大胃王们上什么菜呢？他们会喜欢什么...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
The reputation of the twins in USU? You're an adventurer. Why do you ask such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
USU那对双胞胎的名声？你是冒险者，为什么要问这种事？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You have been requested by that unit... Then I should tell you.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
你是受那个部队委托来的...那我应该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Several years ago, commander Ericsson brought them here.
Sounds like he brought them from an orphanage.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
几年前，指挥官埃里克森把她们带到这里。
听起来像是从孤儿院带过来的。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They took the training without any problem and excelled in shooting. They quickly were able to play a role of a Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们顺利完成了训练，并在射击方面表现出色。很快就能胜任反叛者的角色了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They have been trainees for a while and several month ago, they went on the real mission for the first time. That's when they stirred up trouble.
Some people said that the younger sister threw a grenade at the civilian zone. But I don't know the exact story.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们当了一段时间的学员，几个月前第一次执行真正的任务。就是那时她们惹了麻烦。
有人说妹妹向平民区投掷了手榴弹。但我不知道确切的情况。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
After that, they were moved to USU, became more educated, etc. There was a fuss.
That's when they began to disobey their seniors.
I think I heard that's what they've been doing... ever since.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
之后，她们被调到了USU，接受了更多教育等等。当时引起了一阵骚动。
从那以后，她们开始不听从前辈们的指挥。
我听说从那之后她们就一直这样...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Before that, they were trainees and had more free time than other squadders. They would visit the mess once in a while, receive some snacks and chat with us.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
在那之前，她们是学员，比其他斯夸德成员有更多的空闲时间。她们偶尔会来食堂，吃点零食，和我们聊天。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
After that incident, they never came. Just by hearing the stories about them, I don't feel like they are the same kids I used to know.
They used to be better than this... I hope you can take cake of them.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
那次事件之后，她们就再也没来过。光听那些传闻，我就觉得她们不再是我认识的那两个小孩了。
她们以前比现在好多了...希望你能照顾好她们。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
This is all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这就是我能告诉你的全部了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I heard a similar story from others...
Maybe the keyword is the incident that happened at the real mission.
I should go back to the twins and ask them about it.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(我从别人那里也听到了类似的故事...
也许关键词是那次真实任务中发生的事件。
我应该回去问问双胞胎关于这件事。)

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Cookies? Made by the twins?
Oh... Those kids. They visited the mess and asked me for several things. Is this the outcome?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
绿饼人？是双胞胎做的？
哦...那两个孩子。她们之前来食堂找我要过一些东西。这就是结果吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I hope they are not trying to poison me...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
希望她们不是在试图毒害我...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, I'm just kidding. Don't look at me like that.
They seem to have found their former character. That's good. You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，我只是开玩笑。别那样看着我。
她们似乎找回了以前的性格。这很好。你做得很棒。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...By the way, where are the cookies?
You don't have anything for me? What a shame! Well~ I like cookies too~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...对了，绿饼人呢？
你什么都没给我吗？真可惜！哎呀~我也喜欢绿饼人~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
So don't look at me like that!!
Just give me the cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
所以别那样看着我！！
快把绿饼人给我！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, you! Adventurer?
What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，你！是冒险者吗？
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Refreshments for seniors
scripts.translation: 给前辈们准备茶点

scripts.text: Take care of the cat please
scripts.translation: 请帮忙照顾一下猫

scripts.text: You don't have to know.
scripts.translation: 你不需要知道。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Yo! Thanks to your support, I'm sure our seniors will enjoy the tea time today!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哟！多亏你的支持，我相信前辈们今天一定会享受这段下午茶时光的！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops... Again?
No thanks. Our seniors don't eat tea and snacks for every meal! Once a day is enough.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀...又是这样？
不用了。前辈们不会每顿饭都吃茶点的！一天一次就够了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
But thank you for your kindness. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不过还是谢谢你的好意。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Wow! You came again! may I ask you to get the snacks for our seniors?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哇！你又来了！能请你再帮前辈们买点零食吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
How did I know you are an adventurer? It's simple.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我是怎么知道你是冒险者的？很简单。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
A stranger rarely visits this place. So someone like you draws everybody's attention.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
很少会有陌生人来这个地方。所以像你这样的人会吸引所有人的注意。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
These people must return quickly in emergency, so they cannot go too far from here.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这些人遇到紧急情况必须迅速返回，所以他们不能离这里太远。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Therefore, I would like to ask you for a favor... Actually for several. Because it has to be done outside.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
因此，我想请你帮个忙...其实有好几个。因为必须到外面去做。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I am very busy because I have to feed the gluttons~ Well now~ I hope you can do something for me~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我很忙，因为我要喂那些贪吃鬼~ 哎呀~ 希望你能帮我做点什么~

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我会去做的。

scripts.text: No. I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 不。我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh~ You're so mean. What a shame.
This is why we should never talk to outsiders. Am I right? Charity~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦~ 你真好意思。真可惜。
这就是为什么我们不应该和外人说话。我说得对吧？慈善~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
... Where did my lovely and sweet cat go...?
Oh, I am so gloomy and lonely!! The adventurer rejected my request!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...我那可爱又甜蜜的猫去哪了...？
哎呀，我好寂寞好孤单！！冒险者竟然拒绝了我的请求！！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, Thank you! The adventurer is so cool!
I would like to ask you to get some snacks.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦，谢谢你！冒险者真酷！
我想请你去买点零食。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
No, no. Don't look at me like that. They are not for me.
Do you know our seniors who live on the 2nd floor? Have you met them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不，不。别那样看着我。那些不是给我的。
你认识住在二楼的前辈们吗？你见过她们吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They enjoy tea time every day.
So I try to get prepare the best tea and snacks... But it's hard to find them in this out-of-the-way place.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们每天都很享受下午茶时光。
所以我总是想准备最好的茶点...但在这种偏僻的地方很难买到。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Since I have to cook for our gluttons, I cannot go out too far. So I am sorry that I haven't been able to prepare something delicious.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
因为我要照顾这群贪吃鬼，不能走太远。所以很抱歉，我没能准备什么美味佳肴。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You are an adventurer who travels around the whole world! Please bring something delicious for our seniors and me!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
您是环游世界的冒险者！请为我们前辈和我带点好吃的回来吧！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
If the food is too expensive, it might me troublesome for you to get it. Please bring one of the following list.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
如果食物太贵，可能会给您带来麻烦。请从下面的清单中选一样带回来。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Let's see. ^0000CDGrape Herb Tea^000000, ^0000CDOrchid Black Tea^000000, ^0000CDHoney Herb Tea^000000, ^0000CDChocolate Mousse Cake^000000... or ^0000CDFruits Mix^000000.

[Milo River]
If you bring one of them, our seniors will be happy.
I am not asking you to get all of them. Just one of them will be fine.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
如果您带其中一样回来，前辈们会很开心的。
我不需要您把所有都买齐，只要其中一样就好。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It doesn't matter whether you make it on your own or not. I count on you~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不管是不是您亲手做的都没关系。我就拜托您了~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
What have you brought? I will read the list.
Tell me what you brought!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
您带了什么回来？我来核对一下清单。
请告诉我您带了什么！

scripts.text: I don't have any.
scripts.translation: 我没有。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well, I see. Although you are an adventurer, they are not easy to get. Aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嗯，我看到了。虽然您是冒险者，但这些东西也不容易买到，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
All I can get around this place are butter with an unpleasant smell and withered herbs. I can't make anything nice with them.
It's just a lack of my ability, haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我在这附近只能找到味道难闻的黄油和枯萎的草药。用它们做不出什么好东西。
这只是我能力不足，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well! Haha, thank you for your kindness!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀！哈哈，谢谢您的好意！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Give it to me!
... What, you haven't brought any of them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
快给我看看！
...什么，您什么都没带回来？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, it's been a long time since Charity went out. She ate all the forage!
Maybe she will come back after enjoying her stroll. If she doesn't come back, please find her again!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦，慈善出去很久了。她把猫粮都吃光了！
也许她逛完街就会回来。如果她还没回来，请再去找找她！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, adventurer. Do you know the idol of our unit?
Aigu? Hehe. Aigu is everyone's idol.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，冒险者。您知道我们小队的偶像吗？
艾古？呵呵。艾古是大家的偶像。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It is the beautiful cat who stays right here! Inside the basket beneath this stairway.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
就是那只一直待在这里的漂亮猫咪！就在楼梯下的篮子里。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It's name is Charity! Some guys say it is Arunafeltz Purebred Laherin Shorthair. Actually she just came to us and started living together. So we don't know her breed or age.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她的名字叫慈善！有些人说她是阿鲁纳菲兹纯种拉赫林短毛猫。其实她只是自己来到我们身边，开始一起生活的。所以我们不知道她的品种和年龄。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
The important thing is, Charity is so lovely and cute!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
重要的是，慈善非常可爱又讨人喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
By the way... Charity loves strolling and she spends about half of the day wandering outside. Look at this. I gave her forage this morning and she hasn't eaten half of it yet.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
顺便说一下...慈善喜欢散步，她一天里有一半的时间都在外面闲逛。看这个。今天早上我给她喂了猫粮，她到现在还没吃一半呢。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Perhaps somebody is feeding her outside... But I want to feed her good forage. If somebody gives her rotten food... It must not happen.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
也许有人在外面喂她...但我想给她喂好的猫粮。如果有人给她喂腐朽的食物...那绝对不行。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
She shouldn't be fay away. Could you please find Charity in Einbech?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
