哎呀，你不该这么说的。冒险者可是我们的客人。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation: 我有点忙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm quite busy...

[Rookie]
The adventure is busy! You shouldn't be asking such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者很忙！你不该这么说的！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I see... Please come back if you remember it later on. I will be waiting for you. Bye... then.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我明白了...如果你之后想起来，请再回来找我。我会在这里等你的。再见...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
See you later. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
回头见。小心点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's all right. What would you like to request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it's true that adventurers are kind!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
原来冒险者真的很善良！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I need some glittering stuffs to decorate my Shooting Star. Let me see... I need pieces of crystal and black crystal that twinkle transparently.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我需要一些闪闪发光的东西来装饰我的流星。让我想想...我需要透明闪烁的水晶和黑曜石碎片。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I wish I can go by myself and pick up good crystals one by one. But since I have to look after these stuffs, I cannot. I need so much time to clean and assemble them... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
要是我能自己去把好的水晶一个个捡回来就好了。但我得照看这些东西，走不开。清理和组装它们需要很多时间...呼...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Of course I will compensate you for your support. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
当然，我会补偿你的支持的。请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Please bring ^0000cd 10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. You can get them by defeating ^0000cdObsidians and Minerals^000000. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
请带来^0000cd 10块水晶和10块黑曜石^000000。你可以通过击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000获得它们。小心点！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. He's so loud. I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼。他真吵。就拜托你了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. I know you are suffering from the weird guy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。我知道你被那个怪人折腾得很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你来了！你把我要求的东西都带来了吗？让我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
啊！！！数量不够！！！冒险者，谢谢你帮助我们。但这还不够！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑曜石^000000。这次请别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你可以从^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000身上获得它们。所以去击败它们吧。我现在得走了。再见！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是够复杂的。我们就指望你了。这家伙还真是执着。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哎呀，哎呀...你带来了水晶...但你没有击败足够的黑曜石和矿石魔。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要黑曜石和矿石魔死亡时产生的特殊振动。那种振动能让水晶碎裂成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
抱歉又要麻烦你了，冒险者。请击败^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只矿石魔^000000。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是够复杂的。我们就指望你了。这家伙还真是执着。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, you brought them all!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哦，你都带来了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it is true that adventurers are so talented. I was a bit worried when I was requesting.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
看来冒险者确实很有天赋。刚才拜托你的时候我还挺担心的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where did you pick up that story?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你从哪听来的这种说法？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Pick up that story? Are you saying the adventurer is not talented? After seeing with your eyes?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
听来的说法？你是说冒险者没有天赋吗？明明是你亲眼看到的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I mean...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry. Lucky has so many things to do... I apologize on behalf of him.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
抱歉。拉基有很多事情要忙...我替他向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. It's okay.

[Magenta]
By the way, it's so beautiful, What a brilliant light... I would like to start working now.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
顺便说一句，真美啊，多么璀璨的光芒...我现在就想开始工作了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, come to think of it... Adventurer! Can you bring them tomorrow? They are so beautiful and I would like to try everything.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哦，仔细想想...冒险者！你能明天把它们带来吗？它们太美了，我想尝试所有的方法。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will come back if I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我想起来的话，我会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I'm so glad!!! But I might be outside for a mission. In that case, don't panic and come back next time.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
太好了！！！但我可能在外执行任务。如果是那样，别慌，下次再来就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will.

[Magenta]
Thank you so much! I should start working. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
非常感谢！我该开始工作了。小心点！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That fellow is really loud, isn't he? I apologize on behalf of him. Please take a good rest and come back ^0000cdafter the dawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这家伙真的很吵，不是吗？我替他向你道歉。请好好休息，^0000cd黎明之后^000000再来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
虽然你不必来这里，但还是麻烦你跑一趟了。
我是说...谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你让我必须来这里的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又来喽！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you please skip that performance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你能不能别搞这种表演了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, did you rest well? I rested well after completing the repair. I know you are not curious about it, but I'm telling you before you ask me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，你休息得好吗？我修完东西后休息得很好。
我知道你可能不感兴趣，但在我被你问之前先告诉你吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But there's still some water leakage in the pipe. Once I repair one of them, there's another water leakage in another pipe.. I wish we could replace them with brand new pipes.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但是管道里还是有漏水的地方。
修好一处，另一处又漏了...真希望能换成全新的管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
That's why need Steel and Old Steel Plate.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
所以我需要钢铁和旧钢板。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please defeat the ^0000cdScrap Heater^000000 and bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
请击败^0000cd火焰龟^000000，并带^0000cd5个钢铁和15个旧钢板^000000回来！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
加油！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, I'm so busy. Sorry to request you again. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，我太忙了。抱歉又麻烦你了。
去吧，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。感谢你的支持。
我们那个调皮的孩子给你添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
The adventurer is here?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者来了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又来喽！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者！你都带来了吗？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯……正如我所说的，请带来^0000cd5块钢和15块旧钢板^000000。我们需要它们来修理管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，你真会走捷径。我喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但我真的很需要它们。所以请把它们带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级明星丹尼现在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是个小少爷。我替他向你道歉。
剩下的物品就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你带来了钢和旧钢板……

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看来你没有击败^0000cd10个废炉^000000。我闻不到铁的味道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
虽然这是我个人的请求，但我希望你能帮我做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级明星丹尼现在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是个小少爷。我替他向你道歉。
剩下的物品就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~ 太棒了！你从不让我失望！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的传奇故事传遍整个大陆！每个人都需要知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那么我去准备修理了！我会再次指望你的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他说了想要什么才回去。真任性！但我没把他教成这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请今天好好休息。明天我们还会指望你。你一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
虽然你不必来这里，但还是麻烦你跑一趟了。
我是说...谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你让我必须来这里的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得听所有人的抱怨。这是个问题。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪里冷了？跟昨天一样啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
嘿，我的感觉真准。今天更冷。看。你穿得更多了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊！我什么时候穿成这样了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
让我看看...我就知道。壁炉的火变弱了。没有柴火吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
等这最后一根柴火烧完，我就要死了...最后...一根柴火...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁告诉你你会死的？你看起来很健康啊！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
拜托，别在我煽情的时候只跟着我念啊！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊，别死。如果你死了，那12个孩子怎么办。求你别死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
嘿！谁是我的孩子！而且为什么要我喂他们？怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的伴侣...在执行任务时去世了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
天哪！那我的伴侣是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...那只泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀！不不！我们就说这位冒险者是我的伴侣吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！这太没礼貌了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
冒险者~ 现在是不是很冷？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，这件外套看起来不错。难怪你不觉得冷。我们总是收到便宜的衣服，所以很容易感觉到寒冷。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者现在很忙。你在说什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
听我说，看看周围。这个地方是由铁和石头建造的寒冷建筑。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
而且既然我们身处接近地下的地方，这里总是寒冷潮湿。你知道那种感觉吗？寒冷潮湿的空气会要了我们的命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
所以我们要总是在壁炉里生火来温暖空气，煮茶，烤一些红薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
总之，那个壁炉真是天使之赐福，给了我们这么多温暖。但是柴火快用完了，火快要熄灭了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
因为太冷了，我出不去。亲爱的，你能帮我带些柴火来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！你对冒险者太无礼了！请分清现实和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哼，我分得很清楚。与其住在这冰冷的石头房间里，我宁愿跳进河里！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！懂了！只要我带燃料来，你就不会当场死亡，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可爱。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又开始了。我得承认，你真有一套。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Tree. About 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better than coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please. Three of them.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
我需要一些燃烧一半的木材。大概10根。
因为它们晒得很干，所以烧起来很旺。
而且没有什么比煤炭更能让火持续更久了。请带一些煤炭来。3块。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？为什么？它会产生太多灰烬。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
对我来说，效率才是最重要的！最暖和的才是最好的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. ^0000cd10 Burnt Tree and three coal^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。请停止争吵。我会把它们带过来。
^0000cd10根燃烧一半的木材和3块煤炭^000000。对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀！还有击败^0000cd10个废弃炉子^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
你必须击败它们才能获得煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜托了。冒险者肯定已经知道了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
小心点，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼...不管怎样，我们就指望你了。不管那个人跟你说了什么，一旦火灭了，大家都会感冒的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。感谢你的支持。
我们那个调皮的孩子给你添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
What? Adventurer? My dear?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
什么？冒险者？亲爱的？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear~~~ You're late! I've been waiting for you for a long time! Have you brought the right one again? I mean, the firewood.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的~~~你迟到了！我等你很久了！
你又带对东西了吗？我是说，柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，没有啊。而且数量也不够... 难道你忘了我们要你带什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
10个燃烧一半的木材和3个煤。我好冷啊。再见，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
还有别忘了击败大约10个废炉！我要去睡觉了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我们有些孩子很任性...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，你有柴火... 那废炉呢？你没击败它们吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
你必须去弄，亲爱的。废炉只有被摇晃大约1000次后，才会掉落优质的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
击败^0000cd10个废炉^000000。我要去睡觉了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我们有些孩子很任性...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Burnt Tree and coal, you have everything! That's why I like you, dear!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
燃烧一半的木材和煤炭，你全都带来了！
这就是我喜欢你的原因，亲爱的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
好了。把木头和煤放进去... 点火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，现在暖和了。就像你的爱一样温暖~

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Thank you so much! I will count you again later on! MY DEAR!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
非常感谢！我之后还会再找你的！亲爱的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又没跟你道别就走了。抱歉，他就是这样。
我们有些孩子很任性。但不是每个反叛者都这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请今天好好休息。明天我们还会再麻烦你的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
虽然你不必来这里，但还是麻烦你跑一趟了。
我是说...谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你让我必须来这里的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Wait!!! Adventurer! Please talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
等等！！！冒险者！请跟我说话！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I would be so sad if you leave without seeing me. I thought of a perfect design last night.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
如果你没看到我就要离开了，我会很难过的。昨晚我想到了一个完美的设计。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
And I made various stuffs and now I ran out of crystals... Would you mind if I ask you to get them?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我做了很多东西，现在水晶用完了...你介意帮我弄一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Defeat ^0000cdObsidian and Mineral^000000. Then bring me ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000。然后请给我^0000cd10个水晶和10个黑水晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Eee you later! I have to go and arrange the stuffs I made. I will count on you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
回头见！我得去整理我做的东西了。拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, Sorry to request you again. It must be tough for you now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，抱歉又麻烦你了。现在对你来说一定很艰难吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. That flake gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。感谢你的支持。那个碎片给你添了不少麻烦吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你来了！你把我要求的东西都带来了吗？让我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
啊！！！数量不够！！！冒险者，谢谢你帮助我们。但这还不够！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑曜石^000000。这次请别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你可以从^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000身上获得它们。所以去击败它们吧。我现在得走了。再见！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我们有些孩子很任性...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哎呀，哎呀...你带来了水晶...但你没有击败足够的黑曜石和矿石魔。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要黑曜石和矿石魔死亡时产生的特殊振动。那种振动能让水晶碎裂成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
抱歉又要麻烦你了，冒险者。请击败^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只矿石魔^000000。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我们有些孩子很任性...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You brought them all again!!! I'm beginning to respect you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你又把它们全都带来了！！！我开始尊敬你了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Thank you so much! Can I ask you for a favor again next time? This is great!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
非常感谢！下次我还能再请你帮忙吗？太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又没跟你道别就走了。抱歉，他就是这样。
我们有些孩子很任性。但不是每个反叛者都这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请今天好好休息。明天我们还会再麻烦你的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
Please do us another little favor!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我把他带出来！
看来还有研究员像这样躲着。
请再帮个小忙！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
^4d4dffYou can stop searching and take a rest!^000000
We will search for the rest of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我把他带出来！
看来还有研究员像这样躲着。
^4d4dff你可以停止搜索，休息一下！^000000
我们会去找剩下的。

scripts.text: The boy with silver hairs looked at me. He frowned and turned his head.
scripts.translation: 那个银发的男孩看着我。他皱起眉头，把头转开了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
Although you talk to him, he would not listen at all.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
虽然你在和他说话，但他完全不听。
看来和那个女孩说话更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
.........

He held his lips tight and looking at me.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他紧紧抿着嘴唇看着我。
看来和那个女孩说话更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Don't talk to Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
......别和雅娜说话。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Don't talk to me either.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
也别和我说话。

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight with a stubborn face..
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他紧紧抿着嘴唇，一脸倔强。
看来和那个女孩说话更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana... You're cute even when you're breathing...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜...你呼吸的样子也很可爱...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
...?!!!
Why did you overhear me?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...？！
你怎么听到了？

scripts.text:
He is furious. But he's the one who said that loud...
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他看起来很生气。但明明是他自己说大声了...
看来和那个女孩说话更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Adventurer, could you please ask Jana?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
冒险者，你能帮我问问雅娜吗？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean.... how much she likes her older brother...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我是说...她有多喜欢她的哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya, I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
伊利亚，我听到了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Gosh! No, no... I was just...!!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
天哪！不，不是...我只是...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I made cookies together with Jana. Yesterday, we read a book together. Tomorrow we will explore the dead mine...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我和雅娜一起做了饼干。昨天，我们一起读了一本书。明天我们要去探索废弃的矿坑...

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev is be excited and boasting about what happened.
scripts.translation: 伊利亚·列别捷夫看起来很兴奋，正在炫耀刚才发生的事。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I want to be called by my first name, Ilya...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我想让你叫我名字，伊利亚...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean... by Jana. Not by you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我是说...让雅娜叫我。不是让你。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Sometimes I wish she calls me 'brother'...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
有时候我希望她叫我“哥哥”...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana calls you Older {0}. And why does she call me Ilya...?!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜叫你“{0}前辈”。为什么她只叫我伊利亚...？！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Shooting? I like it. But it's not the only reason I practice it.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
射击？我喜欢。但这不是我练习的唯一原因。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because I have to support Jana. I will shoot anyone who puts a hand on Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
因为我必须保护雅娜。我会射杀任何对雅娜动手的人。

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev looks quite excited.
scripts.translation: 伊利亚·列别捷夫看起来相当兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to be treated as a child.
Do not stroke my head.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我不想被当成小孩子。
不要摸我的头。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya is the only one who can call me Jana.
Call me Lebedeva.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
只有伊利亚可以叫我雅娜。
请叫我列别杰娃。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Who are you?
You don't look like Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
......你是谁？
你看起来不像反叛者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are right. I'm an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说得对。我是冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
How did an adventurer come in here?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
一个冒险者怎么会跑到这里来？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Are you the adventurer who defeated our commander?
So you're the one from the Secret Wings, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你就是打败我们指挥官的那个冒险者？
原来你就是秘密之翼的人啊。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Huhu, the old guys here hate the Secret Wings, but we don't care.
Since we want to fight hard in a mission, we welcome your proposal.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
呵呵，这里的老人虽然讨厌秘密之翼，但我们不在乎。
既然我们想在任务中好好表现，那就欢迎你的提议。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Whatever Jana likes, I like it too.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜喜欢的，我也喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Have you brought any story filled with gunpowder?
...Well, we cannot be involved in the mission anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你带来了什么充满火药味的故事吗？
……不过，我们反正无法参与那个任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are still young.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们还太年轻了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...We'll become adults in the near future.
We are not that much younger compared to other people here. Does putting on several years make any difference?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……我们很快就会长大的。
比起这里其他人，我们也没小多少。多算几年有什么区别吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
They all know that we have better abilities than adults.
If it wasn't for one thing... No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
大家都知道我们的能力比成年人更强。
如果不是因为那件事……算了，不说了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
It's so annoying...
Ilya, tell the adventurer to go away.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
真是烦死了……
伊利亚，告诉那个冒险者让他走。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
We don't want to talk to you any more.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请离开。
我们不想再和你说话了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So they started to hate me pretty early... What should I do?
Maybe I have to listen to ^0000CDRebellions around them^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(他们好像很早就开始讨厌我了……该怎么办？
也许我得去听听周围^0000CD反叛者^000000们的说法。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ah, Ilya. That person keeps irritating me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
啊，伊利亚。那个人一直在惹我生气。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
I won't forgive you if you distress Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请离开。
如果你再让雅娜难过，我不会原谅你的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
We don't want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你又来了？
我们不想说话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Ask them about the incident that happened in the past...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(问问他们过去发生的那件事……)

scripts.text: Ask them directly.
scripts.translation: 直接问

scripts.text: Beat around the bush.
scripts.translation: 旁敲侧击

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you throw a grenade to the civilian zone during your actual mission?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们在执行任务时，真的向平民区投掷了手榴弹吗？
为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
What...!!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
什……么！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Where did you hear this story!
Hey, why are you saying that?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
你从哪里听来的这种说法！
喂，你为什么要这么说？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Get lost! Stay away from Jana!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
滚开！离雅娜远点！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......Looks like a huge mistake. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……看来是大错特错了。还是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's something I would like to ask you.
I asked others and they say you were...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有件事想问问你们。
我问了其他人，他们说你们……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Why do you pry into our private affairs?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……为什么要打听我们的私事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't pry into anything. I mean, they told me you look very tired these days...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没有打听什么。我是说，别人告诉我，你们最近看起来很疲惫……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We are tired because someone is irritating us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们之所以疲惫，是因为有人一直在惹我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......This is getting difficult. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……这越来越难办了。还是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We don't want to talk to you. Just leave.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们不想和你说话。快走吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(...I guess they really hate me now.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……看来他们真的很讨厌我了。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你怎么又来了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
( I did take the cookie... Where is it?
Let's go back to Ericsson and talk to him.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(我确实拿了那块饼干……它在哪里？
还是回去找Ericsson问问吧。)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, guys?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你们在吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Do you have so much free time? Why do you keep stalking us?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……你有那么多空闲时间吗？为什么一直跟踪我们？

scripts.text: There's something I would like to tell you.
scripts.translation: 我有件事想告诉你们

scripts.text: Want some cookie?
scripts.translation: 想吃点饼干吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to hear it.
Unless you pay us 1 million Zeny for listening to your story, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我不想听。
除非你付给我们100万Zeny作为听你说话的报酬，否则现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't know what you are up to. But we...
...Wait, where did you get this cookie?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我不知道你在搞什么鬼。但是……
……等等，你这饼干是从哪弄来的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Someone you know well told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一位你们很熟的人让我把这个交给你们。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Commander Adler?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
……Adler指挥官？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And he also said this.
Trust me. And tell the adventurer if you have any problem.
This is my request. Could you please tell me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他还说了这句话。
相信我。如果你有任何问题，就告诉那位冒险者。
这是我的请求。能告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......What...
That.. is a lie. How can I trust an adventurer...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……什么……
那……那是谎言。我怎么可能相信一个冒险者……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As I told you earlier, please think about commander Adler.
He's so worried about you. So am I, and so is commander Volkova.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就像我之前说的，请想想Adler指挥官。
他非常担心你们。我也一样，Volkova指挥官也是。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We...
No. We won't tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们……
不。我们不会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me one thing.
I heard you didn't ruin yourself like this before.
Why do you keep hurting yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我一件事。
我听说你们以前并不是这样的。
为什么你们一直在伤害自己？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Why do you say that? What do you know about us?
You know nothing!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你为什么要这么说？你了解我们什么？
你什么都不知道！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...I was so..
scared...... so...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……我当时好……
害怕……太……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Scared...?

[Jana Levedeva]
And then... I got out of shape...
So I was scared... I did so... on purpose... sniffle.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
然后……我就变得不像样子了……
所以我很害怕……我是故意那样做的……啜泣。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I'm sure you know what happened during our first mission... not long ago.
After that. Jana had such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我相信你知道我们第一次任务时发生了什么……就在不久前。
在那之后。雅娜过得很艰难。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because Jana and I had been so confident that we would do well.
Then it happened... and we... were so miserable.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
因为雅娜和我当时非常自信，以为我们会做得很好。
然后事情发生了……我们……非常痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Sniffle. We didn't throw the grenade on purpose and we didn't enjoy it either. It's out fault. But, but...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
啜泣。我们不是故意扔手榴弹的，我们也不喜欢那样做。这是我们的错。但是，但是……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We were punished and moved to USU... Then we felt that everyone else regards us as horrible kids.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们受到了惩罚，被调到了USU……然后我们觉得其他人把我们看作可怕的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
We wanted to talk to commander Ericsson. But we couldn't, because we were assigned to another unit.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我们想和Ericsson指挥官谈谈。但我们做不到，因为我们被分配到了另一个单位。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We had no idea what to do. We just wanted to run away. Because everyone was blaming us and disappointed at us...
But we liked our unit and commander Ericsson...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们不知道该怎么办。我们只想逃跑。因为所有人都在责怪我们，对我们失望……
但我们喜欢我们的单位和Ericsson指挥官……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We thought that we had already ruined everything.
As everyone was already disappointed at us, we thought we could do whetever...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们觉得我们已经搞砸了一切。
既然所有人都对我们失望了，我们就觉得可以随便做点什么……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
As we acted at our pleasure, things got worse and worse... So we were sacred...
Then we began to believe that we were the worst and hopeless kids...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
随着我们随心所欲地行动，事情变得越来越糟……所以我们很害怕……
然后我们开始相信我们是世界上最糟糕、最没希望的小孩……

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It's just our excuse that nobody stopped us...
I'm sorry to have troubled you...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
这只是一个借口，说没有人阻止我们……
很抱歉给你们添麻烦了……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I'm... sorry too...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我……也很抱歉……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what happened... Now I know you suffered a lot.
Can I tell this to your commander?
Of course I won't tell anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来是这样……现在我知道你们经历了很多痛苦。
我可以把这个告诉你们的指挥官吗？
当然，我不会告诉其他人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(You heard their story. Let's go to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000 and tell her.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(你听到了他们的故事。让我们去告诉^0000CDElena Volkova^000000。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......
We'll be scolded...
But we have no choice. It's our fault. Please report to our commander.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
……
我们要被骂了……
但我们别无选择。毕竟是我们的错。请向我们的指挥官汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Call from USU commander?
She will tell us that story...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
是USU指挥官叫我们去的吗？
她应该会告诉我们那个故事的……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We'll be kicked out...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们要被赶出去……吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm coming with you. I will defend you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会和你们一起去的。我会保护你们。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Thank you...
...I hope Jana cheers up.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
谢谢你……
……希望雅娜能开心起来。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Yes, I'm coming!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
是的，我来了！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I'm scared what she's going to tell us... But we will still meet her.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我很害怕她会对我们说什么……但我们还是会去见她的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, It's Older {0} {1} !
By the way, we are quite sleepy now after wandering around all day long...
I wonder it's already time for us to be sleepy. Let's play together tomorrow...Zzz
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦，是{0}{1}哥哥/姐姐！
话说回来，我们在外面逛了一整天，现在有点困了……
看来是睡觉的时间了。明天再一起玩吧……Zzz

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, It's Older {0} {1} !
Have you come to play with us? Or for another business?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦，是{0}{1}哥哥/姐姐！
你是来陪我们玩的吗？还是有别的事情？

scripts.text: I have come to play with you!
scripts.translation: 我是来陪你们玩的！

scripts.text: I have come for another business. But I wanted to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我有别的事。不过我想打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I see... If you are busy, we shouldn't bother you.
But please don't go away without coming back to us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
原来如此……如果你很忙，我们就不打扰你了。
但是请不要离开，记得回来找我们哦。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Wow! Really?
But Older {0} the truth is that you are not playing with us. Older {1} we are playing with you. Haha!
Hmm... What are we going to do?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哇！真的吗？
不过大哥哥/大姐姐 {0} 其实是我们没有在和你们玩。大哥哥/大姐姐 {1} 是我们在和你们玩呢。哈哈！
嗯……我们要怎么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
嗯……指挥官埃琳娜让我们培养一个爱好。
我觉得读书是个不错的爱好。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please borrow a book for us from the juvenile section of Prontera library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDIt's dizzy after being shaken 1,000 times^000000. Please borrow this for me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
请帮我们在普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区借一本书。
书名是……^0000CD《摇晃一千次后头晕目眩》^000000。请帮我借这本书。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区有专门的借阅系统。你可以去问^0000CD青少年区图书管理员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
嗯……指挥官埃琳娜让我们培养一个爱好。
我觉得读书是个不错的爱好。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please rent a book for us from the juvenile section of Prontera Library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDRebellion, the history of liberty^000000. Please borrow this book for me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
请帮我们在普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区借一本书。
书名是……^0000CD《反叛者：自由的历史》^000000。请帮我借这本书。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区有专门的借阅系统。你可以去问^0000CD青少年区图书管理员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
嗯……指挥官埃琳娜让我们培养一个爱好。
我觉得读书是个不错的爱好。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I would be glad if borrow a book for me from the juvenile section of Prontera library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDNorgroad Horizon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
如果你能帮我在普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区借一本书，我会很高兴。
书名是……^0000CD《诺格莱德的视野》^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
普隆德拉图书馆的青少年区有专门的借阅系统。你可以去问^0000CD青少年区图书管理员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Today, we would like to go to Einbech mine to research explosives. But I guess it would be dangerous if only two of us go there.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
今天，我们想去艾音贝赫的矿洞研究炸药。但我觉得只有我们两个人去那里会很危险。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean, you're dangerous for the mine? Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的意思是，你们对矿洞来说很危险？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
No! How can you say that? There are so many dangerous monsters in the mine!
And Jana says she's curious to see if there are materials suitable for our research...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
不！你怎么能这么说？矿洞里有那么多危险的魔物！
雅娜说她想看看那里有没有适合我们研究的材料...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Therefore Older {0} please implement a previous exploration for us.
Please defeat 30 Pitman in Einbech mine and bring us a Gun Powder.
Older {1} I'm sure this is a piece of cake for you. We will count on you!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
所以，前辈{0}，请替我们进行一次先期探索。
请在艾音贝赫矿洞击败30只矿工魔，并带一份火药粉末回来。
前辈{1}，我相信这对您来说易如反掌。拜托了！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Today, we would like to go to Einbech mine to research explosives. But I guess it would be dangerous if only two of us go there.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
今天，我们想去艾音贝赫的矿洞研究炸药。但我觉得只有我们两个人去那里会很危险。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean, you're dangerous for the mine? Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的意思是，你们对矿洞来说很危险？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
No! How can you say that? There are so many dangerous monsters in the mine!
And Jana says she's curious to see if there are materials suitable for our research...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
不！你怎么能这么说？矿洞里有那么多危险的魔物！
雅娜说她想看看那里有没有适合我们研究的材料...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
So we'd like to request you to implement a previous exploration.
Please defeat 20 Venomous and 20 Noxious in Einbech mine and bring us one Explosive Powder.
I know this will be cumbersome. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
所以，我们想请您进行一次先期探索。
请在艾音贝赫矿洞击败20只毒液魔和20只废气魔，并带一份炸弹粉末回来。
我知道这很麻烦。但拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Older {0}, Older {1}! We made some cookies!
Of course we didn't do the entire cooking... Milo prepared ingredients and the cooking space.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
前辈{0}，前辈{1}！我们做了一些小蛋糕！
当然，我们并没有做所有的烹饪工作...米洛准备了食材和烹饪空间。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
It tastes good! Certainly not better than those cooked by grandma Lucy. But it's still wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
味道很好！当然比不上露西奶奶做的。但依然很棒。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Older {0} Please have some! Older {1} This is for you... And could you please these five bundles to people around you?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
前辈{0}，请尝尝！前辈{1}，这是给你的... 另外，能麻烦您把这五份分给周围的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
To Milo, Mason and Rachel.
And to commander Adler and commander Elena as well, please.
Make sure you tell them we made these.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
给米洛、梅森和拉赫。
还有指挥官阿德勒和指挥官埃琳娜，也请给他们。
请务必告诉他们这是我们要做的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You don't have enough space in your bag.
Please make some space. We don't want the cookies to get broken.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
您的背包空间不足。
请腾出一些空间。我们不想让小蛋糕被压坏。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Did you forget what I asked you to borrow? It's dizzy after being shaken 1,000 times!
Last time I went there with Ilya, the librarian at juvenile section found it for me...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
您忘了让我借什么书了吗？被摇晃了1000次后头晕目眩！
上次我和伊利亚去那里时，青少年区的图书管理员帮我找到了...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Did you forget what I asked you to borrow? 'Rebellion, the history of liberty'!
Last time I went there with Ilya, the librarian at juvenile section found it for me...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
您忘了让我借什么书了吗？《反叛者，自由的历史》！
上次我和伊利亚去那里时，青少年区的图书管理员帮我找到了...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Norgroad Horizon, please.
If you tell the book name to the librarian, he/she will hand it you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
《诺格莱德的视野》，请。
如果您把书名告诉图书管理员，他/她会把它交给您。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, you're back? Please give the book!
The book... You don't have it? Don't tell me you lost it.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦，您回来了？请把书交给我！
书...您没有带吗？别告诉我您把它弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
If you lost it... You have to go to the library and report of the loss of that book.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
如果您弄丢了...您必须去图书馆报告这本书遗失的情况。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back. Here's the book.
So you'll return it yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回来了。书在这里。
所以您会自己还回去吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Wow! I wanted to read this!
Thank you, Older {0}! Older {1} do you want me to read this book for you? This must be exciting!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哇！我想读这本书！
谢谢您，前辈{0}！前辈{1}，您想让我为您读这本书吗？这一定很精彩！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmm, she's not mentioning about returning it.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（嗯，她没有提到还书的事。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh! We're going to Einbech mine. Please implement a previous exploration for us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦！我们要去艾音贝赫矿洞。请替我们进行一次先期探索。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please defeat 30 Pitman in Einbech mine and bring us a Gun Powder.
We are about to experiment the degree of firepower in reference to the amount of Gun Powder!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请在艾音贝赫矿洞击败30只矿工魔，并带一份火药粉末回来。
我们要根据火药粉末的数量来实验火力程度！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Thank you for doing us a favor!
About the result, I will inform you later!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
谢谢您帮我们的忙！
关于结果，我稍后会通知您！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh! We're going to Einbech mine. Please implement a previous exploration for us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦！我们要去艾音贝赫矿洞。请替我们进行一次先期探索。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please defeat 20 Venomous and 20 Noxious in Einbech mine and bring us one Explosive Powder.
Jana is researching whether we can apply the Explosive Powder to grenades.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请在艾音贝赫矿洞击败20只毒液魔和20只废气魔，并带一份炸弹粉末回来。
雅娜正在研究是否可以将炸弹粉末应用于手榴弹。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Thank you for doing us a favor!
Jana says she will inform you about the result after the experiment!!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
谢谢您帮我们的忙！
雅娜说实验结束后会通知您结果！！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please bring them to the five people I mentioned.
They are Milo, Mason, Rachel, commander Ericsson and commander Elena.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
请把它们交给我说的那五个人。
他们是米洛、梅森、拉赫、指挥官埃里克森和指挥官埃琳娜。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, did you eat all those cookies?
You liked them, didn't you?
Oh, come on. How can you eat all of them!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
哦，你把那些饼干都吃光了？
你喜欢吃，对吧？
哎呀，你怎么能全吃光呢！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We will give you some more. Make sure you bring them to those five people please.
Glutton {0} Older {1} we will make you more cookies for you next time!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们会再给你一些。请务必把它们交给那五个人。
贪吃的{0}，年长的{1}，下次我们会为你多做一些饼干！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
What did they say?
Did they like them? Huhu.
Don't you think I'm good at cooking?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
他们怎么说？
他们喜欢吗？呵呵。
你不觉得我做饭很厉害吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Hello. Welcome to Prontera library.
For juvenile books, only designated rental service is available.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
你好。欢迎来到普隆德拉图书馆。
青少年书籍仅提供指定的借阅服务。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Have you lost the book you borrowed?
Yes... We accept your report of a loss.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
你弄丢了借的书吗？
是的...我们接受你的遗失申报。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Please be careful next time.
If you lose the book more than once or damage it, we may forbidthe lending to you.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
下次请小心。
如果你再次弄丢书籍或损坏书籍，我们可能会禁止你借阅。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Hello. Welcome to Prontera library.
For juvenile books, only designated rental service is available. Which book are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
你好。欢迎来到普隆德拉图书馆。
青少年书籍仅提供指定的借阅服务。你在找哪本书？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Prontera library always welcomes juveniles who read books.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
普隆德拉图书馆永远欢迎阅读书籍的青少年。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
{0}, That book? Please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
{0}，那本书？请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
The book you wanted is out on loan now. Please use another book.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
你想要的那本书目前已被借出。请使用另一本书。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
{0}? Please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
{0}？请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Yes. Here it is. Please abide by the deadline.
scripts.translation:
[青少年区图书管理员]
是的。在这里。请遵守截止日期。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
怎么了？

scripts.text: Give him the ring.
scripts.translation: 把戒指给他

scripts.text: Do you come here often?
scripts.translation: 你经常来这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Teaching juniors after retirement, I think of my son every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
退休后教导后辈，我时不时会想起我的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... And my wife who passed away, too.
I also think of my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
...还有我去世的妻子。
我也会想起我的女儿。

scripts.text: You gave him the ring.
scripts.translation: 你把戒指给了他。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... This ... ring is ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
... 这... 戒指是...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Poor fellow.
In the end, this is the way you come back.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
可怜的孩子。
到头来，你竟是这般回来的。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I was expecting this.
When I found his Pecopeco, I knew something was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
我早就料到了。
当我发现他的大嘴鸟时，我就知道出事了。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
But as I didn't see it with my eyes,
I had a slight hope in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
但因为没有亲眼所见，
我心里还存着一丝侥幸。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
....
... Should I welcome you, to see you again like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
....
... 我该欢迎你吗？以这种方式再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... Thanks.
...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
... 谢谢。
...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... That rocket belongs to Cheiron.
When they told me they would take them to Geffen's Magic_tower ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
... 那些火箭属于Cheiron。
当他们说要把它们送到吉芬的魔法塔时...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I thought they would take good care of them.
... Why should my children end up like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
我以为他们会好好保管的。
... 为什么我的孩子会遭遇这样的不幸？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What should I do now?
My wife and children have passed away.
What can I do ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
我现在该怎么办？
我的妻子和孩子都去世了。
我能做什么...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
You ...
......
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
你...
......

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Shrines and convents have a very close relationship.
They come to help us like this frequently.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
神龛和修道院有着非常密切的关系。
它们经常这样来帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
什么事把你带到这里来了？

scripts.text: Hands Rosary.
scripts.translation: 递上念珠

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I know this stuff.
This is the Rosary that she was holding tightly in her small hand when she first came to this convent.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我认识这个。
这是她刚来到这座修道院时，紧紧握在手中的念珠。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I can faintly feel the spirit of that girl, Sorin.
She's grown up a lot.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我隐约能感觉到那个女孩索林的灵魂。
她长大了不少。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She was a tomboy. But since she met Seyren, she often pretended to be modest.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
她是个假小子。但自从遇见塞伦后，她经常假装很矜持。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Jooshin loved the girl a lot, and she was taken so early.
....
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
Jooshin非常疼爱那个女孩，她却这么早离开了。
....

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Thank you very much for giving this to me.
May the blessing of Jooshin be with you forever.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
... 非常感谢你把这个交给我。
愿Jooshin的赐福永远与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I used to visit the Capitolina convent with Sorin quite often.
With her high-spirited personality, she got along quite well with the monks.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我以前常和索林一起拜访Capitolina修道院。
她性格开朗，和武僧们相处得相当融洽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She also came here to relax when she needed some rest ...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
她需要休息时，也会来这里放松...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... even though the path is quite rough.
If you are going back now, do you want me to send you to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
... 尽管路途相当崎岖。
如果你现在要回去，需要我送你回普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
If you need it later, do not hesitate to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
如果你之后需要帮助，请尽管告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Bye.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
... 再见。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
You can smelt your gears over there.
I don't take requests for personal production or smelting.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你可以在那边熔炼你的齿轮。
我不接受私人定制或熔炼委托。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Who's there? A shopper?
I don't accept personal production requests.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
谁在那儿？是顾客吗？
我不接受私人定制委托。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Wait, can I see that Thimble Of Archer?
This decoration is ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
等等，能让我看看那个“弓箭手顶针”吗？
这个装饰是...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Hey! What happened to Alt?
He made this decoration for the Thimble Of Archer when he visited here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
嘿！阿尔特怎么了？
他上次来这里时，亲手为这个“弓箭手顶针”制作了装饰。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
A jewel decoration on a Thimble Of Archer! I know it sounds crazy. But it took him several days ? he didn't even sleep!
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
在“弓箭手顶针”上镶嵌宝石装饰！听起来很疯狂。但他花了好几天...甚至都没睡觉！

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Since he was having a hard time making it, I was willing to help him. But he still made this Thimble Of Archer alone ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
因为他制作得很辛苦，我本想帮他一把。但他还是独自完成了这个“弓箭手顶针”...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Why do you have this?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你为什么要拿着这个？

scripts.text: It's a relic.
scripts.translation: 这是一件遗物。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What?
No ... Wait ... Wait a minute
I heard some rumors. I did ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 什么？
不... 等等... 等一下
我听到过一些传闻。我确实...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
But I still believed that no news is good news ...
In this way, all of a sudden ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
但我一直相信没有消息就是好消息...
就这样，突然之间...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What ... What a fool.
Why did he make a gift that he cannot even deliver?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 真是... 真傻。
他为什么要制作一份连送都送不出去的礼物？

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Haa ...
Eventually, this is how it ends ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 唉...
到头来，结局还是这样...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Thank you ... for coming all the way here.
I have to delay my work for a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
谢谢你... 大老远来到这里。
我得暂停工作一会儿。
....

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Alt has an older brother.
... I will give this to him.
Since he is in a critical moment now, I will look for a chance to give it to him.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
阿尔特有个哥哥。
... 我会把这个交给他。
既然他正处于关键时刻，我会找个机会送给他。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Damn.
I cannot resume my work.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 该死。
我没法继续工作了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
... If you want to become an Assassin, go east of the desert.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
... 如果你想成为刺客，去沙漠以东。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's quite unusual.
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
这很不寻常。
是什么把你带到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
This dagger is ...
Right. Eremes ...
has finally returned.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
这把短剑是...
没错。艾雷姆斯...
终于回来了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's been a long time since I dispatched him ... He returned too late.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我派他出去已经很久了...他回来得太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Is this mission failure or success?
... He is the type of guy who hates to have a mission fail.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
这次任务是失败还是成功？
...他是那种讨厌任务失败的人。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I like guys who are serious about completing their missions. But in this case ... I wish he had just abandoned his mission and taken a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我喜欢那些认真完成任务的人。但在这种情况下...我希望他直接放弃任务去度假就好了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I will take him ... well.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我会收留他...嗯。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
In this field, it is quite common to not have your companion come back after a mission.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
在这个行当里，同伴执行任务后没能回来是很常见的事。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Some lucky guys come back like this.
And he was quite lucky.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
有些幸运儿能像这样回来。
他相当幸运。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
There's no need to be sad.
But it's just regrettable.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
没必要难过。
只是有点遗憾。
仅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
In the past, the Hunter guild was in the Payon Forest.
And I grew up in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
过去，猎人公会位于斐扬树林。
而我是在斐扬长大的。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
That's why I visit Payon once in a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
所以我会偶尔去斐扬看看。
....

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
For some reason, I felt like coming here today.
Maybe it was for this.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
不知为何，今天我想来这里。
也许就是为了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
My silly sister.
... As a matter of fact, she cannot sew well.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
我那傻妹妹。
...事实上，她针线活很差。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
She can barely sew on a button.
.......
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
她连扣子都缝不好。
.......

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
One day, she asked me.
Would it be better for me to act more like a girl?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
有一天，她问我。
我是不是应该表现得像个女孩一点？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
Maybe I can just sew on a single button?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
也许我可以试着缝一颗扣子？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
So I gave her this sewing box.
I don't know who she was thinking about when she took this.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
所以我给了她这个针线盒。
我不知道她拿着这个时在想谁。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
.........
The spare button is missing.
... Would she have sewn it on well?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
.........
备用扣子不见了。
...她缝好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
I expected this, but I never imagined this thing would come back.
... Since it was her choice ... I must accept this ... But ...
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
我预料到了，但没想到这东西会回来。
...既然是她的选择...我必须接受...但是...

scripts.text:
Sherine is holding back her tears.
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
谢琳在强忍泪水。
请让她独处一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
... Thank ... you ...

[Sherine]
... Please leave me alone.
... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
...请让我一个人待着。
...对不起。
